sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to dairy farmers belonging to ST category on purchase of electric powered chaff cutters. By using power driven chaff cutter, dairy farmers can reduce wastage of green & dry fodder which is economically important for their profitable dairy farming.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for setting up vegetable trellises (Mandap) for raw, semi-ripe, and ripe vegetables, with varying support for General, SC, and ST farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to dairy farmers belonging to Scheduled Caste category on purchase of electric powered chaff cutters. By using power driven chaff cutter, dairy farmers can reduce wastage of green &dry fodder which is economically important for their profitable dairy farming.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to dairy farmers belonging to General Caste category on purchase of electric powered chaff cutters. By using power driven chaff cutter, dairy farmers can reduce wastage of green & dry fodder which is economically important for their profitable dairy farming.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, the Marginal Farmers, Small farmers, Scheduled Caste/ Schedule Tribe Farmers, Women Farmers, Big Farmers and Institutions are provided with a subsidy on the total cost or ₹ 25,000/‐ per hectare whichever is less for the installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance for Establishment of On-Farm Storage for Sorting-Grading" aims to prevent post-harvest spoilage in horticultural crops by providing financial assistance for constructing storage infrastructure and purchasing sorting-grading equipment for farmers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" aims to promote natural farming and hybrid seed cultivation through financial assistance to farmers. The scheme provides up to ₹20,000 per hectare to encourage sustainable agricultural practices.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Cultivation of Medicinal/ Aromatic Crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance up to 75% of the cost or ₹11,250/- per hectare (whichever is lower) to farmers in Gujarat cultivating medicinal or aromatic crops on land between 0.20 and 4 hectares.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Cattleshed, Gaman, Water Tank and Bucket
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance for Cattleshed, Gaman, Water Tank and Bucket" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat, aims to support livestock farmers by offering financial assistance for essential infrastructure such as cattle sheds, gaman, water tanks, and buckets.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for the area expansion of spice crops, including seed and rhizomatic spices, to enhance spice production in Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Floriculture Mission
sub_schemes.description: This is a special scheme initiated during 2014-15 aimed at all-round development of floriculture sector in the State which incorporates cultivation, marketing, training etc. For the year 2015- 16 cultivation of Gerbera under Shade net house with tissue cultured planting materials is proposed.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Drought Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Chief Minister Drought Relief Scheme aims to provide relief and financial assistance to families affected by drought in designated areas. The scheme ensures financial security, livelihood support, and basic resources for drought-hit communities.

sub_schemes.title: Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi
sub_schemes.description: In the "Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi" scheme to encourages girl students to study agriculture subject and provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students who may face challenges in accessing education due to financial constraints.

sub_schemes.title: Chai Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to offer subsidies for planting materials, horticultural machinery, and related resources to support tea farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
sub_schemes.description: A relief and rehabilitation scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs provides central assistance to the displaced families from PoK And Chhamb and settled in the state of Jammu & Kashmir. The amount of Central Assistance of Rs. 5,49,692/- per family will be distributed through Direct Benefit Transfer.

sub_schemes.title: Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SCSP)” is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry, Government of Gujarat. Under this scheme, the financial assistance is given to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries for construction of Cattle Shed for 2 animals.

sub_schemes.title: Capital Subsidy Scheme for Setting Up Solar Plant in Milk Cooperatives in Gujarat State (Tribal Area)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote renewable energy and reduce electricity expenses. Through this scheme, a 75% subsidy is provided for setting up solar plants (1KW to 40KW) in milk cooperative societies in tribal areas.

sub_schemes.title: COP-34 Financial Assistance to Farmer for Interest Subvention (Kishan Credit Card Interest Asst.)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of interest subvention is provided to farmers who repay their crop loans on time, helping them improve their agricultural productivity and economic well-being.

sub_schemes.title: COP-5 Financial Assistance to Agricultural Credit Co-operative Banks (PACS/LAMPS) for Reconstruction and Reestablishment (General/Tribal Area)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) and Large-sized Agricultural Multi-Purpose Societies (LAMPS) in General and Tribal areas to strengthen their economic viability and ensure their continued contribution to the cooperative credit structure.

sub_schemes.title: COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to financially strengthen cooperative purchase and sale unions through 50% capital subsidy for project development such as procurement, processing, marketing, and storage activities.

sub_schemes.title: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Birsa Harit Gram Yojana" by the Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, promotes afforestation while generating sustainable livelihoods. It supports SC, ST, and landless families through plantation activities under MGNREGA, ensuring income and environmental sustainability.

sub_schemes.title: Bio Control Laboratory and Pesticides Testing Laboratory Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective is the production of Bio Control Agents such as Trichoderma, Trichogramma, etc., and further distribution to farmers as awareness and demonstration for organic Plant Health Management in order to promote organic crop production.

sub_schemes.title: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support BPL Scheduled Tribe farmers in tribal areas by providing financial assistance to purchase rotavators and thresher machines.

sub_schemes.title: Rainfed Area Development
sub_schemes.description: Rainfed Area Development (RAD) scheme was launched in 2014-15 to mainstream development of rainfed areas in a sustainable manner. It adopts an area-based approach, focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability.

sub_schemes.title: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
sub_schemes.description: In order to promote soil test analysis in a campaign mode and to create awareness among farmers about soil health for judicious use of chemical fertilisers, organic manure, the component of “Setting of Village-level Soil Testing Laboratories” is being implemented under the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
sub_schemes.description: Soil Health Card is designed to give each farmer soil nutrient status of his/her holding and advice him/her on the dosage of fertilizers and also the needed soil amendments, that s/he should apply to maintain soil health in the long run.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance in Packing Materials under Post Harvest Management of Horticultural Produce
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers to procure packing materials like corrugated and wooden boxes for post-harvest management of horticultural produce.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to General Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to Scheduled Caste Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" aims to promote structured vegetable farming through the provision of financial assistance for constructing kachha/semi-pucca/pucca trellis mandaps to all farmers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Tribe Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Tribe Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to Scheduled Tribe Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the Scheduled Tribes category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the General Category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, is designed to help farmers reduce fodder wastage and improve their dairy farming efficiency.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Protected Cultivation
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Assistance for Protected Cultivation” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote protected horticulture practices by providing financial assistance to farmers for mulching, plug nursery, polyhouse, shed net house, and nursery development.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit Crops" aims to promote fruit crop cultivation through financial assistance for high density and ultra-high density plantations, tissue culture bananas, and papayas to farmers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance Towards Sugarcane Supplied By The Sugarcane Growers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist Sugarcane Growers to take up sugarcane cultivation in the State of Goa. It provides financial support to farmers cultivating sugarcane, paid based on actual tonnage supplied at the factory weighbridge as per the Fair & Remunerative Price.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance Program for the Cultivation of Lotus Fruit (Dragon Fruit)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers to support the cultivation of dragon fruit (lotus fruit), with higher benefits for SC/ST and priority for small-scale and women farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance Program for Expansion of Fruit Crop Cultivation
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for expanding fruit crop cultivation like mango, banana, papaya, etc., through intensive and ultra-intensive farming methods.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance Program for Planting in Floriculture
sub_schemes.description: The scheme offers financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for the cultivation of floriculture crops, including loose, cut, and tuberous flowers, based on crop type and farmer category.

sub_schemes.title: Assam Tea Plantations Provident Fund Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial security to Assam tea plantation workers through a contributory provident fund. It benefits eligible employees earning up to ₹6,500/- per month by accumulating 12% contributions from both the worker and employer, earning interest to be paid upon retirement.

sub_schemes.title: Arun Pig Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Arun Pig Development Scheme” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development, Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing.

sub_schemes.title: Aromatic Plants Cultivation - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage farmers to grow aromatic plants by providing them with free seeds, planting materials, and technical support, helping them increase their income and promote aromatic farming in Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Aromatic Awareness Programme - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to raise awareness about aromatic plants and their benefits, and to provide guidance on cultivation practices suitable to different agricultural climates.

sub_schemes.title: Arka Vertical Garden
sub_schemes.description: "Arka Vertical Garden" aims to promote vertical gardening in urban and peri-urban areas to increase self-sufficiency and produce pesticide-free vegetables. The scheme provides subsidized vertical garden structures to help families grow their choice of vegetables using vertical space.

sub_schemes.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY), launched in 2015, is an extended component of Soil Health Management (SHM) under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS), National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA).

sub_schemes.title: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana aims to translate the comprehensive vision of Mahatma Gandhi about an ideal Indian village into reality, keeping in view the present context. Each Member of Parliament adopts a Gram Panchayat and guides its holistic progress giving importance to social development.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
sub_schemes.description: Farmer welfare scheme by Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Edible Oils- Oil Palm
sub_schemes.description: The Mission was launched with the aim to enhance the edible oilseeds production and oils availability in the country by harnessing Oil Palm area expansion, increasing CPO production and to reduce import burden on edible oils.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Natural Farming
sub_schemes.description: To motivate farmers to adopt chemical free farming and enhance the reach of natural farming, the Government has formulated National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF) as a separate and independent scheme from 2023-24 by up scaling the Bhartiya Prakritik Krishi Paddati (BPKP).

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme aims to enhance per-animal productivity, reduce inbreeding, and minimize sexually transmitted diseases in pigs. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing semen processing labs at government pig farms.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.

sub_schemes.title: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission
sub_schemes.description: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM) was announced as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan and aims for the overall promotion & development of scientific beekeeping in the country to achieve the goal of ‘Sweet Revolution’ which is being implemented through National Bee Board (NBB)

sub_schemes.title: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Sericulture In Irrigated Area
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides loans to farmers for sericulture activities in irrigated areas, with a loan amount ranging from ₹49,000/- to ₹79,000/- per acre, and interest rates from 11% to 12.75%.

sub_schemes.title: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Tractor Purchase
sub_schemes.description: The scheme offers a specialized loan for farmers to purchase tractors, covering up to 90% of the tractor's cost.

sub_schemes.title: Fisheries Training and Extension Programme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support fishermen attending training programmes. Through this scheme, stipend and travelling allowance or daily allowance are provided to fishermen during training.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Fishermen Affected by Natural Calamities / Accident
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to fishermen and their families in cases of death due to natural calamities or accidents, or in situations where fishermen are held captive by Pakistani authorities.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help the families of the fishermen affected due to captured by Pakistani Marine Security Agency. Under this scheme, daily assistance, repatriation allowances, and vessel reconstruction subsidies are provided.

sub_schemes.title: Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide agricultural electricity connections on a priority basis to Scheduled Caste farmers. Benefits include electrification of wells and free domestic electricity connections for Scheduled Caste farmers and beneficiaries across Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme improves power supply for farmers by replacing old wires and equipment and upgrading agricultural feeders for uninterrupted service, which is crucial for irrigation.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil" offers financial assistance to promote the use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) and enhance organic carbon levels in soil.

sub_schemes.title: Crop Input Subsidy to the Farmers for Crop Loss Due to Natural Calamities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat who suffer crop losses due to natural calamities, based on crop damage surveys conducted by the district administration.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
sub_schemes.description: With a view to provide income support to all landholding farmers’ families in the country, having cultivable land, the Central Government has implemented a Central Sector Scheme, namely, “Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)”.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote livelihood generation and income enhancement of tribal communities through value addition, processing, and marketing of tribal products.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
sub_schemes.description: With the objective of providing rural connectivity, the Government of India launched the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (referred to as PMGSY-I hereinafter) on 25th December 2000 to provide all-weather access to eligible unconnected habitations.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)
sub_schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana was launched in 2016 with the aim to support farmers by providing an affordable comprehensive risk cover for crops.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to develop selected villages with significant Scheduled Tribe population into model villages by providing basic infrastructure and improving socio-economic conditions.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana
sub_schemes.description: With a view to enabling an area-based development approach, a new scheme Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY) was launched during 2009-10. The Scheme aims at the integrated development of Scheduled Castes majority villages.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY) - Adarsh Gram
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to achieve integrated development of selected villages primarily through implementation of existing Central and State Government schemes in a convergent manner, ensuring access to quality services and infrastructure development in villages having SC population more than 40%.

sub_schemes.title: Post-Harvest Management
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the development of modern post-harvest infrastructure by supporting farmers & entrepreneurs in setting up facilities such as pack houses, pre-cooling units, cold rooms, cold storage units, etc., thereby reducing post-harvest losses & marketability of horticultural produce.

sub_schemes.title: Post Harvest Marketing Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The “Post Harvest Marketing Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya for the creation of post harvest marketing infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Popularisation Of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements” For Intensive Aquaculture In Odisha For The Financial Year 2021-22
sub_schemes.description: The aim of the "Popularisation of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements” for Intensive Aquaculture in Odisha for the Financial Year 2021-22" scheme is to provide subsidy support to farmers/ fishers.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Loan and Subsidy for Manure and Fertilizer-DNH&DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote fertiliser use for higher productivity. Subsidy-cum-loan assistance is provided in kind to small and marginal farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyaan - DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme ensures holistic and sustainable development of tribal communities, building on PMJANMAN. It promotes inter-ministerial convergence across 17 ministries with 25 focused interventions. Gap analysis by departments guides need-based funding to bridge development gaps effectively.

sub_schemes.title: Students Ready
sub_schemes.description: The Student Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana (READY) was launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister on 25 July 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Small Scale Goat / Sheep Farming (10+1 Capacity)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide livelihood support to the interested beneficiaries to improve the livelihoods of the weaker sections of society. Through this scheme, a subsidy of 60% or 50% of the unit cost is provided to eligible beneficiaries for the establishment of one Goat / Sheep Unit (10+1).

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as sheds, breeding units, and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote fish feed self-sufficiency and affordability among fish farmers. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up medium-sized fish feed mills with a production capacity of 8 tons per day, benefiting entrepreneurs and fish farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Backyard mini RAS Units - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to eligible beneficiaries for establishing these units. Various surface and groundwater sources such as canals, rivers, springs, open wells, and tube wells can be utilized for operating RAS units.

sub_schemes.title: Rajiv Gandhi Gramin Bhoomihin Krishi Majdoor Nyay Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The state government has started the "Rajiv Gandhi Landless Agricultural Laborer Justice Scheme" with a view to providing strength to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Quality Test Report - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality testing facilities at a subsidized rate to registered aromatic farmers, enabling them to obtain authentic quality reports for their produce or essential oils.

sub_schemes.title: Quality Paddy Seed Distribution
sub_schemes.description: The “Quality Paddy Seed Distribution” Scheme offers a subsidy of ₹5/- per kg on certified paddy seeds.

sub_schemes.title: Providing Navigational Aids and Other Infrastructure Facilities
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to support fishermen by providing financial assistance for purchasing essential fishing equipment, life-saving gear, and infrastructure to enhance safety, efficiency, and fish preservation.

sub_schemes.title: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)" aims to encourage tribal farmers to bring their produce to market committees by providing financial assistance towards transportation costs.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote organic agriculture by providing financial assistance for certification, transportation, and organic inputs to farmers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage and support farmers, institutions, and groups engaged in aromatic plant cultivation to establish post-harvest management and processing facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of Lakadong turmeric (Ha)
sub_schemes.description: To promote the cultivation of Lakadong turmeric for exports by providing 50% of the cost of planting material, subject to a maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha, to turmeric growers of the North East having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of NE ginger (Ha)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote the cultivation of ginger in the North Eastern region by supporting farmers with financial assistance for quality planting material, enhancing productivity and quality, and increasing the exportable surplus of spices from the region.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion Of Intensive Aquaculture Through Introduction Of Bio-floc Technology During The Year 2021-22
sub_schemes.description: The government of Odisha introduced Bio-floc-based farming and aims to promote sustainable intensification of freshwater fish and brackish water shrimp farming for boosting productivity and generating high income in a limited area.

sub_schemes.title: Promoting to Farmer for Post Harvesting & Management (Value Addition)
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to support farmers in setting up crop value addition units using post-harvesting technology and management concepts.

sub_schemes.title: Production of Foundation Seeds
sub_schemes.description: The "Production of Foundation Seeds" scheme, provides subsidies to farmers cultivating seed farms for pulses, offering specific benefits to SC/ST farmers and farm women.

sub_schemes.title: Production of Foundation and Certified Seeds
sub_schemes.description: The "Production of Foundation and Certified Seeds" scheme, provides subsidy to farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified seeds to the Department of Agriculture.

sub_schemes.title: Production of Certified Seeds of Maize
sub_schemes.description: The "Production of Certified Seeds of Maize" scheme, aims to promote the production of certified maize seeds by providing subsidy to farmers in select districts of Tamil Nadu.

sub_schemes.title: Production Of Certified Seeds
sub_schemes.description: The "Production of Certified Seeds" scheme, offers a subsidy to farmers for producing certified seeds of Pulses.

sub_schemes.title: Procurement of Food Grains From Farmers at Support Price
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure fair and assured prices for farmers by enabling direct government procurement of wheat, paddy, maize, and jowar from registered farmers at the centrally declared Minimum Support Price (MSP) along with any applicable state bonus during the designated procurement period.

sub_schemes.title: Krushak Assistance For Livelihood And Income Augmentation
sub_schemes.description: Through the implementation of Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation - KALIA Scheme , the State Government aims to lend farmers with an all inclusive and flexible support system, ensuring accelerated agricultural prosperity.

sub_schemes.title: Krushi Mahotsav
sub_schemes.description: The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana is an agricultural development scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat in the year 2010. The scheme aims to boost agricultural productivity and increase the income of farmers in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Krishi Yantra
sub_schemes.description: In the Krishi Yantra scheme, the farmer purchases farming-related equipment from an authorized dealer, then the state government gives a subsidy to the farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Krishonnati Yojana - Sub Mission On Seed And Planting Material (SMSP)
sub_schemes.description: The Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) aims to increase the production of certified / quality seed, increase SRR, upgrade the quality of farm-saved seeds, strengthen the seed multiplication chain, promote new technologies and methodologies in seed production, processing, testing, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Krushy Aranya Protsaha Yojane (kapy)
sub_schemes.description: The Karnataka Forest Department launched 'Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane (KAPY)' in 2011-12 to encourage farmers and the public to increase forest and tree cover by providing subsidized seedlings and monetary incentives for planting

sub_schemes.title: Plastic Tunnel (Lo-Tunnel)
sub_schemes.description: Plastic tunnels (low tunnels) provide benefits to farmers. These are protected structures created by covering each crop bed with a low-lying plastic sheet after the crops have been planted in the main field.

sub_schemes.title: Plastic Mulching
sub_schemes.description: Under the Plastic Mulching scheme, the Rajasthan government provided subsidies to farmers. In this, the soil surface of the field is covered with plastic film. Farmer can also use crop residues for laying mulch.

sub_schemes.title: Production Incentive / Back-Ended Subsidy for Cultivation of Horticulture Crops
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, the farmers who possess farmer's identity cards / authenticated land records/documents are provided with One-Time Assistance/ Bi‐Annual Assistance/ Annual Assistance for the Cultivation of Horticulture Crops such as Mango, Guava, and Sapota.

sub_schemes.title: Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide short term catalytic support to the District Administration in backward districts to improve programme delivery and simultaneously develop a cadre of Development Facilitators. Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend.

sub_schemes.title: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Inland Fishing
sub_schemes.description: The scheme offers loans to farmers for inland fishing projects, with a loan amount of up to ₹3,30,000/- per hectare at an interest rate between 11% and 12%.

sub_schemes.title: Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The government of Bihar launched the "Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana" scheme aims to enhance the water holding capacity of private ponds to boost fish productivity & production as well as provide benefits to private fish farmers through the expansion/renovation of their ponds.

sub_schemes.title: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme "Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes" to voluntary organizations to run the Public School (Vidya Niketan) on a grant-in-aid basis.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, fish farmers are provided insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh in case of accidental death/total permanent disability, ₹2.5 lakh for partial disability, & ₹50,000 for hospitalization. No premium is required to be paid by fish farmers, entire cost of the insurance is fully borne by Dept.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for selling fish directly.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure & ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness & quality of fish during post-harvest handling & transportation.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Small Biofloc Establishment Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and generate employment through innovative fish farming techniques like Biofloc and RAS.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote growth of fisheries sector by providing financial assistance & technical support for modern fisheries activities, thereby increasing fish production,improving livelihood opportunities,& encouraging adoption of advanced fisheries infrastructure among eligible beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to bring about a Blue Revolution through the sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector in India, with a focus on increasing fish production, creating employment, and ensuring the socio-economic welfare of fishers.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Large Biofloc Establishment Culture System - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs, provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities, accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, and boost inland fisheries.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Installation of Cage in Reservoir - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and employment in fisheries. It provides financial assistance for cage installation in reservoirs to eligible beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Krshak Prashikshan Tatha Bhraman Karyakram
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, Horticulture and Food Processing Department provide visit to the different location to make the farmers aware of the new technologies of agronomy by giving them tours.

sub_schemes.title: Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The government will provide compensation to the farmers after any accident.

sub_schemes.title: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide agricultural input subsidies in affected areas due to the rise in water levels of rivers like Ganga and Kosi and flood-related crop damage from heavy rainfall.

sub_schemes.title: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide merit-based financial assistance to children of CM-KISAN beneficiaries pursuing professional and technical courses, supporting higher education through Direct Benefit Transfer.

sub_schemes.title: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial security to farmers through direct income support and death/disability benefits. It benefits small and marginal farmers with annual assistance of ₹5,000/- per acre and a one-time payout of ₹2,00,000/- in case of death.

sub_schemes.title: Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna" with the aim to increase income generation opportunities for economically weaker segments of the society as well as to increase meat production.

sub_schemes.title: One Tea Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the One Tea Scheme is to ensure a minimum guaranteed price for fresh tea leaves to protect tea farmers from financial losses and provide economic stability. It also aims to support bought-leaf factories and promote sustainable tea cultivation in Meghalaya.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions verities / Hybrids verities Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Distribution of Minor and Micro Elements - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance productivity for Adivasi farmers through the provision of subsidised seeds, fertilisers, and supporting agricultural inputs. Through this scheme, such inputs are provided to Scheduled Tribe farmers to boost crop yields and livelihoods.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Pump Set (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. It provides subsidized pump sets and farm inputs to Scheduled Tribe farmers (except Dang district).

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Vegetable Seeds Minikit & Fruits Minikit at Free of Cost
sub_schemes.description: “Distribution of Vegetable Seeds Minikit & Fruits Minikit at Free of Cost" was launched by the Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. All the horticulture growers of rural & urban areas are provided with vegetable seeds minikit & fruits minikit worth ₹250/‐ free of cost.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Rhizobium
sub_schemes.description: The “Distribution of Rhizobium” scheme offers a subsidy on the cost of Rhizobium, to farmers raising seed farms with Pulses crops in Tamil Nadu.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Plant protection pesticides Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help Scheduled Tribe farmers and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher agricultural crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, various tools and practices are provided to the farmers at subsidised rates.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Power Operated Plant Protection Equipment Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural production and livelihood of Scheduled Tribe farmers. Through this scheme, subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, and demonstrations are provided to tribal cultivators.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil) Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help tribal farmers improve their livelihood by increasing agricultural crop production. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided on high-yield and hybrid seeds, fertilizers, and other agricultural inputs to Scheduled Tribe farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Rhizobium Packets-Oilseeds
sub_schemes.description: The “Distribution of Rhizobium Packets-Oilseeds” scheme provides a subsidy on the cost of Rhizobium, to eligible farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Agricultural Fair/Exhibition/Farmer Camp Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural productivity and the livelihood of Adivasi farmers. It provides hybrid seeds, fertilizers, equipment, and support for agricultural fairs.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and employment through reservoir-based fish farming. The scheme offers financial assistance to individuals and groups via the iKhedut portal.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Small RAS Culture System Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and create employment. It provides financial support for setting up Small RAS units for eligible beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Medium Biofloc Establishment - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Surface Scheme) Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide every farmer with reliable surface irrigation facilities by developing sustainable irrigation infrastructure, ensuring that every field receives adequate water to improve agricultural productivity.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Introduced by the Department of Fisheries, Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a scheme to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector of India.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the rearing of ornamental fish and accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, also increase inland fish production. The scheme also employs people involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Diggy
sub_schemes.description: Rajasthan Government has started the Diggy Scheme for the welfare of farmers, under which farmers will be provided grants for making dig for irrigation of crops. This scheme is to help farmers improve their farming by using more water resources and encourage them to grow good crops.

sub_schemes.title: Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen
sub_schemes.description: The "Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance by subsidizing the VAT levied on high-speed diesel used in fishing boats.

sub_schemes.title: Feed The Seed
sub_schemes.description: The "Feed for Seed" program is an initiative launched by the Government of Telangana in India, aimed at promoting agriculture and supporting farmers in the state. The program is designed to encourage farmers to produce their own seeds by providing them with free, high-quality seeds of various crops.

sub_schemes.title: Feed And Fodder Entrepreneurship Scheme
sub_schemes.description: It was launched by Union Government in 2014, and focused on supporting farmers in producing fodder from non-forest wasteland/grassland and cultivating coarse grains

sub_schemes.title: Fawara Sanyantra
sub_schemes.description: Under the Fawara Sanyantra Through this scheme, the government will provide subsidies to farmers to install sprinkler plants. This will save water and farmers will also be able to irrigate their fields through sprinklers.

sub_schemes.title: Farmers Training
sub_schemes.description: The “Farmers Training” scheme provides financial assistance for training sessions involving up to 50 farmers or agricultural laborers per cluster.

sub_schemes.title: Fasal Pradarshan
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Agriculture Department organizes field and crop demonstrations to showcase advanced crop production methods and the latest technologies to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Farmers Training Institute Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide training to farmers at the village level on updated and innovative agriculture technology. The Training Institute facilitates exposure visits for farmers to agriculturally advanced states.

sub_schemes.title: Farmers Interest Group (FIG)
sub_schemes.description: The “Farmers Interest Group (FIG)” scheme supports every group of 15 farmers with grants for agricultural development. The scheme offers assistance for office equipment, training, ID cards, and district-level meetings.

sub_schemes.title: Farmers Accidental Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of registered farmers in the event of accidental death or disability.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen
sub_schemes.description: “Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance amounting to ₹50% is provided by the Government to eligible fishermen for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Setting up Crab Culture Unit
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, financial assistance of 25% of the actual cost, limited to ₹1,50,000 per hectare is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up crab culture unit. Only Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Group/ Societies, interested in the setting up of the Crab Farming Unit.

sub_schemes.title: Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage the demand for environment-friendly products that cause lesser adverse impacts on the environment. It provides an Ecomark label for products meeting specified environmental criteria to eligible producers, manufacturers, importers, and exporters.

sub_schemes.title: Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage milk production and ensure fair remuneration to cattle farmers by providing financial incentives based on the quality of milk supplied to cooperative societies.

sub_schemes.title: Drip Sanyantr
sub_schemes.description: Under the Drip Sanyantr scheme, the government gives subsidies to farmers. There is an immense saving of water in this method. Under this method, water is applied drop by drop to the roots of the plants and wastage of water will negligible.

sub_schemes.title: Drip Irrigation Sprinkler
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote efficient and sustainable irrigation for horticultural crops by providing farmers with modern irrigation systems and financial subsidies to enhance productivity and water conservation.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Kamdhenu Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide business opportunities in the dairy sector especially to unemployed youths, increase milk production, strengthen economic condition and farmers will get economic benefits even in adverse circumstances.

sub_schemes.title: District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance sugarcane productivity & quality in Uttarakhand by providing financial & technical support to farmers for improved seed production, seed & soil treatment, pest & disease management, thereby promoting sustainable farming & strengthening the livelihoods of sugarcane growers.

sub_schemes.title: District Plan: Inter-Village Road Construction Scheme on Contributory Basis
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to facilitate the easy and timely transportation of sugarcane from farms to purchasing centers and sugar mills by improving inter-village road connectivity in sugarcane-growing areas.

sub_schemes.title: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For SSI Unit Loan and Other NFS Activities
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance for SSI unit loans and other Non-Farm Sector (NFS) activities through District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Water Carrying Pipe Line (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural productivity of Scheduled Tribe farmers through subsidized seeds, fertilizers, and equipment. It provides direct support to tribal farmers for enhancing crop production and livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Tarpaulin Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance crop production and livelihood. It provides subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, tarpaulins, and other agricultural inputs to Scheduled Tribe farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Soil Health Card
sub_schemes.description: Under the “Distribution of Soil Health Card” scheme, Soil health cards will be distributed to all the farmers who have offered the soil sample for testing by paying a prescribed fee of ₹5/- each for Macro and Micronutrient testing.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help Adivasi farmers and tribal cultivators increase crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for various agricultural inputs and equipment such as seeds, fertilizers, plant protection equipment, and pump sets.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Minikits At Free of Cost
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Minikits at Free of Cost" scheme provides subsidies for minikits to maize-growing farmers in some of the selected districts of Tamil Nadu.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus" scheme provides subsidies for the distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus (NPV) to farmers raising seed farms with Pulses crops.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment" scheme provides farmers with a subsidy of 50% on the cost of equipment to enhance agricultural practices.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districts, Scheduled Castes/Tribes, and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds" scheme provides a subsidy on the cost of gypsum material and transportation cost, to farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Horticulture Kit to Urban and Rural Areas
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, all the horticulture growers in rural & urban areas are provided with a horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 per kit to urban and rural areas, during Aadipattam/Thaipattam, through the Additional Director of Agriculture (Horticulture).

sub_schemes.title: Distribution Of Tractor Unit Under CMSGUY
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Tractor Unit" scheme is meant to revive the agricultural sector and help in doubling the farmer’s income by 2022. The government will provide one tractor along with some necessary accessories in each revenue village at subsidized rates. 10,000+ tractors will be distributed.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Certified Seeds-Oil Seeds
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Certified Seeds-Oil Seeds" scheme offers subsidies to farmers for purchasing certified oil seeds, helping them improve their crop yield and quality.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize" scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu offers a subsidy to maize-growing farmers in specific districts of the state, providing financial assistance for purchasing certified maize seeds.

sub_schemes.title: Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)
sub_schemes.description: “Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)” by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to facilitate end-to-end (from land development to residue management) use of farm machinery which can be within the reach of the small and marginal farmers at reasonable charges.

sub_schemes.title: Farm Storage Structure Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to help farmers to protect their harvested crops from damage due to natural calamities and store them safely for better financial returns by selling at optimal prices.

sub_schemes.title: Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram
sub_schemes.description: Under the Farm Pond (Khet Talaee) Nirmaan Kaaryakram scheme provied to help the farmers of Rajasthan to collect rain water and use it for irrigation purposes so that the farmers can get sufficient water for irrigation in their fields.

sub_schemes.title: Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen the financial status of district and taluka-level cooperative buying and selling unions by supporting infrastructure projects like storage godowns, marketing facilities, and branding units.

sub_schemes.title: Fal Podharopan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to expand the area under fruit plantation in the district and increase the fruit production. This scheme is implemented in all the 52 districts of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: "Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)" aims to provide safe play areas for healthy recreation and sports to urban communities. Assistance is provided to develop safe play areas in urban spaces.

sub_schemes.title: FOCUS Scheme (Farmers Collectivization For Upscaling Production and Marketing System)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the FOCUS Scheme is to strengthen farmer groups, increase production, and improve market access to enhance farmers’ income.

sub_schemes.title: Exhibition Fair and Publicity
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote departmental schemes and disseminate information about the technology of fruit, flower, vegetable, and spice crops to farmers through exhibitions and seminars organized at the district and block levels.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Vermicompost Units
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable agriculture and organic farming by providing financial assistance for setting up vermicompost units to farmers and women self-help groups.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
sub_schemes.description: Under the Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for Sheep and Goat Scheme, the Central Government will provide assistance for the establishment of frozen semen production laboratories for goats and liquid semen production laboratories for sheep at the regional level.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Small Scale Poultry Unit (Layer) for livestock owner of Daman & Diu
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims at the economic upliftment of the SC/ST, SMF, and BPL Families. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to SC/ST, SMF, and BPL families.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Poultry Valley
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organized poultry farming among cooperative society members, especially women, by providing financial and technical support for poultry rearing, thereby enhancing income generation and livelihood opportunities in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit
sub_schemes.description: The "Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to livestock owners for setting up dairy farms, ensuring sustainable dairy production.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Entrepreneur for Breed Development in Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme for the "Establishment of Entrepreneurs for Breed Development in the Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)" falls under the Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry. The Entrepreneurs / Eligible Entities can establish sheep and goat breeding unit.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Cow Shelters
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide proper shelter and care to unprofitable, abandoned, or roaming cattle by supporting eligible organizations in establishing and maintaining cow shelters with financial assistance from the state government.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Goat Unit (10 +1)
sub_schemes.description: The "Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1)" scheme by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the social and economic upliftment of goat breeders by encouraging goat breeding and genetic improvement through pure breeding.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm
sub_schemes.description: The "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance in the form of an interest subsidy to livestock farmers to take up animal husbandry as a sustainable business.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Broiler Farms
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote commercial broiler rearing by providing financial assistance in the form of subsidies for poultry rearing and infrastructure development, thereby enhancing income generation and employment opportunities, especially for women and self-help groups (SHGs).

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm
sub_schemes.description: The "Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, supports livestock owners in establishing dairy farms with up to 12 milch animals.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment Of Small Scale Dairy Unit (SSDU)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the establishment of dairy units with 10 Gir cows. Through this scheme, capital subsidy and back-ended subsidy are provided to beneficiaries via bank finance and NABARD.

sub_schemes.title: Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen market infrastructure through financial assistance to State Agriculture Marketing Boards.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Solar Pump-Based Lift Irrigation Projects (For Hilly Areas)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free and reliable irrigation facilities to farmers in hilly areas by constructing solar-powered lift irrigation projects on high-altitude agricultural lands where conventional canal or pipeline irrigation is not feasible.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Water Storage Tanks for Drip Irrigation
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers across Gujarat for constructing water storage tanks to support drip irrigation, with cost-sharing benefits based on farmer category.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of NABARD-Funded Minor Irrigation Projects - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide farmers with free and reliable irrigation facilities by constructing NABARD-funded minor irrigation projects, so that water availability improves and farming becomes easier and more productive.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Minor Irrigation Projects for Scheduled Caste Beneficiaries
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide Scheduled Caste farmers with free and adequate irrigation by constructing small irrigation projects such as water tanks and pipelines in Scheduled Caste-dominated areas, thereby helping them improve their farming.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Minor Irrigation Projects for Scheduled Tribe Beneficiaries
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide Scheduled Tribe farmers with free and adequate irrigation by constructing small irrigation projects such as water tanks and pipelines in Scheduled Tribe-dominated areas, thereby helping them improve their farming.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Fish Markets
sub_schemes.description: “Construction of Fish Markets” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, subsidy is provided to the local bodies such as Municipalities and Village Panchayat in the State of Goa for the construction of fish markets. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Godown for Grain Storage
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 24th December 2013, the scheme "Construction of Warehouse for Grain Storage" by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide modern and scientific food grain storage facilities under Food Security Act 13 to applicants in rural areas.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Artesian Wells in Scheduled Tribe Areas
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free irrigation facilities to farmers in Scheduled Tribe-dominated areas through the construction of artesian wells, thereby enhancing agricultural productivity. It is a 100% state government-funded scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)" provides financial assistance for the construction of Dudhghar (milk storage unit) and Godown (cattle feed storage) for Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Caste areas of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Tribe Area)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Tribe Area)" provides financial assistance for the construction of Dudhghar (milk storage unit) and Godown (cattle feed storage) for Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Tribe areas of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Crop Losses Due to Wild Animal Attacks
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for crop losses caused by wild animals in forest areas and their surrounding regions, thereby mitigating economic losses and supporting farmers’ livelihoods.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation in Animal Death
sub_schemes.description: The "Compensation in Animal Death" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance to animal breeders who suffer livestock losses due to natural disasters, diseases, or poisoning.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to livestock owners for losses due to wild animal attacks.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Crop Damage Caused by Wildlife (in Revenue and Forest Villages)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance to farmers for crop damage caused by wildlife, assessed and compensated within 30 working days as per revenue book circular guidelines.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to victims or families affected by wild animal attacks in both urban and rural areas through timely monetary compensation.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings. Under this scheme, a grant ranging from ₹3,000 to ₹40,000 per animal is provided, depending on the species and extent of loss.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation Amount Towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 6th February 2024, the scheme "Compensation Amount towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals" by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides compensation in case of death of cattle due to attacks by wild animals.

sub_schemes.title: Community Canning & Training On Fruit Preservation
sub_schemes.description: The office of the Deputy Director of Agriculture (Fruit Preservation) Assam was created in 1978, under the Directorate of Agriculture and in 2008 it was transferred to the Directorate of Horticulture and Food Processing.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The scheme strives to back the farmers with financial incentives in the event of a crop loss due to natural calamities.

sub_schemes.title: Bhraman - Darshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Bhraman-Darshan Yojana" was launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar aims to educate fish farmers in Bihar about the latest fisheries techniques through organized excursions, enabling them to adopt and implement these technologies in their water source.....

sub_schemes.title: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.

sub_schemes.title: Bhed Palan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sheep rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a sheep unit.

sub_schemes.title: Bhesaj Krishi Vikas Yojana (Herbal Cultivation Programme)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the cultivation of medicinal and herbal plants (Jadi-Buti) among local farmers and unemployed youth, providing sustainable employment and improving their economic well-being.

sub_schemes.title: Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This scheme includes, Plantation of sixteen perennial horticulture crops. Farmer from Konkan division can avail benefit of 0.10 Hector to 10.00 Hector and rest Of Maharashtra 0.20 Hector to 6.00 Hector

sub_schemes.title: Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide short-term vocational training for rural educated unemployed youths in agriculture and allied sectors to develop entrepreneurship skills and employment generation.

sub_schemes.title: Beej Swalamban Yojna
sub_schemes.description: Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana was started in the year 2017-18 with the objective of producing quality improved seeds on their farms for their own use by the farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage the farmers to cultivate identified seed spices such as coriander and fenugreek keeping in mind their medicinal and nutritional properties.

sub_schemes.title: Bee Keeping
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote kitchen gardening among poor and small/marginal farmers and agricultural laborers living below the poverty line by providing free vegetable seed packets.

sub_schemes.title: Balram Talab Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to conserve rainwater in fields to help farmers, ensuring water availability during irrigation and drought conditions. Farmers receive subsidies up to ₹1,00,000/- for pond construction.

sub_schemes.title: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase the production of Kufri Chipsona variety suitable for potato processing in Bihar by expanding its area and to increase the income of farmers by promoting processing.

sub_schemes.title: AGR-4 Scheduled Castes Sub-Plan for Distribution of Seeds and Fertilizers Input Kits at Subsidised Rates to Scheduled Caste Cultivators
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide subsidised seeds, fertilizers, and organic inputs to Scheduled Caste farmers to improve agricultural productivity.

sub_schemes.title: AGR-61 Agro Service Providers for the Purpose of Making Farming More Profitable With the Help of Farm Mechanization
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to support farmers in Gujarat by facilitating access to farm implements and mechanization.

sub_schemes.title: AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For SC Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme for SC Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance To Purchase Tractors
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance to Purchase Tractors” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat in the year 2011-12. The scheme was implemented for the farmers to help in buying the tractor in the state.

sub_schemes.title: AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme Of Farmers Other Than SC/ST
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme of Farmers Other Than SC/ST” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A welfare scheme by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare was launched in 2002. AC&ABC aims at agricultural development, supplementing the efforts of public extension by providing extension and other services to farmers either on a payment basis or free of cost as per the business model.

sub_schemes.title: Advanced Animal Breeding Scheme (Supply of Breedable Pedigree Murrah Bull on Subsidy)
sub_schemes.description: "Advanced Animal Breeding Scheme (Supply of Breedable Pedigree Murrah Bulls on Subsidy)" aims to improve cattle breeding by supplying pedigreed breedable Murrah bulls to progressive cattle rearers and trained cow servants. Murrah bulls are provided with a 75% subsidy to animal keepers.

sub_schemes.title: Afforestation Schemes Providing Incentives And Employment To Tribals In Forest
sub_schemes.description: This scheme offers grants to unemployed tribals for afforestation work, providing them with incentives and employment opportunities in forest operations.

sub_schemes.title: Acharya Vidyasagar Gau Samvardhan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to Increase in milk production, improving the economic status of the beneficiaries, increase in milk production capacity of animals and provide employment opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Bakri Palan Yojana
