sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote goat rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a goat unit.

sub_schemes.title: Aushadhi Avam Sugandhit Fasal Shetra Vistar
sub_schemes.description: Under the Scheme To increase production and productivity by expanding the area of ​​quality, high-yielding, short-duration medicinal and aromatic species.

sub_schemes.title: Atma Nirbhar Plantation Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance in the agriculture sector through sustainable plantation activities across the state. Under this scheme, support in the form of plantation assistance and allied resources is provided to individual farmers, Self-Help Groups & Farmer Producer Organizations.

sub_schemes.title: Atma Nirbhar Pashu Palan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance rural livelihoods, promote sustainable animal husbandry practices, & contribute to self-reliance in livestock sector. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to unemployed individuals, SHGs, cooperative societies, etc. for livestock rearing & allied activities.

sub_schemes.title: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana (ANKY) is a scheme launched by the Arunachal Pradesh government to boost the agriculture sector. It provides financial assistance to farmers for various agricultural activities

sub_schemes.title: Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a 45% subsidy with credit linkage for fishery infrastructure to ST individuals, SHGs, and FPOs engaged in aquaculture.

sub_schemes.title: "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure long term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and incentivize Orthodox tea production over Crush, Tear, Curl tea. It provides interest subvention, production subsidies, plant & machinery subsidies, tax holidays to tea plantations and manufacturing units in Assam.

sub_schemes.title: "Integrated Farming for Productivity Improvement Scheme" by the Coconut Development Board
sub_schemes.description: Through the “Integrated Farming for Productivity Improvement Scheme" by the Coconut Development Board, the coconut farmers are provided financial assistance through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) mode for the Laying of the Demonstration Plot, and for the Construction of the Organic Manure Unit.

sub_schemes.title: "Input Assistance to Farmers for Taking up Fish Farming in Farm Ponds" Component of the "Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana" Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to increase the inland fish production, and to enhance the income of farmers in the State though aquaculture. Input assistance is provided to the farmers who have excavated farm ponds under MGNREGA for facilitating the production of fingerling and fish.

sub_schemes.title: "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the sudden demise of the breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.

sub_schemes.title: "Green and Eco-Friendly Measures" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”
sub_schemes.description: The award for "Green and Eco-Friendly Measures" is conferred upon the industries that are green and eco-friendly as per the standards of the Department of Science, Technology and Environment (DSTE), Puducherry. The awardee is given a cash award of ₹2,00,000/- and a citation.

sub_schemes.title: "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced with the objective of assisting fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periods.

sub_schemes.title: "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" is introduced by the Govt of Puducherry with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending financial grants for the reactivation of wooden/steel mechanized boats.

sub_schemes.title: "Conversion/Modernisation of Mechanised Fishing Boats for Deep Sea Fishing" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Conversion/Modernisation of Mechanised Fishing Boats for Deep Sea Fishing" is introduced by the Dept of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Govt of Puducherry to increase marine fish production by extending grants for the conversion/modernization of mechanized boats for deep-sea fishing.

sub_schemes.title: "Back Ended Investment Subsidy to Paddy Growers" component of the "Crop Production Technology" scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Back Ended Investment Subsidy to Paddy Growers" component of the "Crop Production Technology" scheme was introduced by the Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. The paddy farmers residing in the Yanam region are provided a back-ended investment subsidy at ₹4,000/- per hectare.

sub_schemes.title: "Agricultural Income Tax Holiday" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam.

sub_schemes.title: "Annual Insurance Premium for Boat Owners" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
sub_schemes.description: "Annual Insurance Premium for Boat Owners" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" is introduced to increase marine fish production through subsidies for the annual premiums for insurance coverage paid by the mechanized boat operators.

sub_schemes.title: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.

sub_schemes.title: "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced to extend financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially.

sub_schemes.title: Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Incentive to Beneficiaries
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide time-bound completion incentives for rural housing construction. Through this scheme, incentives are provided to eligible beneficiaries who complete house construction within 4 and 6 months, respectively.

sub_schemes.title: Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Construction of New House
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible rural households for the construction of a new pucca house.

sub_schemes.title: Anti Bird Net
sub_schemes.description: Under the Anti Bird Net Birds will never leave your garden if they are used to pecking on certain trees and plants, but if you install anti-bird nets at the appropriate places, you can prevent them from coming again to peck your plants.

sub_schemes.title: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Production Programme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance the production and economic status of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe small and marginal farmers. It provides Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds for high-yielding food grain crops with a 75% subsidy to registered farmers operating near Government agricultural farms.

sub_schemes.title: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Exchange Programme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase agricultural productivity and production for SC/ST farmers who cannot afford improved seeds. It provides high-yielding improved seed varieties, up to one hectare, in exchange for existing crop or seed, backed by a 75% subsidy with a maximum limit of ₹1,500/-.

sub_schemes.title: Animal Husbandry: Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to small and marginal farmers for the replacement of productive livestock lost due to notified natural disasters such as floods, landslides, or other calamities.

sub_schemes.title: Animal Husbandry
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides subsidies on the distribution of sheep units, milch animals, and calves, as well as health coverage and artificial insemination for the animals. It is targeted at Tribal communities to improve their livelihood through animal husbandry.

sub_schemes.title: Planting Assistance Program for Hybrid Seeds of Vegetable Crops
sub_schemes.description: This scheme offers financial assistance to farmers for the plantation of hybrid seeds and promotion of natural farming in vegetable crops across Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function
sub_schemes.description: The "Planning for Best Livestock Keeper's Award Function" scheme by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department honors outstanding pastoralists in Gujarat by awarding them at Taluka, District, and State levels for their excellence in animal husbandry.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Haryana, aims to promote the use of solar energy for domestic water heating by providing a financial subsidy to the residents of Haryana and Haryana Government employees residing in Chandigarh.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Water Pumping System
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Solar Water Pumping System" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana aims to encourage the adoption of renewable energy for irrigation. Through this scheme, solar water pumps are provided at a 75% subsidy to eligible farmers and institutions for irrigation need

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana belonging to the Scheduled Caste category can avail a subsidy for purchasing livestock. This subsidy will be provided after the establishment of the livestock units and can be availed as a loan by the beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units
sub_schemes.description: This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities to Schedule castes, the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Dairy units, Piggery units, and Sheep/Goat units.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General)
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is a credit linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities, the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Sheep or Goat Units (15 female+1 male) and Piggery Unit (10 female+1 male).

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock, provided they have taken a loan for establishing a 10+1 Piggery unit or a 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Promotion of Protected Cultivation of Commercial Horticultural Crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the protected cultivation of commercial horticultural crops by providing financial assistance to farmers. The scheme supports greenhouse, shade net, low tunnel, plastic mulching, bird/hail net, and cultivation of vegetables and flowers under polyhouse/shade net house.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Plantation Development (New planting & Replanting) under Medium Term Framework Plan (MTFP) in Traditional Areas (Kerala and Tamil Nadu), Non-Traditional and North Eastern Region
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme is intended to increase the production of natural rubber in India by accelerating new planting and replanting of rubber on scientific lines. Accelerated new planting/replanting would be achieved by giving proper technical guidance and financial assistance to growers.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Management and Purchase of Bulls Provided for Breeding of State Gir/ Kankarej Breed
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered Gaushalas for rearing purebred Gir or Kankrej male cow calves with high genetic quality to promote pure breeding in indigenous cattle.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)" aims to promote holistic horticultural growth through financial assistance for production, processing, marketing, and infrastructure support to farmers across Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote agro-processing and value addition by providing capital investment assistance to private entrepreneurs operating in regulated APMC areas (general zones).

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5" aims to enhance the skills of women through training on value addition, preservation, and kitchen gardening of horticultural produce, while also providing a daily stipend and training support.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals. The subsidy can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units with two milch animals.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, unemployed persons will be assisted by way of providing financial assistance in form of subsidy for establishing dairy units of 4, 10, 20 & 50 milch animals like buffaloes, indigenous cows (Hariana, Sahiwal, Belahi, Red Sindhi, Tharparkar and Gir breeds only) and crossbred cows.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to improve the socio-economic and nutritional status of the poor families, small farmers and landless agricultural labourers and other economically weaker section of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, 50 chicks of 10 days of age from the Government Hatchery Farm along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.

sub_schemes.title: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The schemes are part of the Atma Nirbhar program announced during the Budget session held in February this year. A total amount of Rs 120 crores – Rs 60 crores for each scheme has been allocated to the two concerned departments of Agriculture and Horticulture.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Kisan Jyoti Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide affordable electricity to farmers in Madhya Pradesh by offering power supply at concessional rates.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish seed rearing - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and providing employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Scheme For Fish Sale Equipment - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals engaged in inland fisheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing fish sale equipment to SC fish farmers and fishermen.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Prawn Seed Stocking Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and to provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, the farmers from the Scheduled Caste Category are provided with a grant of 90% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories, subject to a maximum of ₹60,000/‐ per tubewell per individual.

sub_schemes.title: Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivators, enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers.

sub_schemes.title: Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram
sub_schemes.description: In "Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram" Rajasthan government will provide subsidies to farmers on purchasing irrigation pipelines. So that farmers can get rid of the problem of irrigation. And their income can increase.

sub_schemes.title: Silkworm Rearing Equipment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support individuals in silkworm rearing by providing necessary equipment, financial assistance, and technical guidance. Under this scheme, financial assistance of upto ₹40,000/- is provided to individuals for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.

sub_schemes.title: Silkworm Rearing Chamber
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sericulture & enhance silk production among farmers by providing financial assistance for establishing dedicated silkworm rearing chambers. Under this scheme, farmers are provided financial support of upto ₹1,00,000 (80:10:10 pattern) for construction of rearing chambers.

sub_schemes.title: Silk Tree Plantation
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mulberry cultivation and silkworm rearing among farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance, technical support, and organized cluster-based sericulture activities to enhance their income and livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the nutrition of dairy animals and enhance milk production by providing subsidized silage and feed to members of milk cooperative societies.

sub_schemes.title: Sheti Samrudhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to facilitate community level action for agriculture growth and management of natural resources. It offers financial assistance, wages for personnel, and funding for necessary office equipment for Tribal Farmers Co-operative.

sub_schemes.title: Shednet House
sub_schemes.description: The Shednet House provided subsidies to farmers so they could earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, fruits, etc. by controlling the agro-climatic factors, temperature, humidity, and sunlight.

sub_schemes.title: Semi-Commercial Duck Farming
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Semi-Commercial Duck Farming” started under the State Sector Scheme "Encouragement of Commercial Poultry Entrepreneur and Promotion of Backyard Poultry Production" to support small entrepreneurs in setting up Duck farms with a capacity of 1000 ducks.

sub_schemes.title: Seed Testing Laboratory Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to assist seed testing services to farmers to ensure the viability and purity of seed to be sown.

sub_schemes.title: Pashu Palan Yojana (GSKVN)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000 are provided to sanitation workers and their dependents at an interest rate of 6% for self-employment in animal husbandry or related activities.

sub_schemes.title: Pashu Palan Yojana (GTKVN)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance the livelihoods of Thakor and Koli communities by providing financial assistance for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farming. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000/- are provided for the purchase of milch animals such as cows and buffaloes.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Insulated vehicles - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for Insulated vehicles.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Construction of Retail Outlets/ Agricultural Malls in State Market Committees
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to support market committees in constructing retail outlets and agricultural malls to facilitate direct selling of farmers' produce, ensuring better pricing and increasing farmers' income.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Processing Units in State Market Committees
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to support market committees in Gujarat by providing financial assistance for the establishment of processing units.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Promote Mechanization for the Development of Horticulture
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mechanization for the development of horticulture by providing subsidies to farmers for purchasing modern agricultural machinery used in horticultural crops.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve crop productivity through providing certified seeds at subsidized rates to all farmers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole" focuses on enhancing the management and operation of Gaushalas and Panjrapoles by offering incentive prizes to the top performers.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Assist for Infrastructural Facilities for Gaushalas & Panjrapole
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme to Assist for Infrastructural Facilities for Gaushalas & Panjrapole" aims to support animal welfare organizations like gaushalas and panjrapoles by offering financial assistance for the development and construction of essential infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers across Gujarat in adding value to their crops by providing financial assistance for purchasing machinery.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Providing Assistance to Encourage Farmers for Adoption of Organic Farming
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to promote organic farming by providing financial assistance to farmers for certification, input subsidies, and residue testing.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, aims to promote the cultivation and production of local cotton seed varieties across Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage individuals and groups to construct fish ponds by providing financial assistance and to promote sustainable fish farming while enhancing livelihood opportunities in the hilly regions of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana with the objective of encouraging the farmers for conservation and development of the indigenous breeds of cows and buffaloes.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Assistance on Purchase of Smartphone by the Farmers
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing smartphones, enabling them to access agricultural technology, weather updates, pest control techniques, and government assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Inverter Charger
sub_schemes.description: The "Solar Inverter Charger" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana, aims to promote the use of renewable energy and reduce electricity dependence by providing a subsidy of ₹6,000/- or ₹10,000/- for solar inverter charger systems to eligible households.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)
sub_schemes.description: The "Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana, aims to promote renewable energy adoption and ensure sustainable power access through solar solutions. Through this scheme, a subsidized solar home lighting system is provided to families.

sub_schemes.title: Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control
sub_schemes.description: Through the scheme “Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control", the farmers can give their soil and water samples to the soil testing lab for analysis and recommendation at completely free of cost.

sub_schemes.title: Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Supply of Male Goat on Subsidy Basis
sub_schemes.description: "Male Goat Supply Scheme on Grant Basis" aims to improve the breed of indigenous/local goats throughout the state. Through this scheme, one male goat of an improved breed (Jamnapari, Barbari, or Sirohi Bakra) is provided to goat farmers of all categories on a grant basis.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder" aims to supply improved quality fodder seeds to registered Gaushalas and Panjarapols to ensure round-the-year green fodder availability for livestock.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Rearing Purebreed Gir/ Kankarage Male Cow Calves with Excellent Genetic Quality
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered Gaushalas for rearing purebred Gir or Kankrej male cow calves with high genetic quality to promote pure breeding in indigenous cattle.

sub_schemes.title: Saur Sujala Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Saur Sujala Yojana is to set up solar irrigation pumps for the irrigation needs of the farmers. The scheme has been started on November 01, 2016, with the aim of empowering the farmers by providing irrigation pumps to the farmers at subsidized rates.

sub_schemes.title: Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat on 30.10.1995.

sub_schemes.title: Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve power infrastructure in coastal taluks by addressing corrosion issues, ensuring adequate voltage, and continuous electricity supply. Benefits include reduction in motor burnout, prevention of industrial losses, and providing new agricultural electricity connections.

sub_schemes.title: Sabji Shetra Vistar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under the Sabji Shetra Vistar yojana, selection of vegetables through quality high yielding varieties to expand the area of crops and increase production.

sub_schemes.title: SVAMITVA Yojana (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
sub_schemes.description: SVAMITVA, a Central Sector scheme of Ministry of Panchayati Raj to provide ‘Record of Rights’ to village household owners with issuance of legal ownership cards (Property cards/Title deeds) to the property owners by mapping of land parcels using drone technology.

sub_schemes.title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

sub_schemes.title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Boat Net - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to boost fish production and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. It offers financial assistance for purchase of boats and nets to eligible Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Non-Tribal Areas
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to enhance fish seed production and promote inland fisheries in non-tribal areas.

sub_schemes.title: To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for constructing community-based water tanks/storage structures to ensure efficient water use through drip irrigation.

sub_schemes.title: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,200/- to male and female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.

sub_schemes.title: Tea Development and Promotion Scheme (TDPS): Plantation Development for Small Tea Growers (PDSTG): Mechanization for Individual Small Growers
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this component is to increase the production, productivity and quality of tea, overall development of small tea growers to help them move up in the value chain, sustainability of production by promoting organic tea cultivation& climate resilient tea and to make them self-reliant.

sub_schemes.title: Tea Development Programme in the Hilly Districts of Uttarakhand - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote tea cultivation in the mountainous regions of Uttarakhand, providing sustainable employment, optimal utilization of barren and unused land, and economic upliftment of local farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana)
sub_schemes.description: "Tap Water Scheme" (नल जल योजना) by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide clean water in Gram Panchayat areas in an accessible manner. The application has to be made to the concerned Gram Panchayat.

sub_schemes.title: Tea Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to continue the experimental plantation of tea and to find the possibility of growing tea economically as well as on a commercial scale.

sub_schemes.title: Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)
sub_schemes.description: The Bihar Government's Animal and Fisheries Resources Department has introduced the "Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)" aims to support fish farmers by providing financial and technical assistance for pond construction, installation of necessary equipment

sub_schemes.title: Supply of Fodder Minikit
sub_schemes.description: The "Supply of Fodder Minikit" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide improved varieties of fodder seeds to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to establish farmer support centers at market committee levels and computerize all market committees in Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to State Market Committees and Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Unions for constructing large-sized warehouse godowns

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Assistance in Cow Maintenance Expenses to Farmers Practicing Completely Natural Farming Based on Indigenous Cows
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance for the maintenance of one indigenous cow to farmers who practice completely natural farming methods using native cows.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Scheduled Caste
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ unit for Scheduled Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Schedule Caste People of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit For Divyang People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit for Divyang People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Divyang People of the society of Gujarat State.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit To Scheduled Tribes
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit to Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Scheduled Tribe People of Gujarat State.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit For Weaker Section
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of weaker section people of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Tribe Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Tribe Women” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for General Category People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Caste People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Caste People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide supplementary income to Schedule Caste People of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles by providing a subsidy on the purchase of battery-operated three-wheelers.

sub_schemes.title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage farm mechanization purchasing and providing 50% subsidy/financial assistance to SC/ST, small and marginal, and women farmers (of all categories), while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Sub-mission On Agriculture Mechanization
sub_schemes.description: The Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization was launched in 2014-15 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.

sub_schemes.title: Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying introduced the National Livestock Mission as umbrella scheme. The "Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry" is the realigned National Livestock Mission, which is the scheme's sub-mission.

sub_schemes.title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the adoption of modern and scientific farming practices among farmers across the state through continuous training, practical demonstrations, and exposure visits.

sub_schemes.title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, individual large farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, self-help groups, and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rate, with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%.

sub_schemes.title: Sub mission on Seeds and Planting Material
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase the production of certified/quality seed; strengthen Seed Testing Laboratories; assist Seed Producing Institutes for the adoption of new technologies, ensuring farmers get quality seeds at the right time and reasonable prices.

sub_schemes.title: Student READY (Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana)
sub_schemes.description: The Student READY (Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana) program aims to provide rural entrepreneurship awareness, and practical experience in a real-life situation in rural agriculture, and create awareness to undergraduate students about practical agriculture and allied sciences.

sub_schemes.title: Rythu Bima Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Rythu Bandhu Farmer Group Life Insurance Scheme for Farmers” is a life insurance scheme by the Government of Telangana that provides insurance coverage to the nominee of a farmer in case of the farmer’s death. It is free for farmers and is implemented through LIC.

sub_schemes.title: Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers
sub_schemes.description: BRIEF DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage farmers and youth in Goa to take up Dairy business to increase local milk production and achieve state self-sufficiency. It offers a 40% composite subsidy on milk proceeds (incentive and cattle feed subsidy) to eligible resident farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Reservoir Fisheries Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Reservoir Fisheries Development Scheme" by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Jharkhand, enhances fish production and livelihood opportunities for registered fisheries cooperatives through the provision of fish fingerlings, boats, and nets.

sub_schemes.title: Replanting & Rejuvenation of Coconut Garden" by the Coconut Development Board
sub_schemes.description: Through the scheme “Replanting & Rejuvenation of Coconut Garden (R&R)" by the Coconut Development Board, the coconut farmers are provided financial assistance through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) mode for the cutting & removal, replanting, and for integrated management practices.

sub_schemes.title: Relief During Natural Calamities Such as Cyclone, Flood or Fire (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: "Relief During Natural Calamities Such as Cyclone, Flood or Fire" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹40,000/- is provided to the registered ESM / Widows/Dependents of ESM as a relief during natural calamities.

sub_schemes.title: Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" introduced to reimburse the sales tax on high-speed diesel oil used by the registered mechanized boat operators.

sub_schemes.title: Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The registration ensures that farmers are eligible to access the benefits of all schemes offered by CAP, including state and central government subsidies, technical guidance, training programs, and product clearance support.

sub_schemes.title: Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plants, make the process of using their cultivated herbs easier, and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests.

sub_schemes.title: Registration for Crop Procurement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure fair crop prices for farmers by facilitating government procurement and provides easy online registration for landholding farmers to sell their crops at minimum support price.

sub_schemes.title: Regional Centre for Training and Production of Mushroom
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to train farmers in the method of mushroom cultivation and to supply quality spawn and pasteurized compost to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Rearing Pond Construction Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Rearing Pond Construction Scheme" by the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, and Cooperation, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote fish farming by providing financial aid for constructing rearing ponds. Beneficiaries receive up to 80% government assistance for Scheduled Castes (SC)

sub_schemes.title: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
sub_schemes.description: The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP) aims to honor scientists and technical experts for outstanding contributions and innovations in agriculture and allied sciences.

sub_schemes.title: Ramie Crop Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage cultivation of perennial and remunerative textile crop such as Ramie in suitable areas by providing necessary inputs and training.

sub_schemes.title: Supply of Insulated Boxes
sub_schemes.description: A subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost for the purchase of an insulated box of at least 50 liters capacity. Only the fisherman engaged in selling and marketing fish, fishing at sea with a canoe, and fishing at sea with a mechanized fishing vessel with upto 6-cylinder engines are eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Supply of Agriculture Machineries Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to distribute and sale of agricultural machinery such as Power Tillers, etc. to farmers at subsidized rates.

sub_schemes.title: Supply of Kadaknath Chicks on Subsidy
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Supply of Kadaknath Chicken on Grant" aims to improve the economic condition of beneficiaries through poultry farming and protect and promote the Kadaknath breed. Beneficiaries receive 40 chicks along with food grains, medicine, and transportation support for 28 days.

sub_schemes.title: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity & improve sugar recovery by promoting cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, & newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, & access to advanced agricultural technology.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for purchasing e-bikes at a subsidised rate. The benefits include making it more convenient for journalists to gather and disseminate news, with the intended beneficiaries being eligible Goa-based journalists.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats" is introduced by the Government of Puducherry with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending subsidies for the procurement of wooden/fiber-reinforced plastic/steel mechanized boats.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote renewable energy and clean transportation by providing a subsidy to students for the purchase of battery-operated two-wheelers from authorized manufacturers.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R./Kadaknath & 1000 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Tribes People of the State
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance and training stipends to Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals in Gujarat for poultry farming.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit, 100 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste individuals by providing financial assistance for poultry farming.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s unit 40 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance and training to economically weaker sections and Divyang individuals in Gujarat for poultry farming.

sub_schemes.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote & support organic farming among farmers in Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹9,000/- per hectare to farmers for the purchase of organic inputs, including seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners.

sub_schemes.title: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme" by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000 per month to each Gram Panchayat for operational and maintenance purposes, ensuring efficient governance at the grassroots level.

sub_schemes.title: Paddy Procurement Scheme Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: The "Paddy Procurement Scheme" 2012-13" by the Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, ensures that farmers receive minimum support price for paddy procurement, preventing distress sales and supporting food security.

sub_schemes.title: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mechanized paddy transplantation under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. It provides ₹3,000 per acre for land preparation, including ploughing and weeding, up to 2 hectares.

sub_schemes.title: Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to support sugar co-operatives by providing financial assistance for modernization, diversification, organic fertilizer production to enhance sugarcane farming and the sugar industry.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for the support for acquisition of deep-sea fishing vessels for traditional fishermen.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to boost fish production, exports, and the safety of fishermen. Assistance is given for modernisation, insulated vehicles, and upgradation of fishing vessels to improve income and fish quality.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Three wheeler with Ice Box including e-rickshaws for fish vending - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for a three-wheeler with an Ice Box, including e-rickshaws for fish vending.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up small-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems.

sub_schemes.title: Plantation Crop Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objectives of the scheme are to boost up the area and production of all plantation crops like Arecanut, Cashewnut, Coconut, Pineapple etc., and to provide a 50 % subsidy for planting materials and construction of a soakage tank.

sub_schemes.title: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field-Pulses ISPOM
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides subsidies to farmers for installing pipes to carry water from the source to their fields, offering a 50% subsidy or up to ₹15,000/- for pipes (up to 800m), including PVC, HDPE, and others.

sub_schemes.title: Plant Protection Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to control pests and diseases including weeds and rodents of horticultural crops by the distribution of bio-pesticides/Bio-agents and equipment at 50% subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Phool Vikash Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial benefits to farmers for the cultivation of marigold flowers. It is available in 15 districts of the state and offers a 50% subsidy for up to 4 hectares.

sub_schemes.title: Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, farmers are enabled to sell teak and sal wood to the government at notified rates, ensuring fair compensation through timely e-payment.

sub_schemes.title: Payment Related to Wheat Procurement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure timely online payment to farmers for wheat sold at government procurement centers through the Just-In-Time (JIT) system directly into their bank accounts.

sub_schemes.title: Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana" aims to promote fisheries by constructing ponds and setting up related supporting units in plateau-dominated districts. The initiative is designed to create new employment opportunities and provide a means of livelihood for farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Pashudhan Mitra Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 20th June 2013, the scheme "Pashudhan Mitra Scheme1" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Govt of Chhattisgarh, aims to expand veterinary and breeding services, strengthen service delivery, and provide incentive honorariums to Pashudhan Mitras for livelihood support.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of Bio-toilets in mechanised fishing vessels - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide sanitation facilities on mechanised fishing vessels. It provides financial assistance depending on category, with once-in-a-lifetime eligibility.

sub_schemes.title: Organizing Block Demonstration on Polythene Mulch Technology in Groundnut
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for adopting polythene mulch technology in groundnut cultivation to improve productivity.

sub_schemes.title: Organic Manure Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide hands on training at the village level on production of organic compost inputs such as compost for plant health management for sustainable agriculture.

sub_schemes.title: Organizing Block Demonstration
sub_schemes.description: The “Organizing Block Demonstration” scheme provides a 50% subsidy or ₹2,000/- (whichever is less) on input costs for demonstrating the cultivation of Pulses crops over 5 hectares.

sub_schemes.title: Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU" offers grants to farmers for maize cultivation. Farmers can avail a subsidy for demonstrating cultivation practices on a 1-hectare plot.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rain water harvesting structure (nos)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing rain water harvesting structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Organic Certification Groups
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme to support farmer groups/FPOs in acquiring organic certification for the farm which is a prerequisite for marketing of organic spices.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Internal Control System (ICS) (nos)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme to support the grower groups / FPOs to establish grower group certification in order to prepare farmers on group formation, organic regulations, certification procedures, training, documentation, internal inspection etc. for organic certification and aggregation of the produce.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (Nos.)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage small cardamom growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development in order to increase productivity and improve the quality of small cardamom.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom : Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / Water Storage Structure (nos)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing water storage structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles. Through this scheme, subsidy benefits are provided to general, women, and SC/ST category beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for new ponds in saline/alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided to beneficiaries constructing new water bodies for fish/shrimp culture.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support fishers by providing financial assistance for live fish vending centers. A subsidy per unit is provided under PMMSY.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of motorcycles with ice boxes. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive subsidies to enhance their livelihood opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.

sub_schemes.title: Implementation of Scheme for Providing Implements/Machinery on Subsidy to the Farmers of Scheduled Caste Category (SB-89)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve agricultural mechanization among scheduled caste farmers, enhance farm income, and enable them to access other mechanization schemes that require tractor ownership.

sub_schemes.title: ₹ 5 Lakh Insurance Cover To Farmers
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15 August 2018, the scheme "₹5 Lakh Insurance Cover for Farmers" is an Insurance Scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana. This scheme provides ₹5 lakh insurance coverage to all farmers aged between 18 and 60 years.

sub_schemes.title: Zero Budget Natural Farming
sub_schemes.description: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote natural farming.

sub_schemes.title: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to protect farmers' crops from damage caused by wild and stray animals by providing financial assistance for wire fencing around farms.

sub_schemes.title: Winter Cropping & Development of Cultivable Land Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objectives of the scheme are to bring more areas under cultivation during the normally lean winter season under different crops other than paddy and increase production and productivity of various crops like cereals, pulses, oilseeds, and vegetables during the Rabi season.

sub_schemes.title: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.

sub_schemes.title: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide crop insurance protection to farmers against weather-related risks under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. It ensures financial support to farmers affected by adverse weather conditions.

sub_schemes.title: Walk In Tunnel
sub_schemes.description: Under the Walk-In Tunnel, the Rajasthan government provides the benefit of a subsidy to the farmers with affordable and efficient structures that offer protection from adverse weather conditions, pests, and diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Visit of Contract Farming Farmers to the Research Stations in Karnataka
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Visit of Contract Farming Farmers to the Research Stations in Karnataka” facilitates visits for contract farming farmers to research stations across Karnataka to gain agricultural knowledge. Financial support is provided for a 3-day visit.

sub_schemes.title: Very Dense Apple Plantation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote intensive apple cultivation among farmers by establishing modern orchards with high-yielding varieties and providing financial assistance through a 60% subsidy on saplings, thereby enhancing productivity and increasing farmers’ income.

sub_schemes.title: Vermicompost Ikai
sub_schemes.description: In the Vermicompost Ikai scheme, provide subsidies to farmers and Organic fertilizer is a systematic pest-nutrition process in which the soil is made fertile by absorbing other organic substances present within the soil.

sub_schemes.title: Vegetable Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote vegetable production through HYV Seeds/ Hybrids/ Improved/ Open Pollinated seedlings, including assistance to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Vegetable Area Expansion
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote and expand vegetable cultivation across the state by providing seasonal vegetable seeds to farmers at a 50% subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Ved-Vyas Housing Construction Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Ved Vyas Housing Construction Scheme" provides financial assistance to active and traditional fish farmers in Simdega district for building houses. The scheme prioritizes individuals particularly those living in kutcha or thatched houses.

sub_schemes.title: Vats Palan Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve Indian indigenous high-yielding cattle breeds by providing eligible livestock farmers with financial incentives and monthly support for calf maintenance.

sub_schemes.title: Uttam Pashu Puraskar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Uttam Pashu Puraskar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide incentives and encouragement to livestock Owners for rearing good quality high yielding animals.

sub_schemes.title: Use of Advanced Drone Technology (Agriculture Aircraft) in Agriculture Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Use of Advanced Drone Technology (Agriculture Aircraft) in Agriculture Sector" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat, aims to promote the use of advanced drone technology for spraying crop protection chemicals and bio-fertilizers, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Udhyan Card
sub_schemes.description: It aims to create a unified identification system for farmers engaged in horticulture activities, enabling them to access all horticulture-related schemes and benefits provided by the Government of Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Tubewell Installation /Pond Construction
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance irrigation facilities for farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance for the construction of tubewells and ponds, thereby improving water availability, supporting horticultural development, and increasing agricultural productivity.

sub_schemes.title: Tuber Crops Potato, Tapioca, Colocasia
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to boost up production and productivity of potato per unit area by providing quality HYV seeds, and equipment at a 50% subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Trainning Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless farm labour at Centre of Excelence of Department
sub_schemes.description: The "Training Scheme for Horticulture Skill Development to Landless Farm Labour at Centre of Excellence of Department" aims to provide skill development training in horticulture to landless farm labourers through the Centres of Excellence.

sub_schemes.title: Training Programme for Sugarcane Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance the knowledge and skills of sugarcane farmers by providing free training and information on advanced and modern sugarcane cultivation techniques.

sub_schemes.title: Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment
sub_schemes.description: The "Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Madhya Pradesh promotes milk production and employment. Trained Gausevaks get an honorarium of ₹4,000 and equipment worth ₹18,000.

sub_schemes.title: Training of Farmers on Pulses Production Technologies
sub_schemes.description: The “Training of Farmers on Pulses Production Technologies” scheme aims to educate farmers on advanced pulses production technologies to enhance crop yield.

sub_schemes.title: Training to Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Training to Farmers” provides training to maize farmers across various districts, aiming to enhance farming practices and increase productivity.

sub_schemes.title: Training Program for A-HELP Women Workers - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide community-service-based skill development and employment opportunities for women in the field of animal husbandry. Eligible women members of Self-Help Groups under the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission can apply.

sub_schemes.title: Training Programme for Entrepreneurship Development in Biotechnology
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to train youth in biotechnology and develop entrepreneurial skills by providing technical knowledge, mentorship, and guidance to help them initiate biotech startups.

sub_schemes.title: Tour Program of Modern Laboratories
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote biotechnology education and research by providing students, researchers, and farmers with exposure to modern laboratories, advanced research activities, and innovative technologies.

sub_schemes.title: To Provide Interest Subvention to Animal Husbandry of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kisan Credit Card
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide 4% interest subvention to cattle breeders in Gujarat on timely repayment of short-term loans taken through the Kisan Credit Card for animal husbandry activities.

sub_schemes.title: Top Working Program
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to transform local varieties of Mango, Ber, Amla, and other indigenous plants into improved varieties. It also provides 20 days of Top Working training to unemployed rural youth.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos)
sub_schemes.description: To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Pepper thresher (nos)
sub_schemes.description: To motivate the pepper growers to produce good quality pepper for export by promoting installation of pepper threshers for hygienic separation of pepper berries from the spikes.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Turmeric boiler ( nos)
sub_schemes.description: To motivate the growers to boil the turmeric hygienically using steam boiling unit and to produce quality turmeric suitable for exports

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Reintroduced subcomponents:Supply of Silpaulin Sheets (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Small Cardamom (nos) (Improved Cardamom Curing Devices)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage cardamom growers to adopt Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for drying small cardamom, thereby improving the quality of the produce and making it more suitable for export.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:Weather Based Insurance Scheme for small cardamom
sub_schemes.description: To protect small cardamom growers against the adverse weather incidences such as deficit or excess rainfall, heat (temperature), relative humidity, etc. which are deemed to adversely affect the production.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents: Basic quality testing of spices
sub_schemes.description: To promote field-level basic quality testing of spices, enabling farmers to assess produce quality, negotiate better prices, and receive fair value for their produce.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:FRESH-IT (Farmer’s Research & Enterprise in Spice Holdings for Innovative Technology)
sub_schemes.description: To encourage spice farmers to adopt innovative technologies and develop improved spice varieties and cost-effective post-harvest machinery to enhance the production, productivity, and quality of spices.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Nursery
sub_schemes.description: The scheme component "Nursery" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm in the state and reduce dependence on imports through providing subsidy assistance for setting up nurseries for farmers.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development" aims to promote sustainable agriculture through improved agronomic practices, efficient resource use, and integrated farming systems by providing financial support to all farmers.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in pig farming by providing a one-time capital subsidy of up to ₹30 lakh to eligible entrepreneurs and organizations to establish breeder farms.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Establishment of Seed Garden
sub_schemes.description: The scheme component "Establishment of Seed Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase oil palm production in Gujarat and reduce imports by establishing seed gardens through infrastructure support to farmers.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Custom Hiring Centre cum Harvester Groups
sub_schemes.description: The scheme component "Custom Hiring Centre cum Harvester Groups" under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm in the state and reduce dependency on imports by supporting farmers with equipment and facilities.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Harvesting Tools
sub_schemes.description: The scheme component "Harvesting Tools" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm and reduce its import by providing subsidies for various harvesting tools to farmers in the state.

sub_schemes.title: National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote organic farming practices through providing financial assistance for organic inputs and infrastructure support to farmers.
