sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Livestock Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to livestock in order to protect cattle rearers against the loss of their animals due to death, thereby encouraging them to adopt better animal husbandry practices.

sub_schemes.title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Tribal Areas
sub_schemes.description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to enhance fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribes (ST) individuals engaged in inland fisheries.

sub_schemes.title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing by Women - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase fish production through inland fisheries and provide employment opportunities, particularly to Scheduled Tribe women engaged in fish seed rearing.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme Of Provision Of Subsidized Rams To Sheep Breeders
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "Scheme of provision of subsidized Rams to Sheep Breeders" to improve the Quality and Quantity of Wool being produced in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Tribe” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Caste
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Caste” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for the State Cattle Breeders” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

sub_schemes.title: Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and Computer–Furniture to the Society
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Castes by providing managerial salary and computer–furniture assistance to eligible cooperative societies.

sub_schemes.title: Stipend Scheme For Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Schedule Tribes through scientific poultry farming training.

sub_schemes.title: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp
sub_schemes.description: The project aims to enhance climate-resilience and profitability of smallholder farming systems in 15 project districts of Maharashtra through promotion of climate resilient technology and commodity value chain across approximately 5,000 drought-prone and/or sodicity/salinity affected villages.

sub_schemes.title: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: To increase the income of farmers, State government has announced "Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana" in which cultivable land holding farmer families of the state will get an additional amount of Rs. 6000/- per year (along with Rs. 6000/- through Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana

sub_schemes.title: Nandi Shala Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve local cattle breeds through natural insemination. Under this, indigenous breeding bulls are provided on subsidy to livestock farmers in rural Gram Panchayats.

sub_schemes.title: Namami Gange Yojana- Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organic farming practices among farmers residing in villages along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries.

sub_schemes.title: Nalkoop Khanan Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, farmers from SC and ST categories are eligible for a subsidy covering 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹25,000/-) for digging a tube well and 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹15,000/-) for the successful installation of a tube well submersible pump.

sub_schemes.title: Nagar Van Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to develop 400 Nagar Vans and 200 Nagar Vatikas to create bio-diverse green spaces in urban areas. The scheme provides a grant of ₹4,00,000/- per hectare to Municipalities, Urban Local Bodies, and Institutions for afforestation and biodiversity conservation.

sub_schemes.title: Mushroom Kit Vitaran
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide subsidized mushroom kits and training to farmers, promoting mushroom cultivation as a sustainable livelihood opportunity.

sub_schemes.title: Mushroom Production
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote and support mushroom cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing mushroom, compost, and spawn production units, thereby enhancing both farmer income and overall mushroom production in Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh with the aim of conserving the environment and doubling the income of the farmers by promoting tree plantation in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana" under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aims to enhance milk productivity and per capita milk availability in Uttar Pradesh by encouraging the purchase of indigenous improved breed cows from outside the state and employment opportunities in rural areas.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy Unit, to promote self employment in the Dairy Sector.

sub_schemes.title: Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH
sub_schemes.description: The “Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH” by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Government of Jharkhand, aims to support fishermen cooperatives and enhance fish production. It provides financial aid, technical support, and welfare benefits to fishermen.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Spice Slicing machines ( nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote the adoption of Spice Slicing Machines to mechanize post-harvest processing, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the quality of spices for export.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: HRD for implementation of the proposed program: Engaging Spice Extension Trainees
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to assist the Spices Board in implementing its programmes while improving the employability of technically qualified unemployed youth belonging to SC/ST and other eligible categories by engaging them as Spice Extension Trainees.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Spice Washing Machines (nos )
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote the adoption of Spice Washing Machines to increase profitability in spice production through mechanization and improve the quality of spices for export.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: QGBG (Quality Gap Bridging Group) - Spice Producer’s Groups in Identified Clusters
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to strengthen the capacity of Spice Producer Groups (SPGs) to produce spices that meet quality, safety, and traceability standards by providing support to identified groups.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Mint distillation (nos)
sub_schemes.description: To motivate the Mint growers to set up modern field distillation units lined with Stainless steel in their fields to improve the efficiency of distillation unit as well as to improve the quality of oil for exports.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Nutmeg /clove drier (nos )
sub_schemes.description: To popularize the drying of nutmeg / clove hygienically using mechanical dryers among the farmers to produce quality nutmeg, mace and clove for exports

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement:Spice Cleaners / Graders/ Spiral gravity Separators (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote the adoption of Spice Cleaners, Graders, and Spiral Gravity Separators to increase profitability in spice production through mechanization and improve the quality of spices for domestic consumption and export.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Large Cardamom Driers (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved drying equipment, thereby enhancing the quality of large cardamom for domestic and export markets.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Large Cardamom in NE, Kalimpong & Darjeeling District (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage large cardamom growers to adopt Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for drying cardamom, thereby improving the quality of the produce and enhancing its suitability for export.

sub_schemes.title: One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)
sub_schemes.description: “One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)” by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to aid the farmers in procuring manually operated small farm implements necessary for agricultural operations.

sub_schemes.title: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery
sub_schemes.description: “Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery” by the Agriculture Dep, Government of West Bengal aims to provide opportunity to rural entrepreneurs for setting up of Custom Hiring Centres.

sub_schemes.title: E-Bhugtan Protsahan Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote e-trading and e-payment in agricultural marketing by providing cash incentives and financial benefits to farmers and traders for transactions through the e-platform (e-NAM).

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Kashtgaar Videsh Parshikshan Yatra Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance farmers’ knowledge and capacity by providing overseas exposure visits to learn advanced agricultural techniques and tools.

sub_schemes.title: Natural Death Relief (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Natural Death Relief" scheme launched by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to the kith and kin of a registered building worker in the event of the worker's natural death.

sub_schemes.title: Natural Death and Funeral Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu was launched the scheme "Natural Death and Funeral Assistance". This scheme provides financial assistance for the funeral and natural death of registered folk artistes to support their families during difficult times.

sub_schemes.title: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State
sub_schemes.description: “Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State” is a scheme by the Dept of Fisheries, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the active fishermen who contribute to the Fishermen Corpus Relief Fund, whose fishing vessels are damaged or lost due to natural calamities.

sub_schemes.title: Natural Death Relief - Telangana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is effective from 01.05.2018 and aims to support the families of deceased workers with financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to help cover funeral expenses and provide additional relief. The Telangana Government has enhanced the relief amount under the welfare scheme "Natural Death".

sub_schemes.title: Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: "Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the nominees/dependents of the members in case of natural death of the worker.

sub_schemes.title: National Youth Corps
sub_schemes.description: A volunteership scheme by Ministry of Youth Affairs And Sports to tap the potential of the disciplined and dedicated youth In the age group of 18 to 29 years who have the inclination and spirit to engage in nation building exercises, to serve up to two years in Nation Building activities.

sub_schemes.title: National Youth Award
sub_schemes.description: This award is to motivate young persons to achieve excellence in the field of national development or social service and to develop in them a sense of responsibility to the community and thus to improve their potential as good citizens.

sub_schemes.title: National Overseas Scholarship For Students With Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for regular, full-time students with disabilities to obtain higher education viz., Master's degree, or Ph.D. courses from foreign universities, in one of the specified fields of study.

sub_schemes.title: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
sub_schemes.description: A scholarship scheme by MoSJE for regular, full-time students from Scheduled Castes, Denotified Nomadic and Semi Nomadic Tribes, Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans; to obtain higher education viz., Master degree or Ph.D courses by studying abroad

sub_schemes.title: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances" is designed to give a boost to the handicraft sector in India. Assistance of upto ₹8,000/- per month is granted to the Artisans in Indigent Circumstances in the form of monthly allowance/lump sum grant/ both.

sub_schemes.title: Home for the Aged and Infirm
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Home for the Aged and Infirm" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to cater to the needs of persons who are aged/infirm, i.e. senior citizens, both male and female above the age of 60 years from BPL Family.

sub_schemes.title: Homes For Intellectually Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The "Homes for Intellectually Impaired Persons" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, Mentally Deficient Children who are in need of care and protection are admitted into shelter homes through the Child Welfare Committees.

sub_schemes.title: Home for Visually Challenged Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Home for Visually challenged Person" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to take care of the male persons who are visually impaired and who lack care and protection in society and are deprived of basic needs.

sub_schemes.title: Home for Mentally Challenged Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Home for Mentally Challenged Children" by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, aims to provide care for children facing mental challenges, i.e. low Intelligence Quotient (IQ). The scheme offers free boarding and lodging, uniform sets, daily living needs, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Hiv / Aids Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Puducherry introduced the HIV / AIDS Pension Scheme to extend a helping hand through monthly financial assistance to HIV/AIDS Affected People so that they could defray some petty personal/ medical expenses without depending on others.

sub_schemes.title: Himachal Pradesh Patrakar Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Himachal Pradesh Patrakar Kalyan Yojana" was launched by the Director of Information and Public Relations Department, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh aims to provide financial assistance to the serving accredited journalists & retired accredited journalists in adverse situations as accident.

sub_schemes.title: Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: By the labor department of Rajasthan started "Hita-Dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana" for the construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage children of workers and reduce financial burden of education through higher educational assistance. It provides ₹20,000/- for Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery admission and ₹10,000/- for other graduate courses to merit students.

sub_schemes.title: Hearing Aid Grant (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: "Hearing Aid Grant" scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry, provides ₹8,000/- for the purchase of Hearing Aid to the ESM/Widows of ESM registered with the Dept. The members of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) are not eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Haryana Divyang Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This is a State scheme under which disabled persons of Haryana domicile with a minimum 60% disability and are 18 years of age and above, are given pension as per eligibility criteria laid down in the rules of the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Haryana Gaurav Samman Scheme for Padma Awardees
sub_schemes.description: The scheme seeks to honour the exceptional achievements of citizens of Haryana who have excelled in fields of sports, arts, literature, education, public affairs, social work, science, technology, medicine, industry and other domains of public life.

sub_schemes.title: Haryana Shubhra Jyotsna Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Haryana Shubhra Jyotsna Pension Scheme” was launched by the General Administration Department, Government of Haryana on 16th April 2018.

sub_schemes.title: Handloom Rebate Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides 10% special rebate for 120 festival days; Additional 5-15% permanent rebates for regular sales; Enhanced 20% rebates for women-led cooperatives. The scheme aims to enhance market competitiveness for Gujarat's handloom cooperatives and apex societies.

sub_schemes.title: Handicraft Rebate Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides 5–20% rebates on sales of handicraft goods to cooperatives, with higher incentives for women-led groups and during festivals. Applications are submitted online via e-Kutir.

sub_schemes.title: Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Handicapped Students Stipend Mizoram
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, provide financial support to differently-abled students for purchasing essential items like books and uniforms. Students enrolled in both government and private schools are eligible to receive a monthly stipend.

sub_schemes.title: Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme For Coir Workers
sub_schemes.description: A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for coir workers. The scheme provides insurance cover against accidental death and permanent disability of the insured member.

sub_schemes.title: Griha Aadhar Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Griha Aadhar Scheme" addresses the problem of spiralling prices and provides support to the housewives/homemakers from the middle, lower-middle and poor sections of society, to maintain a reasonable standard of living for their families.

sub_schemes.title: Griha Lakshmi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Griha Lakshmi" aims to provide financial assistance to women heads of households in Karnataka. The scheme offers a monthly benefit of ₹2,000/- to eligible women, helping them manage household expenses and improve their economic stability.

sub_schemes.title: Green Business Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Green Business Scheme has been launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for activities that can tackle the impacts of climate change and also be income-generating.

sub_schemes.title: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) - "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to establish professional, well-trained, motivated and adequately equipped workforce for maintenance and management of sewers and septic tanks, addressing the critical need to eliminate fatalities resulting from workers entering sewers and septic tanks without proper safety measures.

sub_schemes.title: National Action Plan for Skill Development of Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: A dedicated skill development program aimed at providing high-quality vocational training with a focus on PwDs. The objective is to enhance the skills of PwDs by providing quality vocational skill training, enabling them to gain meaningful employment and become contributing members of society.

sub_schemes.title: Nashamukt Gram Panchayat Puraskar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to incentivize and recognize Gram Panchayats that demonstrate outstanding work towards de-addiction, ensuring 100% of their population lives a drug-free life. The scheme provides the benefit of a cash award of ₹1,00,000/- and a Certificate of Appreciation to Gram Panchayat.

sub_schemes.title: Nari Adalat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide an alternative grievance redressal mechanism for women at the grassroots level through mediation, counselling, and awareness of rights and entitlements.

sub_schemes.title: Nandaa Gaura Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for upto 2 girls in a family. Assistance is given in 2 installments per girl child: 1st installment of ₹11,000 is provided at the time of birth if girl is born in a hospital/ANM center & 2nd installment of ₹51,000 is given when girl passes Class 12th.

sub_schemes.title: Nalanda Award
sub_schemes.description: The "Nalanda Award" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, recognizes organizations for exceptional work in the field of social welfare, particularly for the socially and educationally disadvantaged sections.

sub_schemes.title: NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme" is one of the five sub-schemes of the National Social Assistance Programme. Under IGNOAPS, citizens living Below Poverty Line and 60 years or above in age are eligible to apply. A monthly pension of ₹ 200 up to 79 years and ₹ 500 thereafter.

sub_schemes.title: NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME” is an initiative by the Govt. of West Bengal which envisages the construction of multi-storied Lower Income Group (LIG)/Middle Income Group (MIG) flats on the public lands belonging to the State Government, local bodies and parastatals.

sub_schemes.title: NEW SWARNIMA (Gopalak Nigam)
sub_schemes.description: Self-employment loan scheme for Rabari and Bharwad women in Gujarat, offering up to ₹2 lakh at 5% annual interest to promote economic independence.

sub_schemes.title: NBCFDC General Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A general loan scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice for Indian citizens from backward classes for various income-generating activities. Loan up to ₹15 Lakh per beneficiary for pursuing income-generating activities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukh‍yamantri Janakal‍yaan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Asangathit Karmakaar Man‍da)
sub_schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana is a initiative of Madhya Pradesh government. The scheme will provide much-needed social security to unorganized workers in the state and help them live a dignified life.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Annadoot Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to unemployed youth/women for 7 years by involving them in the transport of food grains from Madhya Pradesh State Civil Supplies Corporation centers to fair price shops. Benefits include an interest subsidy/grant.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojna” is an old-age pension scheme implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Bihar to provide financial assistance to elderly citizens. Under the scheme, a monthly pension is given to individuals who are aged 60 years or above.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of senior citizens residing in the state by providing them with monthly financial assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana" (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Pratibha Yojna
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is to provide scholarships to the students studying in classes 9th to 12th for enabling them to bear the expenses required for their studies.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial grants for the construction of houses to economically weak widows and single women.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Religious Trusts and Endowments, Government of Madhya Pradesh in June 2012.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sukh Ashray Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive care, education, and support to orphans, abandoned children, specially-abled individuals, destitute women, and senior citizens, recognizing them as “children of the state” and ensuring their holistic development.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana" for construction worker on 12 May 2022.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Marriage of Poor Brides Living Below Poverty Line
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to poor brides living below the poverty line to meet their marriage expenses. The assistance amount is ₹25,000, and it is granted for the first marriage of the bride. The scheme is implemented through the Department of Women and Child Development.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools” by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides one-time reimbursement to each registered beneficiary of the Board for purchasing tools.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for the Marriage of Daughter of Destitute Widow
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per daughter for the marriage of up to two daughters of destitute widows who are receiving widow pension and whose total monthly income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/-, or who belong to BPL families.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for Marriage of Daughters of Scheduled Caste Individuals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a grant of ₹50,000/- per daughter to Scheduled Caste families, for a maximum of two daughters, whose total monthly family income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/- or who belong to a BPL family, to help cover marriage expenses.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for Purchase of Bicycle (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹3,500/- is provided to registered construction workers who have been members of the Board for at least one year, for purchasing a bicycle.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- is provided for the purchase of individual aids, which may be increased to a maximum of ₹7,000/- in special cases. Additionally, ₹500/- is provided for the repair of prosthetic limbs and other assistive equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Grant Of Financial Assistance For The Funeral Expenses Of Old Age/ Destitute Pensioner
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Grant Of Financial Assistance For The Funeral Expenses Of Old Age/Destitute Pensioner Scheme to extend a helping hand by way of monthly financial assistance to Old Age/Destitute Pensioners.

sub_schemes.title: Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons
sub_schemes.description: “Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons” by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry supports marriages between differently-abled individuals and those without disabilities. An incentive of ₹1,00,000/- is provided (₹20,000 as cash, and ₹80 as NSC).

sub_schemes.title: Grant For Purchase Of Tools (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant for Purchase of Tools (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home
sub_schemes.description: The "Grant in Aid to Old Age Home" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, grants are provided to the NGOs for accommodating old men & women, destitute, disabled victims, into Old Age Homes, and providing them with food, & accommodation.

sub_schemes.title: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
sub_schemes.description: The food bill assistance at the rate of ₹1,500/- per month (Up to 10 Months) will be granted to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students admitted in college-affiliated hostels.

sub_schemes.title: Food Bill Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The "Food Bill Assistance" scheme provides financial support to non-reserved category students pursuing graduate-level medical, dental, technical, and para-medical courses.

sub_schemes.title: Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give fitter training to the hearing-impaired candidates at the ITI, Guindy for two years and a stipend of ₹300 per month.

sub_schemes.title: First Self Marriage Expenses
sub_schemes.description: The Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board implemented the "First Self Marriage Expenses" scheme. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹30,000/- towards the first self marriage expenses to the registered worker.

sub_schemes.title: Honorarium for Pradhan Samajpatis of Indigenous Tribal Community
sub_schemes.description: “Honorarium for Pradhan Samajpatis of Indigenous Tribal Community" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Govt. of Tripura on 1st July 2021 to provide financial assistance to to the Pradhan Samajpatis (Chief Community Headman) of indigenous tribal community.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, hostel facilities for free accommodation and meals shall be provided to the children of migrant construction workers in primary school. The aim of the scheme is to provide primary, secondary, and higher education to the children of migrant construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Hospitalisation Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana financial assistance is provided to construction workers who suffer temporary disabilities due to accidents or diseases & hospitalized for five or more days.

sub_schemes.title: Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
sub_schemes.description: The 'Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute goggles to needy visually impaired persons to enable them to protect themselves from sunlight.

sub_schemes.title: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers" by the Home Department, Government of Goa, provides financial assistance in the form of a Gross Pension of ₹ 2,500/- per month to the beneficiaries. The applicant should be a retired seaman. The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above.

sub_schemes.title: Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants And Awards Scheme
sub_schemes.description: GVMCCGS awards the Panchayats / Municipal Local Bodies to discuss and resolve the issues relating to children. The winner is awarded an annual financial grant of ₹ 10,000/- towards administrative expenses incurred on organizing the activities of the Committee.

sub_schemes.title: Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to traditional bakers (poders) in Goa to ensure the protection and growth of this traditional occupation. Subsidies for the purchase of flour are provided to traditional bakers who produce essential Goan breads.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" aims to improve the welfare of working journalists retired from service in Goa and their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family pension benefits for eligible journalists and their dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed to envisage grant of awards for one meritorious Library and one Librarian serving either in any Government or Government–aided Libraries in the State of Goa, which includes the Public/Academic/Special/Research Libraries.

sub_schemes.title: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of electric two-wheelers to construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.

sub_schemes.title: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.

sub_schemes.title: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.

sub_schemes.title: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage Labourers/Industrial Workers to purchase of battery operated electric two-wheelers that reduce carbon emissions.

sub_schemes.title: Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a grant of ₹20,00,000–₹12,000 and a monthly allowance of ₹5,000–₹1,500 to gallantry awardees as a mark of honor and recognition for their valor.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to cover 90% of estimated maintenance cost for the registered NGOs running residential homes for children, aged, and vulnerable.....

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence
sub_schemes.description: “Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence" was launched by Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. NGOs are paid ₹ 500/- per month per inmates, in two equal installments, for 12 months.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-In-Aid to Voluntary Organizations Working In The Area of ​​Disabled Welfare
sub_schemes.description: "Grant-in-aid to Voluntary Organizations Working in the Area of Disabled Welfare" aims to support institutions working for the welfare of disabled individuals. Grants for free education, training, residential arrangements, and rehabilitation are provided to disabled immigrants.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)
sub_schemes.description: The SWAWLAMBHAN Scheme by the Govt. of Goa provides financial assistance to Mahila Mandals/Self-Help Groups for training/orientation for members of the Mahila Mandal/Self-Help Groups for generating their own activity for self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. In this scheme, a fixed sum ₹ 300/- per month shall be paid as Transport Allowance to the differently abled individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees
sub_schemes.description: "Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees" by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry was introduced to provide financial assistance to differently abled individuals undergoing technical or professional training. The objective is to enable them to successfully complete their training.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Stipend to the Differently Abled Trainees of the Vocational Training Institutes
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, the differently abled persons undergoing any technical or professional training through Institutes are paid a fixed monthly stipend which will enable them to secure the training successfully in order to make their own earnings and become useful members of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students
sub_schemes.description: "Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students" scheme aims to improve the educational status of handicapped children studying in standards 1st to 10th. Monthly stipends (₹200 to ₹300) are provided to parents who are unable to send their children to school due to economic reasons.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to provide Financial Assistance of ₹ 2,500/- to the Bridegroom from Weaker Section.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to provide financial support to widows for the marriage of their daughters. Eligible widows can receive ₹25,000/- to cover marriage expenses. The scheme is implemented through the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses
sub_schemes.description: “Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to motivate the Scheduled Caste people to keep their houses neat and tidy. Incentives are in the form of household articles worth ₹500/-.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to create awareness among parents about the desirability of the girl child and elevate the status of the girl child in the family. The scheme provides an amount of ₹30,000/- deposited in the name of the girl child, and in the case of two girl children, ₹15,000/- is deposited.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was introduced to promote small family norms, uplift the welfare of girl children, and ease the financial burden on parents during their daughter's marriage. The scheme provides ₹25,000/- financial assistance for single girl children studying in 8th to 10th standard.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided house construction subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, an incentive of ₹2,00,000/- is provided, comprising ₹40,000 in cash and ₹1,60,000/- in the form of a National Savings Certificate (NSC), for the marriage between differently-abled individuals. The selection is periodical and depends on the availability of funds.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide a subsidy of upto 50 % of the cost of fuel to persons with disability who own motorised vehicles.

sub_schemes.title: Grant in Case of Death Due to Disaster
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families/dependents of individuals who lose their lives due to any disaster. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹4,00,000/- is given as ex-gratia to support the affected families.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry" by the Department of Information & Publicity, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to provide financial support amounting to ₹25,000/- to eligible press reporters who have served in registered Newspapers/Magazines.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disability to maintain their minimum standard of living.

sub_schemes.title: Grant In Aid Hostels
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities to tribal students who wish to pursue primary, secondary and higher secondary education. Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to intended beneficiaries who are students studying in standards 5th to 12th.

sub_schemes.title: Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded,Chennai' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, children with intellectual disability are given special education, vocational training, food, uniforms etc.

sub_schemes.title: Government Working Women’s Hostel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Government Working Women’s Hostel" is an initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide safe accommodation facilities to working women who live far away from their families, belonging to lower and middle-income groups.

sub_schemes.title: Gomant Vibhushan Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Gomant Vibhushan Award" has been designed in order to honour and recognize the Goan renowned personalities who have contributed to the distinguished and extraordinary achievements/ services in any field of activities/disciplines such as art & culture, literature & education, sports, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Government Institutions for Teaching and Training of Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to arrange for education and rehabilitation of children with disabilities by providing them free hostel, education-training, food, clothing and residential facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Government Hostel for Working Women/ Girl Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide suitable, inexpensive, and safe accommodation to women employed in government offices, organizations, and firms, as well as girl students studying in colleges. Essential facilities include a cot with mattress, lockable cupboards, television, newspapers, magazines, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Government Service Home" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide institutional care to widows, destitute women, deserted women, adolescent girls and differently-abled women and their children.

sub_schemes.title: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, was introduced to facilitate the education and self-confidence development of visually impaired and hearing-impaired children.

sub_schemes.title: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The “Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana” was launched by the Information & Public Relations Department, Govt. of Odisha. It is a health insurance scheme that covers the medical expenses of the journalists and their eligible family members.

sub_schemes.title: Good Samaritan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 3rd Oct 2021 by the MoRTH, the scheme grants an award to the good samaritan who has saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident (involving a motor vehicle) by administering immediate assistance and rushing to the Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident.

sub_schemes.title: Issuance of Free House Sites
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides free residential land sites to eligible individuals from the Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) who do not own a house or land, helping them secure housing stability.

sub_schemes.title: Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The scheme provides free bus passes to all the differently abled persons to facilitate their mobility/transport in buses run by the Government and NGOs.

sub_schemes.title: Interim Relief to the Beneficiaries Affected by Disaster (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Through "Interim Relief to the Beneficiaries Affected by Disaster (GBOCWWB)" , the beneficiaries of the Board who are affected by disasters, catastrophes or natural calamities are extended immediate relief of up to ₹10,00,000/-. This shall include cash payment to beneficiaries of the affected area.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Free Loan (CBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, interest free loan shall be granted to the registered construction workers of the Board for the purchase of items like Fridge, Television/ LCD, Motor Cycle/Scooter, Cooler, Fan & Bicycle.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Help Scheme For Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate
sub_schemes.description: The "Interest Help Scheme for Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate" aims to provide financial assistance in the form of interest subsidy on loans to the non-reserved category professionals in Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Inter-Caste Marriage Award
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to eliminate the practice of untouchability by encouraging marriages between the Scheduled Castes and other castes, under which an incentive of ₹50,000/- or an amount as decided by the Government from time to time is awarded.

sub_schemes.title: Inter-Caste / Inter-Religious Marriage Award
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- is provided to married couples where, in the case of an inter-caste marriage, one spouse belongs to a Scheduled Caste, and in the case of an inter-religious marriage, both spouses belong to different religions.

sub_schemes.title: Inter-state Border Areas Development Programme
sub_schemes.description: The aims and objectives of the Inter-State Border Areas Development Programme ISBADP are to provide facilities for the socioeconomic development of the people living along the Inter-State boundary with Assam.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Old Age Pension
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, pension is provided to old aged persons males (60 years & above) and females (55 and above) and who are destitute in the sense of having no means of subsistence from their own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Pension for Women in Distress
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Social and Tribal Welfare Department, Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Under this scheme, a financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month is provided as a pension to destitute widows, divorced, or deserted women with no source of income.

sub_schemes.title: General Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a pension shall be given to a registered beneficiary working as a building worker for not less than one year after the commencement of the Rules on completion of sixty years of age.

sub_schemes.title: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
sub_schemes.description: The aims to provide shelter, protection, rehabilitation, livelihood opportunities, and social reintegration support to transgender persons. It also provides shelter facilities, food, medical care, counselling, legal assistance, skill development, and document support to transgender persons.

sub_schemes.title: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme supports remarried women who are beneficiaries of the Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme, aiming to reintegrate them into society with financial support.

sub_schemes.title: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to widowed women, ensuring self-reliance through monthly pensions.

sub_schemes.title: Gallantry Medal – PMG/GM
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to honour exceptional and conspicuous acts of gallantry. Through this scheme, medals, a Presidential scroll, and monthly monetary allowances are provided to eligible service personnel.

sub_schemes.title: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students" by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa aims to provide additional financial assistance to OBC (Dhangar) students to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance.

sub_schemes.title: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students" aims to provide additional financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance. Additional monthly allowances are provided to meet food, travel, and disability-related expenses.

sub_schemes.title: GST Exemption Certificate Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "GST Exemption Certificate Scheme" has been introduced by the Dept. of Heavy Industries, for issuing certificates to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) having a disability percentage equal to or greater than 40%. The scheme provides GSC Concession to orthopedically disabled persons on purchase of car.

sub_schemes.title: Funeral Financial Assistant (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Funeral Financial Assistant” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The “Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for funeral expenses to the nominees of a deceased registered member.

sub_schemes.title: Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to intensely examine the implementation of schemes at the ground level and monitor scheme outputs and outcomes to ensure the quality of services being provided under these schemes. The scheme component provides for physical inspection of every scheme of the Ministry.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme - Sikkim
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)” by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim provides financial support is provided to the poor widows of the state of Sikkim. The beneficiary receives a monthly pension of ₹ 2000/- through DBT.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹500/- is provided to widows aged 40 to 79 years who are living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme-Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme is being operated to provide financial support to widowed women living below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi Shehri Credit Card Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Indira Gandhi Urban Credit Card Scheme-2021 is implemented to provide employment / self-employment opportunities in urban areas and to provide financial resources for everyday needs.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Bihar
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹400/- is provided to widows in the age group of 40 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana" is an initiative by the Himachal Pradesh government. The scheme recognizes the significant contributions of women in household work, cultural preservation, and family economy by providing a monthly assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: 'Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Dept, Tamil Nadu. A pension of ₹1,000 is provided to destitute widows who are 40 years and above in age and belong to households below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Punjab)
sub_schemes.description: "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)" provides a pension of ₹300/- per month to widows aged 40 years and above. After attaining the age of 80 years, the pension amount increases to ₹500/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)" is a scheme by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept, Govt of Maharashtra. In this scheme, widows aged 40 to 79 years who are from a BPL family receive a pension of ₹1500/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the scheme "National Social Assistance Programme" is a welfare scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. It provides monthly financial aid of ₹1,000/- to widows aged 40 years and above who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A non-contributory pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL) of the society.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to the citizens whose families live below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Special Ability Pension
sub_schemes.description: National Disability Pension Scheme is a government scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to specially-abled individuals residing in India.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to elderly people aged 60 years and above living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme- Bihar
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension is provided to elderly people (women/men) aged 60 years or above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Sikkim
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)” was started by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim in 2014. Under this scheme, a pension is provided to elderly citizens above the age of 60 years belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, persons aged between 60 and 79 years receive a pension of ₹200/- per month, while those aged 80 years and above receive ₹500/- per month. The scheme applies only to persons belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme -Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. A pension of ₹1,000 is provided to destitute old age persons of 60 years and above belonging to households below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension" is a social welfare scheme by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra. In this scheme, ₹600 per month is provided to elderly individuals aged 65 years and above from BPL families.

sub_schemes.title: Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows
sub_schemes.description: The Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu launched the "Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows" scheme to supply notebooks to children of poor widows studying up to higher secondary courses and govt. children homes and service homes.

sub_schemes.title: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, 10 kg of free rice is supplied to poor people through fair-price shops during natural calamities and on two important festive occasions every year. The beneficiaries are identified based on the data from the Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department in Puducherry.

sub_schemes.title: Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities”, who are facing the mainstream of society due to their disabilities are provided motorized tricycles free of cost to those unable to connect.

sub_schemes.title: Journalist's Medical Welfare Scheme - Assam
sub_schemes.description: The Journalist's Medical Welfare Scheme was first implemented in 2012 by the Government of Assam. Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the accredited and recognized journalists of Assam for their medical treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Journalists’ Family Benefit Fund
sub_schemes.description: The Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department scheme was launched by the "Journalists’ Family Benefit Fund". The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to families of journalists who died in harness with a minimum of 20 years of service as editor, sub-editor, reporter.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme (JSFSS)" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to ensure food security by providing subsidized/free rice to eligible Green Card holders.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme" aims to identify and support migrant workers from the state. The scheme ensures social security, rehabilitation, and welfare for migrant workers and their families.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali
sub_schemes.description: The "Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali" aims to provide financial assistance to journalists who have served the state for an extended period. It ensures their well-being post-retirement and acknowledges their contribution to media and society.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide a petrol subsidy of ₹250 per month for two-wheelers to eligible NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana" is a 100% State Sponsored scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides social security to all registered workers in the age group of 18-60 years.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹500/- is provided to severely disabled (with a disability of 80% and above) and multi-disabled individuals aged 18 to 79 years who are living below the poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)
sub_schemes.description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" provides ₹300/- per month to disabled persons (80% or more disability) aged 18 and above. After age 80, the amount increases to ₹500/-. Dwarfs are also eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Indian Community Welfare Fund
sub_schemes.description: A scheme by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for the welfare of Overseas Indians; assisting them in distress situations. ICWF has also been a critical support in emergency evacuation of Indian nationals from conflict zones, countries affected by natural disasters and other challenging situations.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive to Widow's Remarriage
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to encourage and support widows to remarry and lead a normal life in society. Through this scheme, eligible individuals receive financial assistance of ₹50,000/- in the form of a National Saving Certificate. The bridegroom should be a bachelor or a widower.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive given to Encourage Inter caste Marriages
sub_schemes.description: The "Incentive for Encouraging Inter-Caste Marriages" scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra, and funded jointly by the State and Central Government (50:50). The scheme provides financial incentives to support inter-caste marriages.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive for Purchase of Electric Scooter for the Daughter of a Registered Construction Worker (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, an incentive of ₹50,000/- or the actual ex-showroom price of electric scooter, whichever is lower, will be provided by the Board through e-RUPI to the daughter of a registered construction worker to facilitate her mobility while pursuing higher education.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive for the Inter Caste Marriage Couple
sub_schemes.description: The Social Welfare Department of the Government of Karnataka has launched the "Incentive for the Inter Caste Marriage Couple", which offers incentives to couples belonging to the SC community and Non-SC. The scheme aims to promote inter-caste marriages and provide financial assistance to the couples

sub_schemes.title: Incentive for the SC Widow Re-Marriage
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka gives incentives to the remarried widows belonging to SC Community. The incentive amount is ₹ 3 Lakh.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive for the Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Caste Community
sub_schemes.description: The Karnataka Social Welfare Department provides an incentive to promote intra-caste marriages within different sub-castes of Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST).

sub_schemes.title: Incentive for Inter-Caste Marriage Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Incentive For Inter Caste Marriage" aims to promote inter-caste marriages between SC and non-SC communities to combat casteism. The scheme provides a financial incentive of ₹50,000/- to eligible couples, with either spouse being a permanent resident of NCT of Delhi.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Pension to Physically Challenged Persons
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is provided to poor physically handicapped persons (including those who are blind, deaf, or dumb) with a degree of disability 40% or above and having no source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Pension For Transgender
sub_schemes.description: ISSS (Integrated Social Security Scheme) is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir where financial assistance is provided to Old Age Persons, Widows, Divorcees, Women in Distress, Transgenders, and Physically Handicapped Persons.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Women In Distress
sub_schemes.description: ISSS (Integrated Social Security Scheme) is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir where financial assistance is provided to Old Age Persons, Widows, Divorcees, Women in Distress, Transgenders, and Physically Handicapped Persons.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka will give incentives of ₹3.00 lakh for men,₹5.00 lakh for women to the Devadasi's Children who are Married Couples.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Award For Marriage With Disabled Person
sub_schemes.description: "Incentive Award for Marriage with Disabled Person" is a Grant by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, incentive is granted to a person who marries a Person with Disability. This is a State Sponsored Scheme. Only the citizens who are domicile of Manipur can apply.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Award to Inter-Caste Married Couples
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Incentive Award to Inter-Caste Married Couples” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to reduce the effect of untouchability and as a step towards bringing about a casteless society.

sub_schemes.title: Immediate Assistance for Severe Injury in Road/Fire Accident (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: "Immediate Assistance for Severe Injury in Road/Fire Accident" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, ₹25,000/- is provided to the registered Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen who have suffered a Road/Fire Accident.

sub_schemes.title: Immediate Assistance in Case of Accident to the Beneficiary
sub_schemes.description: The "Immediate Assistance in Case of Accident to the Beneficiary" scheme was launched by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board & aims to provide financial assistance to registered building workers and their families in case of worker accidents, disabilities, or death.

sub_schemes.title: Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme" by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Kerala, aims to improve the basic facilities of houses belonging to widowed, divorced, or abandoned women from minority religious communities.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Rural)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to widows, irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute weavers aged 50 years or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to destitute weavers who are 50 years or above in age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to widows irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: IMA Nongthangleima Yaipha Tengbang Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Ima Nongthangleima Yaipha Tengbang Scheme" provides support to approximately 4 lakh women in Manipur who are above the age of 40 years. The scheme aims to empower these women by offering crucial financial assistance, thereby aiding them in pursuing diverse livelihood options.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to persons with disabilities of 40% or above who are 18 years of age or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of Andhra Pradesh, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute elderly persons aged 65 years or above with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)" aims to disburse monthly pensions to old age citizens, both male and female, who are 65 years of age or above and are destitute (with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon). To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family.

sub_schemes.title: INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)
sub_schemes.description: "INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to the individuals 18 years or above in age and having a disability of 40% or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
sub_schemes.description: The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times.

sub_schemes.title: Housing Assistance Grant
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial support to widows/dependents of soldiers martyred in wars and border clashes, as well as to war-disabled retired soldiers. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time grant of ₹2 lakhs for the construction or repair of a house during their lifetime.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang
sub_schemes.description: "Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang" is a Social Welfare Scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Manipur. The scheme provides Free Travel & Concession to the Persons with Disabilities. All the PwDs who are a domicile of the State of Manipur are eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: "CMST: Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the Students with Disability who are a domicile of the State of Manipur, and are studying in Class 1st and and above are awarded with scholarship of upto ₹ 8,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT): Support For Purchase Of Instruments / Equipment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "CMAT: Support for Purchase of Instruments / Equipment" aims to support many talented students and budding artistes, who are economically well but in need of instruments/equipment for their learning and performance purpose to help them groom towards professionalism.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme" is a pension scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
