The scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to Below Poverty Line (BPL) individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 1st April 2009, the scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme" is a pension scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt of Madhya Pradesh. In this scheme, a pension of ₹600/- is provided to differently-abled individuals from 'Below Poverty Line'.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Bihar
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹400/- is provided to persons with disabilities in the age group of 18 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)” was started by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim in 2014. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to differently-abled persons with severe or multiple disabilities of more than 80%.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension is provided to severely disabled and multi-disabled individuals aged 18 and above who are living below the poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)" is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept., Govt. of Maharashtra. The differently-abled individuals aged 18 to 65 years with a disability of 80% and above are eligible to receive a pension of ₹600/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme"is a pension scheme by the Department Of Social Welfare Jammu and Kashmir. In this scheme, a pension of ₹1000/- is provided to differently-abled individuals from 'Below Poverty Line'.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide social security pensions to divyangjans aged 18 and above who belong to a poor family (BPL) in society.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme' is a state initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. Its goal is to offer a ₹1,000 pension to individuals aged 18 and above. Eligibility criteria include a disability percentage of 80% or above.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
sub_schemes.description: The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme in Civil Service (Chhattisgarh)
sub_schemes.description: "Incentive Scheme in Civil Service" aims to encourage bright and meritorious persons with disabilities to pass competitive exams in the field of civil services. Financial support is provided on passing the different stages of the Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Exams.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for Marrying a Disabled Young Man/Woman
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to couples on marriage, where at least one partner has 40% or more disability and marries a non-disabled person, or where both partners have disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Policy for Setting Up Community Radio Stations - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment and operation of community radio stations across the state, particularly in disaster-prone and remote areas, to strengthen community-level communication, awareness, and disaster preparedness.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands
sub_schemes.description: "Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands" aims to reduce power consumption through demand side management and promote green energy adoption. The scheme offers monetary incentives to consumers who achieve at least 30% energy savings.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance per year to parents whose daughters are employed in the Indian Armed Forces.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Inter Caste Marriage Couple (Scheduled Tribe)
sub_schemes.description: The "Incentive for Inter Caste Marriage Couple" scheme was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Karnataka. The scheme provides incentives to the couple in which one spouse is from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) and the other spouse is non-ST. An incentive of ₹5,50,000/- is provided to the couple.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Simple Marriage (Scheduled Tribe)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Incentive for the Simple Marriage" was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka. The scheme provides an incentive of ₹50,000/- to ST individuals residing in Karnataka who marry another ST individual on or after 11th August 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Simple Marriage
sub_schemes.description: The Social Welfare Department of the Government of Karnataka has launched the Simple Marriage scheme, which offers incentives to couples belonging to the SC community. The scheme aims to promote the idea of simple marriages and provide financial assistance to eligible couples.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Incentive for the Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe" by the Govt of Karnataka provides incentives for the marriage of Devadasi's ST children. Couples married on or after 01-04-2019 are given an incentive of ₹8 Lakh, i.e. ₹3 Lakh for groom and ₹5 Lakh for bride.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For Eye Donors
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Incentive For Eye Donors” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to create awareness among the public about the eye donation and to pay an amount of incentive to the donors of eye. In this scheme, an amount ₹ 10,000/- per beneficiary is provided.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance To The Cultural Group For Training With New Production
sub_schemes.description: "CMAT - Assistance to the Cultural Group for Training with New Production" by the Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Manipur aims at providing financial assistance to registered cultural groups that have been relentlessly working on providing training to the younger generation with new products.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Scheme Of Festival Assistance For Participating In International & National Festival
sub_schemes.description: Through the scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT)-Scheme of Festival Assistance for Participating in International & National Festival", the artists will be extended a sum of financial assistance to meet their travel costs and journey costs to participate in International Festivals.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme For Award To Distinguished Artistes
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "CMAT - Scheme for Award to Distinguished Artistes" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Govt. of Manipur, to encourage and felicitate the artistes (in the field of culture) belonging to different fields for their achievements such as winning National Awards namely Padma Award, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension" by the Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Manipur provides a monthly pension of up to ₹ 4,000/- to the aged reputed artists who have contributed to making the tradition, culture, and art forms of Manipur more vibrant.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme (CMDPS)” was started by the Women & Child Welfare Department, Govt. of Sikkim to provide financial assistance to the differently abled person who has a disability of 40% and above.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yoiana 2017
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has decided to implement the Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yojana 2017 for creating model villages in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The guidelines of the "Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme" were approved by the Dept. of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The COVID-19 Pandemic and the resulting economic dislocations have severely affected the livelihood of a large percentage of the population.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial assistance to elderly small and marginal farmers.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Specially Abled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The State government of Bihar Started the "Chief Minister Nari Shakti Yojana" scheme with the aim of improving the lives of Disable persons. Financial assistance is provided by the government through these schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
sub_schemes.description: In 2023, Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana" for women empowerment

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Kanya Utthan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: A Scheme Chief Minister Kanya Utthan Yojana started under the Social Welfare Department by Bihar State Government for the social empowerment of females.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹500/- to senior citizens, widows, and abandoned women listed on the basis of the survey list of Social, Economic and Caste Census 2011 in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Grants in Aid to SC/ST patients suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases” was launched by the Government of Assam in 2017 to provide financial assistance in the form of grants in Aid to SC/ST patients who are suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance under Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme” was launched by the Information & Public Relations Department, Government of Odisha. Under the Scheme, financial assistance is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death, and in case of permanent incapacitation.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the disabled (blind, mentally retarded, mute and deaf) children of registered workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Unmarried
sub_schemes.description: The aim of the scheme is to provide Social Security to Unmarried Persons who are unable to sustain themselves from their own sources and are in need of financial assistance from the State.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to the Recipients of the Service Medal by the Government of Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to honor medal-winning defense personnel who are permanent residents of the state by providing them with financial support and benefits for their distinguished service.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Widower
sub_schemes.description: The aim of the scheme is to provide Social Security to Widowers who are unable to sustain themselves from their own sources and are in need of financial assistance from the State.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- is given to the widow or dependent of the worker working in the industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana state in case of his death due to any reason.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to grant financial assistance to the family of the temple employee who expires while in service. The scheme provides an amount of ₹5,000/- under the Group Insurance Scheme and an amount of ₹20,000/- under the Chief Minister’s Welfare Fund. The applications are accepted offline.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers(JKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers” is administered by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Jammu and Kashmir. In this scheme, ₹2,00,000/- is provided to the dependents in case of the death of the registered worker.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to War Widows of Defence Forces
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month shall be granted to War Widows of Defence Force Personnel’s (Army, Navy & Air Force) who were killed in action during declared war of 1962, 1965 & 1971 in addition to family pension already getting from Government of India.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries
sub_schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered member or their children studying Higher Secondary and above.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to fund the pre-matric and post-matric education of wards belonging to specific mine, beedi, and cine workers. It provides annual scholarships between ₹1,000/- and ₹25,000/- based on the student's academic level and course type.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18
sub_schemes.description: The Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18 scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a fixed deposit of ₹1,00,000/- for each female child of a registered worker or spouse who has undergone a family planning operation after the birth of one female child.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹51,000/- per marriage for the marriage of registered construction workers themselves or for the marriage of up to two daughters.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Cremation (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for artificial limbs upto rates fixed by Saket Hospital, Chandimandir(Panchkula). This assistance is available to workers employed in industrial &commercial units in Haryana and their dependents, who become disabled due to the loss of vital organs.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was started by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB), Labour Department, Government of Haryana on 15.01.2019. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- will be provided as Shagun for the marriage of workers' sons and unmarried male workers themselves.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Women And Girl Acid Attack Victims
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Women and Girls Acid Attack Victims” by the Govt. of Haryana, provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the women/girls residing in Haryana who have suffered disfigurement of any part of the body or have become disabled due to acid attack.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide 50% reimbursement of interest on home loans up to ₹1,00,000 for eligible war widows, war bereaved families, war disabled personnel, and attributable peacetime casualties.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance for the physical & psychological rehabilitation of child victims of communal, caste, ethnic & terrorist violence with special reference to their care, education & training, besides promoting communal harmony,

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
sub_schemes.description: Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Visually Impaired Advocates
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to visually impaired Advocates” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Self-Employment For Trained Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance to Self-Employment for Trained Disabled Persons" is a scheme by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to facilitate the purchase of equipment for those disabled persons who are completing their vocational training.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana during the years 2008-09.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
sub_schemes.description: "Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Through the “Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme” by the Dept of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of Haryana, financial assistance of ₹1,250/- per month per family member is provided for five years to the Kashmiri families which have migrated from J&K to Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Institutions/Societies Belonging To Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Institutions/Societies Belonging to Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Gad-Hanjis
sub_schemes.description: In the "Financial Assistance to Gad-Hanjis", financial assistance for the purchase of Nylon Twine is provided to the Licensed Fisherman by the Social Welfare Department. The beneficiary shall approach the concerned District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) for submission of the application.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Ex-Convicts
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Ex-Convicts” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. This scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice to help those released from jail from poor economic conditions to find their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to facilitate the self-employment of unemployed disabled persons. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities for self-employment, small-scale business, and agro-based project. This scheme is 100% funded by Govt. of Maharashtra.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme was launched on in the year 1986. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the scheduled castes to purchase agricultural land, with a maximum limit of 2 acres, for self-cultivation.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Destitute Children Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Destitute Children Scheme (FADCS)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana in the year 1984.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Financial Assistance To Dependent Children of Widows And Destitute Women" is a Social Welfare scheme by the Dept. of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Govt. of Chandigarh; to extend financial assistance (₹ 1000/- per month per child) to children who are fatherless or orphan.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Dairy Farmers Belonging To Scheduled Tribes And Scheduled Caste For Purchase Of Basic Dairy Equipments
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste communities for the purchase of basic dairy equipments needed to run a small scale dairy farming, and to encourage the tribal population to adopt Animal Husbandry activities, especially Dairy Development Schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance Scheme for Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to journalists and litterateurs for the treatment of critical illnesses, medical emergencies and no source of income, unemployment, or advanced age.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For The Marriage Of Daughters Of Poor Widows And Orphan Girls
sub_schemes.description: This is a welfare scheme by the GNCTD to provide financial assistance to poor widows for performing the marriage of their daughters and to provide financial assistance to the guardians including Homes/Institutions or foster parents of an orphan girl or an orphan girl for her marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the dependents of deceased journalists and litterateurs in situations such as medical emergencies, unemployment, or when there is no other source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance Scheme for Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination to Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For Marriage (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Marriage” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance On Marriage Of Children (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance on Marriage of Children (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
sub_schemes.description: Welfare scheme of Department For The Welfare Of SC/ST/OBC’s/Minorities to provide help for purchase of stationery to SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students of 1st to 12th class studying Govt. of India/GNCT of Delhi/Aided Recognized schools.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance After Death (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2 lakh in case of natural death and ₹4 lakh in case of accidental death to the dependents of registered construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For Aids And Appliances For Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance for Aids and Appliances for Disabled Persons" is a scheme by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to provide assistance to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) for the purchase of aids and appliances as per their age group and the type of disability.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance (Kanyadaan) on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter- Haryana Silicosis Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000/- is provided to workers suffering from silicosis, as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana, for the marriage of up to three of their daughters.

sub_schemes.title: Festival Gift Coupons (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Festival Gift Coupons" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide Festival Gift Coupons worth ₹4,000/- per annum to the Non-Pensioner ESMs who are 60 years or older in age.

sub_schemes.title: Fee Reimbursement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has decided to launch UP Fee Reimbursement Scheme to reimburse fees and give scholarships to students from backward classes.

sub_schemes.title: Fee Waiver Scheme For SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education
sub_schemes.description: "Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education" provides free access to every SC/ST student, to the institutions of higher learning so that that no eligible SC/ST students are deprived of higher education for want of resources.

sub_schemes.title: Financial assistance for Marriage for the Construction Worker
sub_schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for children (upto 2 children) of the building workers.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial incentives worth ₹5,000/- to the meritorious girls from Scheduled Castes who have secured 80% or above marks in the HSLC examination. To objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher studies and bring them at par with the rest.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Incentive For Inter-Caste Marriages Under Protection Of Civil Rights Act 1955 And Scheduled Castes And Scheduled Tribes (Prevention Of Atrocities) Act 1989 In Assam
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage inter-caste marriages in Assam. It provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- in a joint fixed deposit for eligible couples where one spouse belongs to a Scheduled Caste and the other to a General Caste Hindu.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Boy Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a financial incentive of ₹5,000/- to the meritorious boys from Scheduled Castes who have secured 80% or above marks in the HSSLC examination. The objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher studies and bring them at par with the rest.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
sub_schemes.description: Financial help on death of family head scheme was launched by Rajasthan state government under tribal area development on 20/08/2008. Under this scheme, ₹10,000/- to the wife of the deceased on the premature death of the head of the family of Saharia primitive tribe.

sub_schemes.title: Mata Shabri Mahila Sashktikaran Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mata Shabri Mahila Sashktikaran Yojana" scheme aims to provide subsidies to purchase LPG gas connections and stoves, thereby reducing their dependence on firewood for cooking & improving the quality of life of women from scheduled caste families living below the poverty line (BPL).

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Gift Scheme - Telangana
sub_schemes.description: The "Marriage Gift Scheme" was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Dept. Telangana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance as a marriage gift to unmarried registered women workers & the daughters of registered building & construction

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows of Ex-servicemen (other than War Widows)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹11,000/- is provided to the widows of ex-servicemen (other than war widows) for the marriage of their daughters, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant Scheme
sub_schemes.description: In Uttar Pradesh State, a scheme for the marriage of girls from economically weaker families of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant of Rs.51,000/- to Daughter/Sister of Personnel Killed/ Disabled in War/ Action/Terrorist Attack/Naxalite Attack/IS Duty
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides ₹51,000 as a wedding gift to the sister or daughter of a martyred soldier to honor their sacrifice and support the dependent family.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant to War Widows’ Daughters of Ex-Servicemen
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- is provided to the war widows for marriage of their dependent daughters, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Marriage Incentive Reward scheme for the marriage of disabled persons by the Government of Uttar Pradesh is being operated by the department since the year 1997.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000 is provided for the marriage of each dependent orphan daughter of an ex-serviceman, for up to two daughters, who are at least 18 years old.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Gift Scheme (APBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers have introduced the "Marriage Gift Scheme" for registered unmarried women workers & the two daughters of registered construction workers. This welfare initiative aims to provide financial assistance on the occasion of their marriage

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of the Daughter of War Disabled Ex-Servicemen above 50% Disability
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- is provided for the marriage of each dependent daughter of war-disabled ex-servicemen whose disability has been assessed above 50%, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Shaurya Medal Recipients by the Government of Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to honor and support Shaurya Medal recipients by providing financial aid and recognition for their bravery and distinguished service.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to ST Students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana", financial assistance of upto ₹ 15,000/- is provided to the Scheduled Tribe Students as the maintenance allowance given under the Post Matric Scholarship is inadequate to meet the expenses on food & travel.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to SC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial grants to the SC students for appearing in the UPSC Mains Exam. An amount upto ₹50,000/- is provided to each beneficiary, subject to budget provision. The assistance is extended depending on the applicant satisfying the eligibility criteria and the documents submitted.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture” by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa has been designed with the objective of encouraging Goan Folk artists to revive, preserve and protect the Goan Maand culture consisting of folk forms.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura to provide financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities in the form of a monthly pension of ₹2,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Vulnerable Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Vulnerable Women" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura to provide financial assistance to Vulnerable Woman in need of special care, support or protection because of age, disability.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Unorganized Workers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa-Unorganized Workers" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial benefits to Unorganized Workers (home-based, self-employed or wage workers).

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Old and Infirm
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Old and Infirm" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to poor people of Tripura who are old and infirm, such as senior citizens.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Bicycle Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Rajya Nirashrit Mahila Samman Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: “Mukhyamantri Rajya Nirashrit Mahila Samman Pension Yojana” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand, that aims to provide social security to women who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resources.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support poor families by reducing their household fuel expenses. Under this scheme, Antyodaya (pink card) ration card holders in the state are entitled to receive three free gas cylinder refills every year.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Rajya Bridhhabasta Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: “Mukhyamantri Rajya Bridhhabasta Pension Yojana” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial asistance to the age group of 60 years and above.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana" to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks & remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme aims to encourage scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, backward classes entrepreneurship by providing financial support to purchase buses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to unemployed candidates who have completed skill training programs aligned with NSQF.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana" for the girl child of the family.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The allowance will be provided by the Government of Bihar to the educated unemployed citizens under the Chief Minister Self Help Allowance Scheme. So that the citizens of the state do not have to face financial crisis.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur suraksha upakaran sahaayata yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nikah Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the needy girls, widows, and abandoned women from destitute or poor Muslim families in the state at the time of their marriage (In case of mass marriage).

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Marriage Assistance" for the employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Mangalya Scheme For Widow Remarriage
sub_schemes.description: The “Mangalya Scheme” was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Kerala. Under the scheme, financial assistance is to be provided to eligible widows and divorced women for their remarriage.

sub_schemes.title: Mandahasam Scheme To Provide Artificial Dentures To Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mandahasam Scheme to Provide Artificial Dentures to Senior Citizens” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Manav Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides toolkit assistance (e-vouchers) to economically weak individuals (annual income ≤ ₹6,00,000/-) for self-employment in 10 trades like dairy, plumbing, and beauty parlors. Beneficiaries include SC/ST, nomadic tribes, and BPL families.

sub_schemes.title: Manav Garima Yojna SCW (EBC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist the economically backward class in becoming self-employed through the distribution of business tool-kits that help them establish small-scale ventures and earn a sustainable livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Manabik Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Manabik Pension Scheme is a financial assistance program launched in 2018 to provide monthly pensions to individuals with disabilities in West Bengal.

sub_schemes.title: Manav Garima Yojna (NT DNT)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enable nomadic and de-notified castes to live with dignity and become self-employed. Through this scheme, business tool-kits are provided to these beneficiaries to help them start small businesses and achieve financial self-sufficiency.

sub_schemes.title: Manav Garima Yojana DCW (Minority)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enable minority persons to become self-employed through business toolkits and support. Under this scheme, business tool-kits are provided to eligible persons from such groups, so they can set up small businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance to Severely Affected Persons
sub_schemes.description: The 'Maintenance Allowance to Severely Affected Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to the severely affected persons who cannot be rehabilitated by any other assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The 'Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to intellectually disabled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance for Persons Affected with Muscular Dystrophy
sub_schemes.description: The 'Maintenance Allowance for Persons Affected with Muscular Dystrophy' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to the person affected with muscular dystrophy.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In Professional Courses And Living In Hostel Attached To Professional Colleges
sub_schemes.description: Government of Maharashtra introduced the scheme to complete the education of V.J.N.T and S.B.C students who are the student of professional courses.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance for Leprosy Affected Persons
sub_schemes.description: The 'Maintenance Allowance for Leprosy Affected Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to leprosy-affected persons.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance Allowance To Backward Class Students Under Training In Sainik Schools
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Maintenance Allowance to Backward Class Students Under Training in Sainik School” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra.

sub_schemes.title: Mai Ramabai Ambedakar Saat Phera Samuh Lagna Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, incentives are provided to couples who participate in group marriages, as well as to the organizing institution. If people adopt the practice of group marriages, they can avoid the unnecessary expenses associated with individual weddings and promote financial growth.

sub_schemes.title: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the goal is to support girls from economically weaker families by providing assistance for transportation, enabling regular school attendance.

sub_schemes.title: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to create self-employment for women from the backward classes. Through this scheme, low-interest rate loans are provided to female beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Mahila Swavlamban Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to women from rural and urban areas for undertaking economic activities, with support in the form of a subsidy and loans.

sub_schemes.title: Mahila Kisan Yojana (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: "Mahila Kisan Yojana" is implemented by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to uplift the lifestyle of economically disadvantaged Charmakar communities. it supports the production and sale of various types of footwear and leather articles.

sub_schemes.title: Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana" was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, under the Labour Department of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered female construction workers and maximum of two of their daughters.

sub_schemes.title: Mizoram Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations and Individuals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations and individuals to support welfare activities for disadvantaged and marginalized groups such as women, children, disabled persons, elderly, and socially vulnerable individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: The Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has successfully launched the "Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0" scheme to provide nutritional support for children below 6 years of age, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), and Adolescent Girls (14-18 years).

sub_schemes.title: Miscarriage Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial benefits for miscarriage up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Finance (GBCDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to create self-employment for the backwards class men. Through this scheme, low interest rates and financial help are provided to the backwards class men.

sub_schemes.title: Meritorious Scholarships To Vjnt And Sbc Students Studying In Secondary Schools
sub_schemes.description: The government of Maharashtra introduced the scheme of meritorious Scholarships to VJNT and SBC students studying in Secondary Schools. To motivate Backward Class students for education.

sub_schemes.title: Merit Based Award and Recognition Of High Performance In The Board Exams Of SSC And HSSC In The State Of Goa
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to motivate students by giving Merit Based Award on the benchmark of performance and to provide financial incentives to high-performing students who are economically weak. The scheme aims to increase the representation of the ST Community in the High-Rank Holders.

sub_schemes.title: Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students
sub_schemes.description: "Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students" by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa aims to motivate students by providing merit-based awards and financial incentives (ranging from ₹5,000/- to ₹20,000/-) to high-performing students who are economically weak.

sub_schemes.title: Merit Awards
sub_schemes.description: In the "Merit Awards" scheme, awards are given to the students with disability who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd among disabled students in the Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.) and Higher Secondary Certificate (H.S.C.) in their respective divisional boards of education.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
sub_schemes.description: "Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept.,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides medical expenses for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from Cancer, Heart disease, Kidney disease, T.B. etc.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Benefit (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers for their own marriage. This assistance shall also be sanctioned for the marriage of all adult children of a worker subject to production of proper documentation such as Marriage Certificates etc.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance to Person with Disability / BPL
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support differently-abled brides/bridegrooms from BPL families by providing financial assistance to meet marriage-related expenses. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹30,000/- is provided to Scheduled Tribe, differently-abled brides/bridegrooms for their first marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide marriage assistance to a normal person marrying a visually Impaired Person.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Orthopedically Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Orthopedically Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide marriage assistance to a normal person.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled couple.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Persons Marrying Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Persons Marrying Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled couple.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Marriage Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides Marriage benefits in the form of financial assistance to the eligible registered women members & their immediate dependents of the board.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance To Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Prisoners
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Daughters of Prisoners” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Marriage Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. In this scheme, financial assistance of ₹7,000/- is provided to the registered construction workers of the Board for the marriage of their children. The benefits are credited via DBT.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Differently Abled Parents (Parinayam-I)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Daughters of Differently Abled Parents (Parinayam-I)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of a registered female worker herself (including one-time remarriage) and for up to two daughters of a registered worker. The scheme applies to the marriage of the female beneficiary herself and the legal, adopted, or stepdaughter of worker.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance For Legally Married Transgender Couples
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Marriage Assistance for Legally Married Transgender Couples” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. This scheme is intended to help deprived transgender individuals who are planning to get married legally to lead a steady normal family life.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to female workers who are working in a factory/organization in the state of Gujarat after their marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance - Folk Artist
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Marriage Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of registered folk artists, or their son or daughter. The assistance aims to support the cultural community by helping with marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, registered construction workers will receive a financial allowance to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The “Marriage Assistance” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for girl children (upto 2 children) of the registered female building workers.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance (JKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Marriage Assistance" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial aid to registered construction workers for the marriage of their dependents, including up to three marriages for their sons, daughters, siblings, or themselves.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Marriage Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support to registered construction workers for the marriage expenses of their own or their two (2) dependent children's marriages.

sub_schemes.title: Marriage Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Marriage Assistance” was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B), Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam for providing financial assistance to the registered construction workers for the marriage of their children.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Training and Rehabilitation in Case of Permanent Disability due to Accident
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to rehabilitate drivers and conductors who suffer permanent disability due to accidents by providing skill training for alternative employment to the beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monetary support for the marriage of daughters of registered drivers and conductors.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides accident insurance coverage to registered drivers and conductors, offering financial protection in the event of accidental death or permanent disability.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Gratuity Assistance in case of Death
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide social security to registered drivers and conductors by offering gratuity assistance for funeral expenses to families in the event of an accidental death.

sub_schemes.title: Mother Teresa Asahay Matri Sambal Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The main purpose of the Scheme to encourage under this Yojana, women who are helpless in upbringing their children (like widows, and destitute) are provided with financial assistance per child per annum for two children.

sub_schemes.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme-1
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, ₹ 25,000/- and an 8-gram gold coin is given to brides who have studied Class 10th. This scheme is only applicable for the marriage conducted from 17th May 2011 onwards. The objective of the scheme is to help financially poor parents in getting their daughters mar

sub_schemes.title: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹25,000/- to the freedom fighters of Uttarakhand and to the widows of deceased freedom fighters, in recognition of their contribution to the nation.

sub_schemes.title: Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹10,000 per month to the dependent parents of martyred soldiers for their maintenance and livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to assist poor parents in getting their daughters married & to promote education status.

sub_schemes.title: Modular Reflective Folding Sticks (Smartcane)
sub_schemes.description: The 'Modular Reflective Folding Sticks (Smartcane)' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute modular reflective folding sticks to needy visually impaired persons for self-orientation & independent mobility.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance/Wage Compensation during Illness (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, wage compensation or financial assistance is provided to registered workers if they are admitted to any government or empanelled private hospital for treatment for a minimum of 4 days and a maximum of 30 days.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries" scheme under the Labour and Employment Department HP, provides financial support for healthcare. It covers ₹50,000 for outdoor treatment, ₹1,00,000 for indoor treatment, and ₹5,00,000 for critical illnesses each year, upon submission of valid medical bills.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance" scheme provides financial assistance to Construction Workers hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or disease. The financial assistance shall be ₹500/- for the first 5 days and ₹50/- each for the remaining days, subject to a maximum of ₹1,5000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" was launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept, Delhi. The registered workers are given medical assistance upto ₹ 10,000/- in case of being hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or disease.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance for the Construction Worker
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides medical expenses for the treatment of the registered beneficiary and /or his dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker who is hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or any disease is provided with ₹400/- for the first 5 days and ₹40/- for the remaining days, subject to a maximum ₹2,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides medical assistance to the Building & Other Construction Workers, who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization due to accident or illness.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: Medical assistance shall be provided to Building & Other Construction Workers who are registered under A.B.O.C.W.W.B. during hospitalization, partial disability & for critical diseases such as Cancer, Heart attack, Failure of kidney, Liver cirrhosis etc. as per the decision of the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Media Person Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Media Person Pension Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information, Public Relations and Languages, Haryana on 07th December 2017.

sub_schemes.title: Matru Jyothi - Financial Assistance For PwD Mothers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Matru Jyothi - Financial Assistance for PwD Mothers” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Maatrtv, Shishu Evan Baalika Madad Yojana" is a initiative of Uttar Pradesh state Government to provide the financial assistance to the mother and her girl child.

sub_schemes.title: Matrimonial Incentives
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, if a Person with Disability (PwD) gets married to a non-disabled person, then the couple is provided a marriage incentive of up to ₹ 50,000. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists. It offers marriage assistance of up to ₹20,000/- for the first daughter and ₹15,000/- for the second daughter of eligible artists.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased Goan artists by assisting them in meeting funeral expenses, thereby acknowledging the contributions of artists and supporting their families during difficult times. The component provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members for medical treatment expenses. It covers major or minor surgical treatment costs in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum ₹20,000/-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications are accepted offline.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to financially assist the Goan artists to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their houses damaged due to natural calamities. The maximum financial assistance provided under this component is ₹25,000/- or the valuation done by the Taluka Mamlatdar.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.

sub_schemes.title: Kala Samman Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Kala Samman Scheme" grants financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contribution to the field of Art and culture.

sub_schemes.title: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra Scheme 2016
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Kailash Mansarovar Yatra Scheme 2016” was launched by the Tourism Department, Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016. Under the scheme, the government of Haryana provides financial assistance to the pilgrims of the State of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: KULAVILAKKU
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to enhance the nutritional status of Pregnant Women. ₹500/- assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries during their pregnancies. The scheme is a crucial step towards ensuring the well-being of both mother and child. The benefit will be provided for upto two pregnancies only.

sub_schemes.title: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family of a prisoner who is the sole or main earner, to support them through self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit" scheme by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to registered female beneficiaries at the time of delivery or upon the birth of a child.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana" for unmarried women of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Mazdoor Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide social and financial welfare benefits to unorganized sector workers. It offers increased remuneration, seasonal bonuses, electricity subsidies, and assistance such as e-rickshaws to registered unorganized laborers in Madhya Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Asahaya Punarwas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and rehabilitation support to destitute individuals who are orphaned, abandoned by their parents, or have no one to care for them. Beneficiaries receive one-time financial aid and support for admission to day-care centers or old-age homes.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance for special project proposals received in the interest of the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to uplift Scheduled Tribe communities through education, health, & economic initiatives. Financial grants, equipment, & training programs are provided for holistic village development.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana" is for the economic freedom of women in the state age group of 21 to 65, improving their health and nutrition and strengthening their decisive role in the family. The women will receive a financial benefit through direct benefit transfer.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat
sub_schemes.description: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat also referred to as the Assam Tea Garden Workers' Financial Assistance Scheme 2025. This initiative marks the 200th-year celebration of Assam Tea and aims to provide one-time financial assistance to tea garden workers in recognition of their invaluable contribution.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Vivah Shagun Yojna
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is being implemented to honor the girl child and to ensure that the girls from poor families and daughters of widows/destitute women, sports women & orphan girl children, are married gracefully. For this purpose, grant is given to eligible persons to cover marriage expenses.

sub_schemes.title: Magnifiers - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The Department launched the "Magnifiers by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department" scheme for differently-abled persons. Under this scheme, magnifiers are distributed to needy students with low vision to enable them to read books.

sub_schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to physically disabled artists and litterateurs for disability-related medical treatment and rehabilitation.

sub_schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to the dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs.

sub_schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance for serious illness, accident, or calamity-related medical treatment to artists and litterateurs.

sub_schemes.title: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Madhu Babu Pension Yojana" under the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Government Of Odisha is a social welfare scheme designed to provide financial assistance to elderly citizens, widows, and disabled persons who are economically weaker.

sub_schemes.title: MICRO FINANCE (Gopalak Nigam)
sub_schemes.description: Micro-loan scheme for Rabari and Bharwad caste entrepreneurs in Gujarat. Provides up to ₹1.25 lakh loan at 5% interest with only 5% beneficiary contribution.

sub_schemes.title: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.

sub_schemes.title: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension (Police Line Yojana) for the democracy fighters of the state imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977).

sub_schemes.title: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets
sub_schemes.description: The “Pay and Use” Community Toilets Scheme under Swachhta Udyami Yojana by NSKFDC offers concessional loans to Safai Karamcharis and their dependents for setting up public toilet units, promoting sanitation, livelihood, and dignity.

sub_schemes.title: Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, the worker registered with the Board is provided with a loan of ₹5,000/- for the purchase of tools.

sub_schemes.title: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Educationally Backward Class (EBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to EBC students.

sub_schemes.title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure mechanised cleaning and provide related safe and sustainable livelihood opportunities to Safai Karamcharis and liberated Manual Scavengers. The Financial assistance is provided for the procurement and operation of sanitation-related equipment and vehicles for the target.

sub_schemes.title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Sanitary Marts Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A sanitary mart is a one-stop-shop for all things for sanitation and hygiene. It is a shopping place where the sanitary needs of the common man could be met. It serves both as a shop and as a service centre.

sub_schemes.title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan (GTL)
sub_schemes.description: A general term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment for Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers, and their dependants aged 18 years and above.

sub_schemes.title: Living Craft Treasure Award
sub_schemes.description: The "Living Craft Treasure Award" scheme was launched by the Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles, and Khadi Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. This is the highest award for handicrafts at the state level was introduced in the year 2013-2014 to craftsperson of eminence who are above the age of 65 years.

sub_schemes.title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Education Loan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide education loans to the students from the community of safai karamcharis\manual scavengers & their dependents for pursuing higher education.

sub_schemes.title: Leave Travelling Concession Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Leave Travelling Concession Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides leave travel concession to the registered construction workers for journeys to religious/ historical places in India or visiting their hometown.

sub_schemes.title: Legal Aid To Scheduled Castes And Vimukat Jatis Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Legal Aid to Scheduled Castes and Vimukat Jatis Scheme” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Schedule Castes and Backward Classes, Haryana on 13th February 1961.

sub_schemes.title: Leprosy Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This Leprosy Pension Scheme has been started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Lean Season Assistance under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Lean Season Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced with the objective of assisting fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periods.

sub_schemes.title: Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage the children of laborers who are enrolled in professional or design courses by providing assistance for purchasing laptops, thereby reducing the financial burden of education.

sub_schemes.title: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
