sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support for the development and supply of low-cost educational materials for visually impaired students. Through this scheme, grants are provided to implementing agencies for purchasing and producing assistive learning devices.

sub_schemes.title: Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers
sub_schemes.description: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides scholarships to children of registered workers. The scheme covers up to two children per family. Students of 9th to 12th grade (Intermediate), ITI and Graduation level will receive financial assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Prosthetic Aid Scheme
sub_schemes.description: In the "Prosthetic Aid Scheme", Prosthetic Aids and Artificial Appliances (Tricycles, Wheel Chairs, Crutches, Hearing Aids, and Artificial Limbs, etc) are provided to Persons with Disability (e.g. blind, deaf, orthopedically or physically handicapped) by the Social Welfare Department.

sub_schemes.title: Providing Artificial Limbs and Other Appliances to Disabled BOC Workers
sub_schemes.description: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board has launched a scheme to provide artificial limbs & other appliances to registered disabled construction workers. The scheme also covers the replacement of limbs every three years based on the workers' needs.

sub_schemes.title: Prosthetic Aid and Appliances for Person with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a Person with Disabilities with 40% or more disability is given relief in his/her disability as well as equipment for self-employment within the limit of ₹20,000/-. The scheme is fully funded by the state government.

sub_schemes.title: Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 1st January 2006, the “Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme” is a flagship social-security scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The family receives ₹2,750/- per month for 15 years after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age.

sub_schemes.title: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been started in Madhya Pradesh for Girl Child in 2007.

sub_schemes.title: Ladli Beti Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A social assistance scheme sponsored by the J&K Govt. for newborn girl children born on or after 01/04/2015. The objective is to arrest the declining female sex ratio. The scheme ensures that the girl child does not become a burden for the parent or guardian at the time of her marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Ladies Vocational Centres
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Jammu And Kashmir started “Ladies Vocational Centres” with the objective is to impart training in various trades i.e. Cutting, Embroidery, Knitting as well as Stenography to the female folk to enable them to start their income-generating units.

sub_schemes.title: Labour Skill Training Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 1st August 2018, the scheme "Labour Skill Training Scheme" is a skill development initiative by the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, Govt of MP. It offers free skill training to construction workers aged 18-45 years and their dependents aged 16-45

sub_schemes.title: Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card
sub_schemes.description: Under this facilities, a labour card is issued to workers engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, and related activities, enabling them to avail the benefits of all welfare schemes provided by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare

sub_schemes.title: Labour Accident benefit Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to workers (Shramyogis) who become disabled during their duty period due to an accident or any other reason at the working premises of the establishment.

sub_schemes.title: Labor Tool Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Labor Tools Assistance Scheme has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh.

sub_schemes.title: LIDCOM Margin Money Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, for a loan limit from ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000/-, 20% of the Project cost loan as Seed Capital is paid by the Corporation @ 4% interest per annum. A maximum of ₹10,000/- will be paid as a subsidy by Corporation. A 5% amount of project cost will have to be contributed by the beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Being implemented by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra for the Roadsides Cobblers from the (Scheduled Caste) Charmakar Community, this scheme provides a 100% subsidy for the erection of a Tin Stall of Size 4’ x 5’ x 6.5’ costing ₹16367/- per stall and ₹500/- incidental charges.

sub_schemes.title: LIDCOM 50% Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "50% Subsidy Scheme" is a scheme by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, 50% amount is being given as a subsidy on a maximum loan amount of ₹50,000/-. The subsidy is subject to the maximum limit of ₹10,000/-. The bank charge of interest is as per the existing rate.

sub_schemes.title: LIDCOM Training Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Being implemented particularly for the Charmakar Community, the "Training Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. This scheme is being implemented for the students to enable them to start their own businesses, trade, or get a job.

sub_schemes.title: LIDCOM Education Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Education Loan Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, finance of upto ₹ 20,00,000 is provided for post graduate students in the 18-50 years age group from Charmakar Community for studies in India and in abroad.

sub_schemes.title: Laadli Laxmi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Laadli Laxmi Scheme was launched with the intention to address the undesirable tendency of female foeticides and with an aim towards erasing the general perception that the birth of a girl in the family is a burden on her parents/guardian during her marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme was initiated in 1991. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided on the occasion of the marriage of two adult girls belonging to the Scheduled Caste category.

sub_schemes.title: Konkani Drama Competition
sub_schemes.description: The "Konkani Drama Competition" is a cultural scheme by Kala Academy under the Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Goa. It is held annually to promote theatre among the institutions. Eligible participants are those registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, with renewed registration.

sub_schemes.title: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial security to farmers through direct income support and death/disability benefits. It benefits small and marginal farmers with annual assistance of ₹5,000/- per acre and a one-time payout of ₹2,00,000/- in case of death.

sub_schemes.title: Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.

sub_schemes.title: One Act Play competition at High School, Higher Secondary School and College level (Konkani, Marathi & English)
sub_schemes.description: The "One Act Play Competition" is a Cultural Scheme by the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, encouraging students' personality development through theatre, with participation open to all Goan schools and colleges, and transport assistance provided as per government norms.

sub_schemes.title: One Nation One Ration Card
sub_schemes.description: "One Nation, One Ration Card" is Aadhaar-based national ration card portability scheme to ensure food security for all, including internal migrants within India, under which beneficiaries can purchase subsidized food anywhere in India.

sub_schemes.title: Old-Age Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Himachal Pradesh government offers an Old Age pension scheme to support elderly citizens who have no means of livelihood. The scheme offers financial assistance to eligible citizens based on their age and income level.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Samman Allowance
sub_schemes.description: "Old Age Samman Allowance" is a social security scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The scheme provides a pension of ₹ 3000/month to senior citizens (60 years of age or older) who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resource

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold
sub_schemes.description: The “Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers” scheme implemented by the MSME and Textiles Dept., aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief Minister’s Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam
sub_schemes.description: The 'Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief Minister’s Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam' is a state scheme. The scheme aims to give a pension of ₹1,000/- to old-age farmers and destitute agricultural labourers who have membership card under CMPUT.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme- On Completion Of 65 Years (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 65 years.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme - Punjab
sub_schemes.description: Punjab State Government started a pension for old age person of the state people.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme - On Completion of 60 Years (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 60 years.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to senior citizens (both husband and wife) in the state who are 60 years of age or above and whose family’s monthly income is up to ₹4,000/- or who belong to the BPL category.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Old Age Pension Scheme” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Old Age Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides pension to registered construction workers aged above 60 years and have completed 3 years of membership with the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension - Chandigarh
sub_schemes.description: The Old Age Pension scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to elderly citizens who have reached a certain age and require regular income for their sustenance.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Pension
sub_schemes.description: In 2010, the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department of the West Bengal State Government introduced the "Old Age Pension" scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of ₹ 1,000/- for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.

sub_schemes.title: Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (NSPY) (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The “Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (NSPY)” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a social welfare scheme that provides pension to the eligible registered beneficiary or their dependents in certain circumstances.

sub_schemes.title: Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana" to help construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families of unregistered workers who die during construction work in Madhya Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme ,launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aims to provide affordable health insurance to the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

sub_schemes.title: Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: In 2008, Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana" for differently ables persons

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes Dept., Govt. of Haryana to promote communal harmony by encouraging inter-caste marriages. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2.5 lakhs to couple when a Non-Scheduled Caste boy or girl marries with a SC girl/boy.

sub_schemes.title: Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry, provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.

sub_schemes.title: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme "Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes" to voluntary organizations to run the Public School (Vidya Niketan) on a grant-in-aid basis.

sub_schemes.title: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/annuity is provided to serving or ex-servicemen who have been conferred with the “Gallantry Medal Award.” In the event of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the grant is extended to the eligible family members or dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Opening And Running Junior Colleges For VJNT Students Run By Voluntary Agencies
sub_schemes.description: The Govt. of Maharashtra vide G.R. dated 26/6/2008 launched the scheme “Opening and Running Junior Colleges for VJNT Students Run by Voluntary Agencies” for the educational and social development of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.

sub_schemes.title: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state who have been conferred with the ‘Vishisht Seva Medal Award’.

sub_schemes.title: One Time Grant For Media Personality
sub_schemes.description: "One Time Grant for Media Personality" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Information and Public Relations Department, Govt. of Assam. Through this scheme, the govt. provides a one-time grant to twenty journalists ₹ 50,000/- each every year.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students
sub_schemes.description: "Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry, is granted to top ranking boy and girl student in each region (Pondicherry, Karaikal and Yanam) who have secured 55% marks in the Higher Secondary Examination.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Awas Navinikarn Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The main purpose of this scheme is to provide grant for the repair of house to all families living under below poverty line, whose house needs repair. An amount of Rs. 80,000/- is provided for this purpose. Only on-line applications on https://saralharyana.gov.in/ are accepted under this scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme (Revised – 2009)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme” has been revised and implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana in 2009. Under this scheme, the state government provides medical treatment facilities to patients of the SC/ST communities.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chattar Sansodhit Yojna
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is being implemented to encourage the merit amongst the students of Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Nomadic, DNTs, Semi-Nomadic, Vimukt Jaati and Tapriwas Jaati and to produce a feeling of competition amongst them and motivate them to earn more and more marks from the middle to post.

sub_schemes.title: Doodh Sanjivani Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance the nutritional health of children aged 6 months to 6 years and pregnant and lactating mothers by providing fortified flavored milk in Anganwadi centers across 20 districts in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme" provides financial assistance for the education and training of differently-abled children, who are regular students in a school or college. The application needs to be submitted to the District Office, Panchayat and Social Welfare / Janpad Panchayat Office.

sub_schemes.title: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to Disabled children of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Divyang Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The State Government of Uttar Pradesh has launched Divyang Pension Yojana to improve and uplift the standard of living of disabled citizens.

sub_schemes.title: Divyang Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support persons with disabilities in meeting their basic needs and improving their quality of life. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to persons with disabilities who are above18 years of age & have a disability of more than 40%.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Pulses
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Distribution of Pulses" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to ensure food security by providing pulses at affordable rates to eligible households under NFSA and JSFSS.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, supports NFSA beneficiaries and others by providing 1 liter of kerosene oil at subsidized rates.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Free House Sites to Scheduled Caste/Other Economically Backward Classes
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, the homeless poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided housing sites to enable them to construct their own houses. Approximately 11,000 persons so far have benefitted from this scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Distress Relief Fund For The Differently Abled (Medical Treatment)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Distress Relief Fund for the Differently Abled (Medical Treatment)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Distress Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Distress Relief Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to the BPL households on the death of their primary breadwinner (male or female).

sub_schemes.title: Disabled State Level Award Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage persons with disabilities and organizations working for the interests of persons with disabilities and to motivate the community for overall rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Disablement Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, financial assistance of ₹75,000/- is extended based on the Disablement Certificate issued by the Competent Authority to the Registered Construction Worker of the Board. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the worker.

sub_schemes.title: Discount Scheme on Sale of Khadi Garments
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the use and sale of Khadi garments by providing a 10% discount to consumers on purchases made at Khadi production and sales centres registered with the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).

sub_schemes.title: Disable Marriage Scheme (Divyang Lagna Sahay)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities when a person with a disability marries another person with a disability, as well as when a non-disabled person marries someone with a disability.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Disability Pension for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides monthly disability pension of ₹3000/- to the permanently disabled member due to paralysis, leprosy, T.B and accidents.

sub_schemes.title: Disabled Marriage Incentive Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance for marriage with a view to social rehabilitation of persons with disabilities who do not fall under the category of income tax payers.

sub_schemes.title: Disabled Person Pension Scheme - Punjab
sub_schemes.description: Punjab State Government started a pension for disable person of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension and Ex-Gratia (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Disability Pension and Ex-Gratia'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides a monthly pension to beneficiaries partially disabled due to worksite accidents or diseases, with an additional ex-gratia payment based on disability percentage.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Relief - Telangana
sub_schemes.description: The "Disability Relief" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Dept. Telangana aimed at providing financial support to registered building & other construction workers who suffer from total or partial permanent disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Relief Allowance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Disability Relief Allowance Scheme under the Department of Social Justice, Government of Himachal Pradesh provides financial assistance to individuals with disabilities to help them manage their living costs and improve their quality of life.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension - West Bengal
sub_schemes.description: In 2010, the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department of the West Bengal State Government introduced the "Disability Pension" scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Disability Pension for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Benefit Who Met With an Accident at Worksite
sub_schemes.description: The "Disability Benefit Who Met With an Accident at Worksite" was launched by the Tripura Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered construction worker who suffer from disabilities due to accident at their worksite

sub_schemes.title: Disability Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Disability Assistance for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000 to construction workers registered with Uttarakhand Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have become permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, accidents, etc. In addition, an ex-gratia amount of ₹40,000 is also provided.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, the Board shall provide disability pension to a beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, T.B., accidents,etc. Additionally, workers will be eligible for an exgratia payment based on percentage of disability & subject to condition as may fixed by the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, eligible workers receive ₹1,000/- per month for permanent disabilities caused by conditions such as paralysis, leprosy, tuberculosis, or accidents. Additionally, a one-time assistance of ₹75,000/- is granted for total permanent disability, and ₹50,000/- for partial disability.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The Board provides financial assistance as disability pension to a beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis leprosy, TB., accident etc. in addition to this pension he/she will be eligible for an one time Ex-gratia payment depending upon the percentage of disability.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Pension (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Disability Pension" scheme, the worker who is permanently disabled due to Paralysis / Leprosy / Tuberculosis(TB) / Accident is provided with financial assistance of ₹300/- per month, and an ex-gratia payment of not more than ₹10,000/-, depending on the percentage of the disability.

sub_schemes.title: Disability Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who become disabled due to an accident during the course of their employment on the production of a certificate from competent medical authorities in respect of the percentage of disability.

sub_schemes.title: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
sub_schemes.description: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (Class 11 & 12) In the year 2011.

sub_schemes.title: Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment
sub_schemes.description: The "Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, Infants and young children with hearing impairment are given training to develop speech.

sub_schemes.title: Early Intervention Center for the Children with Intellectually Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The "Early Intervention Center for the Children with Intellectually Disabled" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu.

sub_schemes.title: Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired
sub_schemes.description: The "Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, visually impaired children are identified, assessed and prepared to join main stream education in 6 districts.

sub_schemes.title: Early Intervention Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy in SRTC, Chennai and Tiruchirapalli Districts
sub_schemes.description: The "Early Intervention Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy in SRTC, Chennai and Tiruchirapalli Districts" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, stimulation training is given to the children affected with cerebral palsy.

sub_schemes.title: Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism
sub_schemes.description: The "Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, Early intervention programme emphasizes attending to social stimuli, imitation skills, language comprehension and usage.

sub_schemes.title: Dwarf Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals suffering from dwarfism to help them meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to persons above 21 years of age whose height is less than 4 feet.

sub_schemes.title: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-I
sub_schemes.description: The 'E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows: Scheme-I' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor widow mothers by providing financial assistance for the marriage of their daughters.

sub_schemes.title: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-II
sub_schemes.description: The "E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows: Scheme-II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor widow mothers by providing financial assistance for the marriage of their daughter's.

sub_schemes.title: E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker in 20 December 2016.

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension- Haryana Silicosis Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, after the death of the worker due to Silicosis, financial assistance of ₹3,500/- per month is provided to the spouse of the worker until he/she remains alive. In the case of an unmarried worker, the financial assistance is provided to his/her living parents.

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to the spouse of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker’s death, if the deceased was a pensioner. Under this scheme, the family pension will be ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: In the event of the death of a pensioner who was receiving a pension from the Board, a family pension shall be given to the surviving spouse by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension (DBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Family Pension" was launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. In this scheme, upon the death of the pensioner, the surviving spouse is provided 50% of the pension amount or ₹1500/-, whichever is higher.

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Family Pension (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa. Through this scheme, in the event of the death of the pensioner of the Board, a 50% pension or ₹200, whichever is higher, is given to the spouse.

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, on the death of a pensioner worker who is being given pension by the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, half of his/her pension is given to his/her spouse (as the case may be).

sub_schemes.title: Family Pension (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Family Pension" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB), Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides pension to the dependent of the deceased pensioner of the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-gratia Payment for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Ex-gratia Payment for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board that provides an ex-gratia amount of ₹1,00,000/- in case of permanent disability.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability.

sub_schemes.title: Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Worker of De-Notified Communities
sub_schemes.description: The "Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Workers of De-notified Communities" by the Government of Madhya Pradesh awards ₹1,00,000/- to a social worker from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities for outstanding contributions to their social and economic upliftment.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities. Under this scheme, financial assistance between ₹74,000/- to ₹2,50,000/-is provided.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-Gratia Payment for Life-Threatening Injury Requiring Hospital Stay for Treatment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals who sustain life-threatening injuries due to disasters and require hospitalization for treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-Gratia Grant for Clothes, Utensils, and Household Items to Disaster-Affected Families
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to disaster-affected families for clothes, utensils, or household items in cases where their house has been washed away, completely or substantially damaged due to a natural calamity, or affected by waterlogging for a period of more than two days.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to CAPF Personnel
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, ex-gratia grant will be given to those personnel of the CAPF hailing from Haryana who get disabled for life and are boarded out of service due to disability declared as in war/operation, in operational area, terrorist activities and natural calamities etc.

sub_schemes.title: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to Defence Forces Personnel
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, the ex-gratia grant will be given to those personnel of the Defence Forces hailing from Haryana who get disabled for life and are boarded out of service due to disability declared as in war/operation, in operational area, terrorist activities & natural calamities, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The 'Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to create self-employment avenues for differently abled persons, the govt. has issued orders to establish Parlour.

sub_schemes.title: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching To Scheduled Tribe Student Studying In Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to impart coaching to ST students across Goa studying in classes Xth, XIth (Science), and XIIth (Arts, Science and Commerce). The scheme prepares the students for various professional courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Architecture, Paramedical Sciences, Law, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Loan Scheme (GBCDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial support to students from socially and educationally backward classes for higher technical and professional education. It offers loans at concessional interest rates for approved graduate and postgraduate courses like engineering, medical, MBA, MCA, and more.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Study Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Educational Study Scheme" provides financial assistance in the form of loans for self-supporting graduate-level courses in professional fields such as Medical, Dental, Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy, Architecture, Nursing, Homeopathy, Veterinary, and similar disciplines.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Natural Death
sub_schemes.description: The component “Natural Death” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹30,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of natural death.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries
sub_schemes.description: The component “Accidental Injuries” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance to the workers or craftsmen in case of accidental injuries.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
sub_schemes.description: “Permanent Partial Disability” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Dept, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹37,500/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of permanent partial disablement.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi AIDS Pirit Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to AIDS patients in the state. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,500/- per month is given to AIDS patients in the state. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Disability Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the persons with disabilities (PwDs) of the poor family of the society by providing them financial assistance. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹400/- is given to PwDs of 40% or more, regardless of their income or age group.

sub_schemes.title: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan
sub_schemes.description: BBSA is a umbrella scheme under the SSEPD Department, Government of Odisha. The aim of the scheme is to promote inclusivity and empowerment among marginalized communities, particularly focusing on those with disabilities and other forms of social disadvantage.

sub_schemes.title: Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Bicycle/Sewing Machine Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, bicycles are provided to registered building & construction workers in plain areas, while sewing machines are provided to registered workers or their dependents in mountainous/hilly areas. These benefits are granted only once in a lifetime.

sub_schemes.title: Bicycle Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the purchase of a new bicycle for commuting on duty from their residence to the establishments.

sub_schemes.title: Bhargava Matching Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Bhargava Matching Scheme" aims to encourage Brahmin Community members who would like to contribute by creating permanent Assets or take up socially relevant activities for the community viz. Andhra Kesari Bhavan (Community Hall), Viswanadha Aarama Kshetram, Old Age Homes, Skill Development, etc

sub_schemes.title: Bhajan Competition
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Bhajan Competition" is a Cultural scheme to preserve and promote the tradition of Bhajan singing. Competition is organized at the Regional level and the selected group from this competition will participate at the State Level. Entries are invited through local press notes.

sub_schemes.title: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance, in the form of a Scholarship, proportionate to the fees paid by Scheduled Tribe students at the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) level in order to take offline coaching assistance through reputed institutions for preparation for NEET & JEE.

sub_schemes.title: Bhagyalaxmi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The prime goal of this scheme aims to promote the birth of girl children in below poverty line(BPL) families and to raise the status of the girl child in the family in particular and society in general. Financial assistance is provided to the girl child through her mother/father or natural guardian.

sub_schemes.title: Bhagwan Budhdh Scholarship
sub_schemes.description: Bhagavan Buddha Post SSC Scholarship launched by the Ministry of Education, Government of Gujarat. A scheme was introduced with the aim to encourage SC girl students to continue their higher studies after SSC.

sub_schemes.title: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The government of Himachal Pradesh launched a scheme for girls to encourage the education of the girl child below the poverty line (BPL) on 5 July 2010.

sub_schemes.title: Berojgari Bhatta Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The UP government has implemented the UP Unemployment Allowance 2022 scheme in Uttar Pradesh. The government has implemented this scheme only for those candidates who belong to the state and is unemployed despite being educated.

sub_schemes.title: Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: 'Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage hearing-impaired students to wear hearing aids to increase their speech capacity.

sub_schemes.title: Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
sub_schemes.description: The 'Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, battery-operated wheel chairs are given to muscular dystrophy & tetraplegia persons.

sub_schemes.title: Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana” was launched by the Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha on 01st February 2016 in collaboration with IRCTC to help senior citizens over 60-75 years of age to undertake pilgrimage with Government assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Bank Tie-Up Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Bank Tie-Up Scheme", the Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC) arranges loans through banks, and subsidy is provided by PSCLDFC. The permanent residents of Punjab belonging to Scheduled Castes and living Below Poverty Line are eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Balri Birth Gift Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: "Balri Birth Gift Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt for the birth of a female child (upto two girls per family) which can be encashed only at the time of the daughter's marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Banglar Yuba Sathi
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance to educated unemployed youth of West Bengal to support them until they get employment or join another scheme. The objective is to ensure income support for eligible unemployed youth for a maximum period of 5 years.

sub_schemes.title: Accident Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Accident Medical Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department. The Board may sanction an amount of ₹1,500/- per month to the Construction Worker who has met an accident and sustained fracture.

sub_schemes.title: Accident Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Accident Relief Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to the legal heirs of the household BPL on the death of a “Primary breadwinner” (male or female).

sub_schemes.title: Abhayakiranam Scheme-Financial Assistance To Destitute Widows
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Abhayakiranam Scheme-Financial Assistance to Destitute Widows” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala to provide a safe and better living environment to destitute and homeless widows.

sub_schemes.title: Aawaas Sahayata
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2016, the "Aawaas Sahayata" scheme by the Department of Tribal Affairs, Madhya Pradesh, The scheme provides housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.

sub_schemes.title: Aastha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with two or more specially-abled members. Under this scheme, eligible families receive free medical treatment, ration supplies, and other welfare benefits.

sub_schemes.title: Aapki Beti Hamari Beti
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Aapki Beti Hamari Beti” was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Haryana on 24th August 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: The "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana" scheme is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme is aimed at providing insurance and scholarship benefits to landless labourers in rural areas, aged 18 to 59 years.

sub_schemes.title: Aahar Anudan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Aahar Anudan Yojana" provides monthly assistance of ₹1,000 to students, girls, and women from backward tribes like Baiga, Bharia, and Saharia. The scheme aims to combat malnutrition among special tribal families by ensuring access to nutritious food through financial assistance.

sub_schemes.title: ARAVANAIPPU
sub_schemes.description: "ARAVANAIPPU", a scheme by the Dept of Women and Child Development, Govt of Puducherry aims to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food; financial assistance of ₹1200 is offered to lactating mothers. The girl child of the applicant should be born after 1-4-2005.

sub_schemes.title: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme for rural landless households implemented by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. The scheme provides insurance coverage to the head of the household or an earning member of the family in the age group of 18 to 59.

sub_schemes.title: AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior Citizens, particularly those who are indigent, by providing basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and entertainment opportunities. The scheme provides financial assistance for projects such as maintenance of Senior Citizen Homes.

sub_schemes.title: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
sub_schemes.description: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.

sub_schemes.title: AASRA Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “AASRA Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Jammu & Kashmir in 2015 to provide Social Security cover to widows, Destitute, Below Poverty Line families and Breadwinners of such families whose annual income is less than ₹75000/-.

sub_schemes.title: 60% and above Disability Allowances
sub_schemes.description: "60% and Disability Allowance" is a pension scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Govt of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to differently-abled persons with a disability of 60% and above.

sub_schemes.title: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is M.P. To assist multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons above the age of six years who are unable to earn a living.

sub_schemes.title: "Outstanding SC/ST Entrepreneur" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”
sub_schemes.description: "Outstanding SC/ST Entrepreneur" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce Dept, UT of Puducherry, formulated to award the best SC/ST entrepreneurs.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows
sub_schemes.description: “Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to provide financial assistance (₹25 to ₹125) for the education of poor widows' children up to higher secondary or equivalent.

sub_schemes.title: Educational Assistance (Scheme for the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to Children of Construction Workers Registered with the MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides scholarships in the form of financial assistance to children of construction workers registered under the Board. These scholarships will be applicable for courses of study specified by the Board from time to time.

sub_schemes.title: Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The “Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement for purchasing Hearing Aids to each registered beneficiary if required.

sub_schemes.title: Contributory Social Security Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Contributory Social Security Scheme (CSSS)" intends to provide social security to marginal workers on a contributory basis. The duration of the scheme shall be for a period of 5 years, or 10 years. The amount will be deposited in a bank account opened for the beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: Continuation of Pension (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Continuation of Pension'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides a monthly pension to registered construction workers who have paid subscriptions for at least three (3) years.

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Sports Infrastructure Facilities (Badminton, Table Tennis, Squash, Indoor Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Football, Hockey, and Swimming) in Private Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide grants of 25% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹50.00 lakh, for the construction of sports infrastructure facilities in the private sector, including Badminton, Table Tennis, Squash, Indoor Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Football, Hockey, and Swimming.

sub_schemes.title: Concessional Bus Travel Facility to Women above 60 years of age- Punjab
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, all the women of 60 years and above residing in the State of Punjab have been given the benefit w.e.f. 12.11.1999 for 50% concession in bus fare in the Punjab Roadways and Pepsu Road Transport Corporation Buses.

sub_schemes.title: Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme helps visually impaired individuals by giving them computer and screen-reading training and providing a laptop to the beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Concession in Railway Travel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Concession in Railway Travel" was launched by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Tamil Nadu. Under the scheme, individual artists and troupes are allowed to travel in the train on concession by the Railways. A concession certificate will be issued by Mandram.

sub_schemes.title: Computer Training Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is being operated with the objective to provide better chances of employment to the youth by enhancing their skills.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance in case of Death/Injury/Disability due to Wild Animal Attack
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals or their dependents in cases of death, injury, or disability caused by attacks from wild animals such as tigers, leopards, elephants, bears, crocodiles, snakes, and other specified species in and around forest

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings. Under this scheme, a grant ranging from ₹3,000 to ₹40,000 per animal is provided, depending on the species and extent of loss.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation Amount Towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 6th February 2024, the scheme "Compensation Amount towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals" by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides compensation in case of death of cattle due to attacks by wild animals.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Death
sub_schemes.description: The component “Accidental Death” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of accidental death.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
sub_schemes.description: “Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” by the Labour Resources Dept., provides financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- to workers or craftsmen suffering from incurable diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
sub_schemes.description: The Amma Two-wheeler is a scheme that will empower working women in Tamil Nadu State.

sub_schemes.title: Alpsankhyak Muslim Parityaqta/Talaqshuda Mahila Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to strengthen the economic condition of minority Muslim abandoned/divorced women and make them self-dependent by providing financial assistance of ₹25,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and EWS categories by providing financial aid for accommodation. The students receive ₹2,000/- per month for up to 10 months per academic year.

sub_schemes.title: Alpshankhyak Vikas Nidhi
sub_schemes.description: The scheme establishes a ₹4 crore fund to support marginalized minorities in Uttarakhand, targeting gaps in existing central/state welfare programs through district-level initiatives.

sub_schemes.title: Allowance To Eunuchs Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Allowance to Eunuchs Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana on 1st June 2006. Under the scheme, the state government provides financial assistance to eunuchs who are living in various parts of the State.

sub_schemes.title: Allowance for 100% Blind
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Allowance for 100% Blind" aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to the blind persons of Tripura aged 10 years and above having 100% blindness. The application should be submitted to the nearest Child Development Project Officer (CDPO).

sub_schemes.title: Allowance To Dwarf
sub_schemes.description: The government of Haryana introduce a scheme for social empowerment to the Dwarfs on 01.11.2014.

sub_schemes.title: All Goa Classical Dance Competition
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "All Goa Classical Dance Competition" is open for Bharatnatyam and Kathak disciplines. Only solo dance will be considered for the competition. Costumes and accompanists are to be arranged by the participants at their own cost. Open to local students between 12 to 20 years of age.

sub_schemes.title: Advance for Purchase or Construction of House (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Advance for Purchase or Construction of House" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa. The worker registered with the Board is sanctioned financial assistance of upto ₹50,000 for the purchase/construction of a house.

sub_schemes.title: Advance For Purchase Or Construction Of House (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Advance for Purchase or Construction of House” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Additional Pension to Widow of Ex-Serviceman having No Child
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, an additional amount of ₹100/- per month, in addition to the pension amount, is provided to the widow of an ex-serviceman who dies while in service but not in any battle.

sub_schemes.title: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Assistance shall be provided to the legal heirs of deceased construction workers, whether registered or unregistered with the Board, in the event of accidental death or permanent disability occurring during ongoing work at the construction site.

sub_schemes.title: Additional Pension to 100% Disabled Ex-Serviceman having No Child
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides an additional amount of ₹100/- p.m., in addition to pension amount, to 100% disabled ex-servicemen who were members of Armed Forces & have been released from service due to 100% disability/permanent incapacity to work, provided disability or incapacity is attributable to service.

sub_schemes.title: Accidental Death Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: This scheme extends financial assistance of ₹2,25,000/- to the nominees/dependents of the deceased Construction Worker, apart from the ₹2,00,000/- extended through the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC). The amount is credited through DBT into the bank account of the nominee/dependent.

sub_schemes.title: Accidental Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Accidental Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the beneficiary in case of hospitalization and disability due to an accident.

sub_schemes.title: Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: "Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the nominees/dependents of the members in case the death is due to an accident.

sub_schemes.title: Additional Pension to Widow of Ex-Serviceman having Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, an additional amount, in addition to the pension, is provided to the widow of an ex-serviceman who dies while in service but not in any battle.

sub_schemes.title: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to the family members of workers (Shramyogis) in the event of their death due to an accident during their course of employment. This assistance aims to help the worker's family cope with the sudden calamity.

sub_schemes.title: Additional Pension to 100% Disabled Ex-Serviceman having Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides an additional pension to 100% disabled ex-servicemen who were members of the Armed Forces & have been released from service due to 100% disability or permanent incapacity to work, provided the disability or incapacity is attributable to service.

sub_schemes.title: Balika Samrithi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: “Balika Samrithi Yojana” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry was introduced to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food to the girl child. Financial assistance of ₹500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate is provided to lactating mothers.

sub_schemes.title: Bal Ashrams
sub_schemes.description: The "Bal Ashrams" have been established by the Social Welfare Dept, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir, to create a society free from child labor, where all children receive free, compulsory, quality, and meaningful education. Orphans and destitute children are provided free schooling, boarding and lodging.

sub_schemes.title: Awareness Programme on Child/Human Trafficking, Family Planning, Legal Awareness, Health etc.
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community regarding child/human trafficking, family planning, legal awareness, and health. It generates awareness benefits for the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community through Non-Governmental Organizations proposals.

sub_schemes.title: Awas Sahayta Yojana for 100% Hearing and Visually Impaired Disabled Students in Special Trades of Industrial Training Institutes
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure qualitative admission and enable 100% hearing and visually impaired students to obtain high-quality technical education free from economic constraints. It provides housing assistance and expenses for food and accommodation, up to ₹4,000/- to PwD Students.

sub_schemes.title: Awarding of Tamil Mamani, Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna
sub_schemes.description: The Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry launched the "Awarding of Tamil Mamani, Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna" scheme with the aims to provide a cash award to the author/writer who have published books.

sub_schemes.title: Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani
sub_schemes.description: The "Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani" scheme was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide prizes and awards to artists or authors/writers in the fields of Literature, Music, Dance, Drama, Painting and Sculpture, and Folk arts.

sub_schemes.title: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation
sub_schemes.description: "Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry, provides scholarships to the students whose parents are engaged in unclean occupations to improve the status of the unprivileged society.

sub_schemes.title: Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to benefit the students who are studying at the Post-matric level or Post-Secondary stage to complete their education.

sub_schemes.title: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry is introduced to provide scholarship to the differently abled students, studying from Class 1st upto Postgraduate/ Professional courses.

sub_schemes.title: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme that provides to encourage Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (V.J.N.T.) & Special Backward Class (S.B.C.) students and promote the interest in Technical education.

sub_schemes.title: Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was introduced in 2018 by the Department of Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Odisha. The scheme's goal is to help people with disabilities live normal and dignified lives and to encourage others to marry people with disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Asra Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Atal Asra Yojana" by the Department of Tribal Welfare, Government of Goa provides financial assistance of up to ₹ 3,00,000 to individuals from Scheduled Tribes communities for construction/ re-construction and repairs of the house.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs
sub_schemes.description: The "Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs" scheme aims to involve the voluntary sector in improving the educational and socio-economic conditions of the target group i.e. OBCs to upgrade skills to enable them to start income-generating activities on their own.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance under SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Assistance under SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide immediate relief to the victims of atrocities who are from Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and the purchase of artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Dikri Development Scheme-DNH&DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims at “Saving girls” as the primary objective and to improve the Sex Ratio at birth. Through this scheme, money is deposited in the name of the girl child under the LIC Single Premium Endowment Plan for the first two living girl children.

sub_schemes.title: Bus Passes for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Bus Passes for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides 50% reimbursement of the travelling cost of registered construction workers who travel by bus from various villages in search of work.

sub_schemes.title: Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
sub_schemes.description: The "Workers In Case of Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to registered BOC workers in the event of their partial permanent disablement.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Shramik Aujaar Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh launched this scheme on October 1, 2010, under the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." Tool kits are distributed to construction workers on an annual basis as part of this initiative.

sub_schemes.title: Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widows, divorced women, and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the KSMDFC.

sub_schemes.title: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2014, the "Funeral and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme for Unregistered Laborers" is a welfare scheme by the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Madhya Pradesh, providing funeral assistance and ex-gratia payments in case of death or permanent disability.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive For The Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Tribe Community
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Incentive for Intra Caste Marriage within the Scheduled Tribe Community" was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka. The scheme provides an incentive of ₹2,00,000/- to couples who are both from the Scheduled Tribe community but belong to different sub-caste.

sub_schemes.title: Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expense
sub_schemes.description: The "Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses" aims to provide financial assistance for funeral expenses of a deceased Brahmin in their family, where the family has no other means to meet the same. This scheme covers Andhra Pradesh all 13 districts, to meet the funeral expenses of the deceased Brahmi.

sub_schemes.title: "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced to extend financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially.

sub_schemes.title: Antyeshthi Sahay Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the families of deceased senior citizens who were beneficiaries of old-age assistance. Upon the death of such a senior citizen, a one-time financial aid is provided to the legal heir to help cover funeral and related expenses.

sub_schemes.title: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana" by the Department of Tribal Welfare, Government of Goa provides grants of financial assistance for the performance of funeral and religious ceremonies of Scheduled Tribe (ST) families.

sub_schemes.title: Antim Sans‍kar Yojana ​
sub_schemes.description: This scheme "Antim Sanskar Yojana" started by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh to provide the financial assistance in the case of death.

sub_schemes.title: Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides loan assistance for animal husbandry to Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backward classes.

sub_schemes.title: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides a monthly assistance of ₹3000 to foster parents raising orphaned children or children whose mother has remarried after the father's death.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Widow
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, aims to provide financial assistance to widows aged between 18-59 years. The scheme offers ₹1,000/- per month to help meet their basic needs, ensuring public assistance for widows in need of support to maintain a dignified life.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to eligible senior citizens to cater to their basic needs. The scheme benefits senior citizens aged 60 years and above, providing a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- for those aged 60–69 years and ₹2,000/- for those aged 70 years and above.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Disabled Persons (Divyangjan)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department to provide financial assistance to individuals with disabilities. The primary objective is to provide financial benefits to eligible Divyangjan to cater to their basic needs. The scheme is targeted at Divyangjan aged between 18 to 59 years.

sub_schemes.title: Special Education - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Special Education by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide free special education, & vocational training to the visually impaired, hearing-impaired person.

sub_schemes.title: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
sub_schemes.description: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist Who Was Receiving Financial Assistance
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist who was Receiving Financial Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu. ₹3,000/- is given to the eligible legal heir of the deceased.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker" was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Tripura. The scheme aims to provide funeral assistance in case of the death of registered construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Financial Assistance in Case of Death
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance in Case of Death" scheme was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the nominee or spouse or dependent of the deceased registered beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Campaign, Seminar and Sports under Disability Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to extend financial support for National & International Events organized by reputed organizations or an individual person with disabilities working for welfare of Persons with Disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Water Heater Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the use of solar energy for water heating in the state to reduce dependence on conventional electricity and fossil fuels, and to encourage the adoption of green and sustainable energy sources in Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Solar Energy Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide solar energy plates/panels to the families of construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

sub_schemes.title: Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide institutionalized social security cover, including provident funds, pensions, and life insurance. It provides monthly pensions, provident fund advances, and lump-sum death benefits to tea plantation workers in Assam and their dependent families.

sub_schemes.title: Snehasparsham
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Kerala has launched the “Snehasparsham” scheme to protect and help unwed mothers. The problems of unwed mothers are linked with various socio-economic and cultural variables.

sub_schemes.title: Sishu Saathi
sub_schemes.description: “Sishu Saathi”, a scheme of the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal as part of the Rastriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) under National Health Mission is meant to treat Indian children of 0-18 years age group with zero out of pocket expenditure.

sub_schemes.title: Skill Development Allowance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Labour & Employment, Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme of granting Skill Development Allowance to the unemployed youth aims at providing allowance to educated unemployed persons for their Skill upgradation.

sub_schemes.title: Skill Development Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
