sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers or their two children for the purchase of tool kits upon submission of a successful course/trade completion certificate from a Government Industrial Training Institute or Vocational Training Centre.

sub_schemes.title: Sindhu Dharshan Yatra Scheme 2016
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Sindhu Dharshan Yatra Scheme 2016” was launched by Tourism Department, Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016. Under the scheme, the government of Haryana provides financial assistance to the pilgrims of the State of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Silpi Pension Scheme - Assam
sub_schemes.description: Silpi Pension Scheme is a Welfare Scheme provided by the Government of Assam to support the Artists of Assam. Those artists and families who have made outstanding contributions in the field of Art and Culture of Assam will be given financial aid and Pension.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Rehabilitation Pension- Haryana Silicosis Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹4,000/- is given to the Silicosis-affected worker categorized as category (A, B, or C) according to the ILO Classification, until he/she remains alive.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of workers engaged in Akik occupation who died due to silicosis disease. It benefits the families of deceased workers with monetary compensation of ₹1,00,000/- as support for occupational disease-related deaths.

sub_schemes.title: Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Sikkim has introduced the Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme, 2014. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled students to help them secure academic education and technical or professional training.

sub_schemes.title: Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme (SUWPS)” was launched in 2013 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, the unmarried women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Sikkim would receive a pension of ₹ 2000/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Sikkim Grant Of Award To Transgender
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Sikkim Grant of Award To Transgender (SGATT)” was launched in 2013 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, the state government provides financial assistance to transgender belonging to a household of the Below Poverty Line category.

sub_schemes.title: Shravanbal Seva State Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Shravanbal Seva State Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹ 600/- is provided to destitute persons in the state of Maharashtra.

sub_schemes.title: Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana (SKSPTYY) is a scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022 to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers for undertaking pilgrimage.

sub_schemes.title: Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimage travel for senior citizens of Gujarat by providing financial assistance for travel expenses. It benefits eligible senior citizens through reimbursements or direct arrangements with authorized travel agents.

sub_schemes.title: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the payment of railway fares for migrant labourers employed in the organized sector in Gujarat, enabling them to travel to or from their home country to the nearest railway station.

sub_schemes.title: Shramyogi Cycle Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide a subsidy for the purchase of a bicycle to laborers working in the organized sector, enabling them to commute between their residence and workplace.

sub_schemes.title: Shramik Parivahan Yojana (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The registered construction workers will be provided a bus pass through the Municipal Corporation at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace.

sub_schemes.title: Shramik Annapurna Yojana (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, registered construction workers are entitled to receive nutritious meals at concessional rates at the workplace or on Kadianaka. This benefit extends to the registered worker's family members as well.

sub_schemes.title: Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme" is a special scheme for the economic empowerment of widowed, divorced, unmarried women of the minority community.

sub_schemes.title: Shramik Auzaar Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Nirman Shramik Auzaar Sahayata Yojana" is a Social Welfare Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme is also known as "Toolkit Assistance Scheme for Construction Workers" in English. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Short Term Professional Training Courses
sub_schemes.description: The "Short Term Professional Training Courses" is provided to train the youth of the Scheduled Tribe Community in order to start their own business, and to acquire skills by joining the various training courses for the purpose of self-employment or for their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Sona Sobaran Dhoti Saree Distribution Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Sona Sobaran Dhoti Saree Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, provides one dhoti/lungi and one saree at a subsidized rate to NFSA and JSFSS beneficiaries to ensure clothing accessibility for low-income families

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Reimbursement of Educational Expenses to Hearing Impaired Students Pursuing Special Higher Education Courses Inside or Outside the Union Territory of Puducherry
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was introduced by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry to provide financial assistance to Hearing Impaired and Visually Impaired students for pursuing their special higher studies. Through this scheme, the reimbursement of the entire fee is granted from the first year onwards.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Laptop or Desktop Computer to the Media Persons of the Union Territory of Puducherry
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to grant financial assistance for the purchase of laptops or desktop computers to eligible media persons, keeping in view the special nature of the service rendered by the Media Persons to society in creating a sense of socio-political awareness among the people.

sub_schemes.title: Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
sub_schemes.description: In order to prevent child marriages and support marriage expense of financially distressed families, on 02nd October 2014, Government of Telangana (GoTS) introduced a welfare scheme called “Shaadi Mubarak’’, providing financial assistance for marriages of minority community girls.

sub_schemes.title: Sewing Machine Scheme (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to encourage registered women construction workers and to enable them to mend their clothing at their homes. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to registered women construction workers to purchase a Sewing Machine.

sub_schemes.title: Self-Employment Scheme For Dependents Of Prisoners
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Self-Employment Scheme for Dependents of Prisoners” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Self Employment Scheme - Goa
sub_schemes.description: "Self Employment Scheme" provides financial support up to a maximum of ₹ 10,00,000 to any individual person belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community to undertake any self-employment activities.

sub_schemes.title: Self Employment Scheme For Rehabilitation Of Manual Scavengers
sub_schemes.description: The Self Employment Scheme for Rehabilitation of Manual Scavengers (SRMS) was introduced in January 2017 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, to assist the identified manual scavengers and their dependants in rehabilitation in alternative occupations.

sub_schemes.title: Self Employment Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, Subsidies will be provided to the religious minority communities with the help of Nationalized / Scheduled banks to start or improve a small-scale handicraft industry, service sector, and agro-based activities.

sub_schemes.title: Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the relief and rehabilitation of the Kashmiri migrants who have been uprooted from the Valley during the militancy period besides other relief & rehabilitation measures. "SRE (R&R) Scheme" is a component of the Umbrella scheme, 'Modernization of Police Forces (MPF)".

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide the best education to meritorious Scheduled Caste students in high-quality residential schools to help them build their careers and improve their living standards.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10th, 12th & Graduation.

sub_schemes.title: Snehayanam Scheme For Mothers Of Persons With Special Needs
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Snehayanam Scheme for Mothers of Persons with Special Needs” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Snehasanthwanam
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Kerala has launched the “Snehasanthwanam” scheme under the Kerala Social Security Mission. The scheme acts as a relief measure for the Endosulfan victims in the state of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Smart Phone for Hearing and Visually Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Smart Phone for Hearing and Visually Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute smart phone to needy visually impaired & hearing impaired students, unemployed youth, self-employed.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Grant Monthly Financial Assistance to the Persons Engaged in Traditional Occupations/Businesses including Motorcycle Pilots
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide Social Security and Financial Support for healthy living to those engaged in traditional occupations/businesses and motorcycle pilots. It offers monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to eligible persons of Goan Origin who meet specified age and income criteria.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Personal Assistance Allowance to Differently Abled Persons with High Support Need
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme of Personal Assistance Allowance to Differently Abled Persons with High Support Need" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a personal assistance allowance of ₹1,000 to differently abled person.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes
sub_schemes.description: The Central Sector Scheme “Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artists
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹3,000/- to indigent artists are now in indigent circumstances and their dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Extending Grants for the Publication of Rare Books on Arts
sub_schemes.description: Under the "Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists", a grant is sanctioned to the writer for the publication of books that are considered rare for the development of arts. 60% of the total cost of the printing charges of 1000 copies or ₹15,000/- whichever is less is sanctioned as a grant.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a grant for dance and drama troupes/associations.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for publishing manuscripts/research journals.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Cultural Organization for Holding Conference, Seminar, Symposium, Exhibition, Festival, Competition etc.
sub_schemes.description: The Arts and Culture Department launched the "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Cultural Organization for Holding Conference, Seminar, Symposium, Exhibition, Festival, Competition etc." The scheme aims to provide annual grant to the institution/organization organizing a seminar, symposium.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Extending Family Maintenance Grant to the Families of the Deceased Famous Artists
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme of Extending Family Maintenance Grant to the Families of the Deceased Famous Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The objective of the scheme is to provide a one-time maintenance grant of ₹25,000/- to the families of deceased famous artists.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal aims to provide financial assistance to the family of the deceased weaver /artisan.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The artists who have already received the Kalaimamani Award and who are presently in indigent circumstances are awarded ₹15,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide economic development assistance to Scheduled Castes living below the poverty line through financial support and credit facilitation. It provides share capital, margin money loans, and subsidies to Scheduled Castes families for employment-oriented schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for the Funeral Expenses
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for the Funeral Expenses" by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial support to the family of a registered building and construction worker in the event of their death, whether due to natural causes or an accident.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi of Goa
sub_schemes.description: The “Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi of Goa” has been designed with the objective of encouraging the festival theatre of Goa which is known as “Gomantakiya Utsavi Rangabhumi”. This form of theatre has an illustrious tradition of presenting plays during festivals in the villages.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Andhra Pradesh aims to provide wage compensation relief to handloom weaver families. A relief assistance of ₹4,000 per weaver family is provided to compensate for wage loss during the rainy season.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children" aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to the parents of transgender children. Transgender persons face stigma and discrimination in almost every sphere of their life including within the group, health facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Relief to the Un-registered Workers
sub_schemes.description: The Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "Scheme for Relief for the Un-registered Workers" to provide the financial assistance to the dependents of unregistered workers who die in accidents at construction sites.

sub_schemes.title: Short Term Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Short Term Loan Scheme" provides financial assistance/ loan as a credit to individuals from the Scheduled Tribe Community to meet the immediate expenses towards Education, Medical and Business needs. The scheme aims to improve their standard of living.

sub_schemes.title: Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs
sub_schemes.description: The "Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs" Scheme has been started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Shelter Home For Women (SHW)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Shelter Home for Women (SHW)" provides temporary shelter and support to women who have no family or social support systems to rely on and rehabilitate the women socially and economically by the provision of skill training, and counselling.

sub_schemes.title: Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired" aims to provide touch phones to hearing and speech-impaired individuals who know sign language as per the Action Plan 2017-18. The Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Different, distribute the touch phones.

sub_schemes.title: Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive the necessary support to lead active and self-reliant lives.

sub_schemes.title: Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme aims to distribute daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18.

sub_schemes.title: Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards..." by the Dept. of Social Welfare, WCD Dept., Govt. of Andhra Pradesh aims to promote inter-abled marriages. It provides ₹1,50,000/- to eligible differently abled persons as a one-time incentive.

sub_schemes.title: Sanctioning of M.C.R. Chappals to Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanctioning of M.C.R. Chappals to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide M.C.R. (Micro Cellular Rubber) chappals to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to improve their comfort and mobility.

sub_schemes.title: Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide motorized three wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive support to enhance their mobility and independence.

sub_schemes.title: Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide spectacles to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to improve their vision and enhance their quality of life.

sub_schemes.title: Sanction of Laptops - Andhra Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanction of Laptops" scheme aims to distribute laptops to visually challenged, hearing impairments, speech impairments, and orthopedic challenges students pursuing professional courses. The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation proposes to procure 200 laptops.

sub_schemes.title: Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide walking sticks to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to enhance their mobility and independence.

sub_schemes.title: Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the marriage of daughters of registered construction workers by providing financial assistance of ₹61,000/- for their daughter’s marriage in a group marriage event.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship To Son And Daughter Of Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The "Scholarship to Son and Daughter of Differently Abled Persons" scheme in Tamil Nadu is a government initiative that aims to provide financial assistance to the children of differently abled individuals for their education.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITI’s
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Scholarship to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Government ITI's” was launched by the Dept. of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana in the year 2017-18. This scheme is implemented through Skill Development and Industrial Training Department, Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at RIMC, Dehradun, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces. The scheme is 100% funding from the State Plan Fund

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship For Transgender Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Scholarship for Transgender Students” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala for providing scholarships to Transgender students from 7th standard onwards studying in State Government/ Government aided/ Self Financing schools.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at Sainik School Imphal, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces.

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship (Above VIII Standard) - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Scholarship (Above VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to differently-abled students studying in government school/colleges/training centre

sub_schemes.title: Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The 'Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to purchase notebooks for differently-abled students studying in government school.

sub_schemes.title: Schemes Of HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation
sub_schemes.description: Social, educational and economic upliftment of the minority class people living below the poverty line of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers" is a Welfare Scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Dept. The scheme provides financial assistance to help mitigate the financial burden on the worker's family.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Registered Organizations/Government Organization/Non-Government Organizations/Institutions for Running Residential Facilities/Half Way Homes for Persons with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered organizations, Government organizations, and institutions for running residential facilities or halfway homes for Persons with Disabilities. The scheme provides financial support in the form of operational grants.

sub_schemes.title: Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme was launched in the year 2000 to provide financial assistance to scheduled caste families at the time of the death of a family member to cover funeral expenses, due to their poor economic conditions.

sub_schemes.title: Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes
sub_schemes.description: The "Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide education to destitute, deserted and abandoned children by giving free food, clothing, shelter and medical care.

sub_schemes.title: Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The 'Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide sewing machines to destitute, deserted women/widows, differently abled men & women to increase self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of per month to elderly individuals, widows, destitute women, differently-abled persons, primitive tribes, and HIV/AIDS patients. The scheme eliminates previous age restrictions and targets inclusivity by guaranteeing pensions to all eligible.

sub_schemes.title: Sarna /Jahersthan/Hadgadi & Masna Protection and Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Sarna / Jahersthan / Hadgadi & Masna Protection and Development" scheme by the Department of Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, & Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Jharkhand, aims to preserve & develop sacred tribal sites. The scheme facilitates fencing, infrastructure.......

sub_schemes.title: Sarothi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Sarothi Start-Up fund is an initiative that the Indian government of Assam has launched (2016-17) to encourage innovation and entrepreneurship in the state. Startups and entrepreneurs receive seed capital, working capital, and other forms of financial support through the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Sant Surdas Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, monthly financial assistance is provided to Persons with Disabilities aged between 0 and 17 years, who have a disability of more than 80% and are registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list.

sub_schemes.title: Santwana Scheme - Karnataka
sub_schemes.description: The "Santwana Scheme" offers loans to religious minority individuals whose houses or shops have been destroyed by natural calamities or communal violence. The scheme provides up to ₹5,00,000/- per unit, with 50% as a loan and 50% as a subsidy

sub_schemes.title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. Financial assistance of ₹600/- per month is given if there is only one beneficiary in the eligible family, and ₹900/- per month if there is one beneficiary in a family.

sub_schemes.title: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free laptops to visually impaired students pursuing courses. The scheme is provisioned for providing laptops to the visually impaired students to pursue professional courses after XII, under-graduate and post-graduate courses.

sub_schemes.title: Sugar Distribution Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Sugar Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide subsidized sugar to AAY households under NFSA, ensuring access to essential food commodities at affordable rates.

sub_schemes.title: Subsistence Allowance (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: "Subsistence Allowance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Veterans of the Second World War, Non-pensioners ESM above 60 years under "Below the Poverty Line (BPL)", and their widows.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy on Rehri alongwith (Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensil etc.) for the Fish/Fish Product Sale
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided for purchase of a handcart along with essential items such as stove, gas chulha, utensils, etc., for fish and fish product sales. A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize excellent work done by individuals and institutions in the field of disaster management including prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation.

sub_schemes.title: Student Welfare Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to economically weaker ST students to meet their emergency needs in special circumstances. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to ST students studying in Class 1 to 10 in cases of urgency or emergency.

sub_schemes.title: Student Housing Scheme for Students with Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, there is a provision to provide free housing facilities to a group of 5 disabled students, to motivate them for higher education, by providing accommodations to them. The accommodations are provided at a rental building.

sub_schemes.title: Stipends To Trainees In Industrial Training Institute
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Stipends to Trainees in Industrial Training Institute” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra for Scheduled Caste students in Industrial Training Institute.

sub_schemes.title: Rupashree Prakalpa
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to mitigate the financial difficulties faced by poor families in bearing the expenses of their daughters’ marriages. Under this scheme, a one-time financial grant of ₹25,000/- is provided to economically stressed families at the time of their adult daughters’ marriages.

sub_schemes.title: Samajik Mukti
sub_schemes.description: The government issued 'Samajik Mukti' (Social Freedom) cards to unorganised sector workers of the State for Provident Fund & Other Social Benefit scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Samarth-Respite Care Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Samarth (Respite Care) scheme, launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aims at setting up Samarth Centres for providing respite and residential care for the specified categories of Persons with Disability (PwD).

sub_schemes.title: Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana" for different age groups.

sub_schemes.title: Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support traditional faith healers by providing a monthly pension. Under this scheme, ₹1,500 is provided to each eligible traditional healer across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Parityakta Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under the Scheme, Madhya Pradesh government provides financial benefits to Be from a family living below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Initiative of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the Madhya Pradesh started the scheme "Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana" for the older age people of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridh Ashram Mai Nivaasarat Ant-vasi Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to the citizens who live in old age homes recognized by the Department of Social Justice.

sub_schemes.title: Salt Distribution Scheme Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: The "Salt Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, ensures subsidized salt is provided to AAY, PHH, and Green Cardholders, promoting accessibility and affordability.

sub_schemes.title: Sabooj Sathi
sub_schemes.description: The Sabooj Sathi Scheme is a student welfare initiative launched by the government of West Bengal, India, to provide bicycles to students in the state. Under the scheme, bicycles are distributed free of cost to students studying in government and government-aided schools from classes IX to XII.

sub_schemes.title: SMILE - Comprehensive Rehabilitation For Welfare Of Transgender Persons – Skill Development And Training
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to the person belonging to transgender person community by providing them market-oriented skills.

sub_schemes.title: Tirth Barat Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide government assistance for pilgrimage to the senior citizens & Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), who are residents of Chhattisgarh, to visit one or more of the various designated pilgrimage sites outside the state, once in their lifetime.

sub_schemes.title: Tiatr Competition
sub_schemes.description: The "Tiatr Competition" aims to encourage and promote the unique Goan theatre form of Tiatr. Participation in this scheme is open to Goan institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (with renewed registration). Entries are invited through press notes in local dailies.

sub_schemes.title: Tholkappiar Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Tholkappiar Award" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to writers and authors for outstanding research publications in Tamil literature.

sub_schemes.title: Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition
sub_schemes.description: The "Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition", organised by the Kala Academy under the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, aims to promote singing talent, preserve and revive the tradition of Tiatr songs, and encourage both traditional and new compositions that reflect Goa.

sub_schemes.title: The Tripura Tribal Folk Arts & Cultural (Financial Assistance) Rules, 2022
sub_schemes.description: The Tripura Tribal Folk Arts & Cultural (Financial Assistance) Scheme, 2022, is a government initiative to provide financial assistance to the government and non-government organizations to promote & preserve the traditional culture programme, exhibition in different tribal communities, & folk songs

sub_schemes.title: The Scheme Of State Award For Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The "The Scheme of State Award for Disabled" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, every year, the State Government felicitates awards to the Best Disabled Employees/Employers/Placement Agencies who have done outstanding work.

sub_schemes.title: The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this Scheme is to provide monthly Financial Assistance to females who have been rendered 40% disabled due to acid attack. This scheme is fully state-sponsored.

sub_schemes.title: The Meghalaya Victim Compensation Scheme, 2022
sub_schemes.description: The Meghalaya Victim Compensation Scheme, 2022 is a social welfare scheme introduced by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Under this scheme, financial assistance to the victim along with support services such as shelter, counseling, medical aid, legal assistance, education, etc.

sub_schemes.title: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to poor and destitute widows in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

sub_schemes.title: The Artist Welfare Fund Of Assam
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "The Artist Welfare Fund of Assam" is a scheme of financial asssistance by the Assam State Film (Finance and Development) Corporation, Department of Cultural Affairs, Govt. of Assam. The scheme extednds to the whole of Assam.

sub_schemes.title: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The aim of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to destitute, senior citizens who are without any means of subsistence and having no one to give financial support to them for their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the poorest and destitute women in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

sub_schemes.title: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

sub_schemes.title: Thatched House Repair Grant for Re-thatching & Repairs (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Thatched House Repair Grant for Re-thatching & Repairs" scheme, up to ₹40,000/- is provided to the registered ESM / Widows of ESM / Dependents of ESM every three years, for the re-thatching & repair of their house. The applicant should be receiving a Subsistence Allowance.

sub_schemes.title: Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme" welfare scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers financial assistance to registered construction workers who face temporary disability due to accidents or diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Term Loan Scheme (GMFDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the minority communities by providing financial assistance for agriculture and allied activities, small-scale businesses, craftsmanship, transport sector, traditional occupations, and service-based businesses/trades.

sub_schemes.title: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,200/- to male and female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.

sub_schemes.title: Tailoring Training To Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Widows/Destitute Women/Girls
sub_schemes.description: The aim of the scheme is to enable Scheduled Caste Widows/girls/destitute women for self-employment. A stipend of Rs.600/- P.M. and raw material costing Rs.300/- per month per trainee is given to a trainee for getting training from the nearest Kalyan Kendar run by this department.

sub_schemes.title: Tablet Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students of 12th Standard
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of ₹1,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Sweekruti: Assistance to Parents of Transgender Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the parents of transgender children to support them in successfully raising their children against societal intolerance, stigma, discrimination, and violence.

sub_schemes.title: Swayam Saksham Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to instil a sense of self-reliance among youth pursuing vocational education/training. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing various professional units

sub_schemes.title: Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1972, "Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs. The scheme provides the grant of pension to living freedom fighters and their families; if they are no more alive, and to the families or martyrs.

sub_schemes.title: Swasraya Scheme For Parents/Mothers Of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Swasraya Scheme for Parents/Mothers of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Swaran Jayanti Guru Darshan Yatra Scheme 2016
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Swaran Jayanti Guru Darshan Yatra Scheme 2016” was launched by the Tourism Department, Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016.

sub_schemes.title: Swahid Kushal Konwar Sarbajanin Briddha Pension Achoni
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 2nd October 2018, "Swahid Kushal Konwar Sarbajanin Briddha Pension Achoni" is a Pension Scheme by the Govt. of Assam. The objective of the scheme is to streamline the payment of old-age pensions and funds. The beneficiary will get a sum of ₹250/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: “Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana ” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The aim of the scheme is to provide social security to differently abled people aged five(5) years and above.

sub_schemes.title: Swami Vivekananda Assam Youth Empowerment
sub_schemes.description: Swami Vivekananda Assam Youth Empowerment (SVAYEM) Scheme is a flagship program by Govt. of Assam to provide financial support to the youths of Assam to take up income-generating activities in the manufacturing, trading, and service sector. This program was launched in the year 2017.

sub_schemes.title: Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Suraksha Laghu Evan Seemaant Vrddhajan Krshak Sammaan Penshan Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives by providing them with monthly financial assistance.

sub_schemes.title: Surgical Grant For The Prevention Of Disability
sub_schemes.description: The "Surgical Grant for the Prevention of Disability" scheme is started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE): Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide health Insurance coverage to all Transgender persons living in India to improve their health condition through proper treatment including sex re-assignment surgeries as well as medical support. The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations” was launched by the Rubber Board, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India to motivate tappers and retain them in the tapping job.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Transgender
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 1st August 2015, the scheme "Pension Scheme for Transgender" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- to the transgender residents of Tripura who have no source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Disabled Persons (Divyangjan)- DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department to provide financial assistance to individuals with disabilities. The primary objective is to provide financial benefits to eligible Divyangjan to cater to their basic needs. The scheme is targeted at Divyangjan aged between 18 to 59 years.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for the Journalists
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme for the Journalists" was launched by the Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give a monthly pension to retired journalists.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- per month to Leprosy Patients who are residents of Tripura.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹4,500/- to state agitators not imprisoned for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement, who are not eligible for any other government pension and are not employed in government service.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender
sub_schemes.description: The 'Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor transgender above 40 years of age who are unable to earn their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme - Folk Artist
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension to the registered folk artists.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to the person suffering from cancer.

sub_schemes.title: Retrofitted Petrol Scooters - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Retrofitted Petrol Scooters by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a retrofitted petrol scooter to orthopedically differently-abled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Residential School For Blinds
sub_schemes.description: The "Residential School for Blinds" have been established by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir for the protection, welfare, and education of the Blind. The school is located at Roop Nagar, near Fire Brigade Office, Muthi, Jammu, 180013. The intake capacity is 50 inmates.

sub_schemes.title: Rental Housing Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide rental housing to individuals and families from lower and middle-income groups, address housing shortages, prevent unauthorized settlements, and promote orderly urban development. It benefits Grade Third and Grade Fourth employees and eligible non-government individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Board provides financial assistance of ₹ 2,000/- to the registered worker as a relief during a natural calamity/pandemic. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.

sub_schemes.title: Relief to the Unregistered Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Relief to the Unregistered Workers" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F Dept. Telangana aimed to provide financial assistance to the dependents of unregistered building & construction workers who die in accidents at construction sites.

sub_schemes.title: Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides relief materials, which among other things include Feeding Charges, Subsidized Rice, Clothing Materials, Utensils, Transportation Charges (on arrival), Porterage and Transport (on repatriation), Cash Doles, Infrastructure Facilities (at camps), Electricity, Drinking Water, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Relief During Natural Calamities Such as Cyclone, Flood or Fire (Sainik Welfare)
sub_schemes.description: "Relief During Natural Calamities Such as Cyclone, Flood or Fire" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹40,000/- is provided to the registered ESM / Widows/Dependents of ESM as a relief during natural calamities.

sub_schemes.title: Reimbursement of College Fees for Scheduled Caste Students in Professional Colleges (Top 20)
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees is facilitated for students who have achieved marks above 75% in the Higher Secondary Course Examination and secured a place in the 'Top 20' Rank. The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on eligible students.

sub_schemes.title: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows
sub_schemes.description: “Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to encourage the children of widows to pursue Typewriting and Shorthand courses and facilitate the reimbursement of course fees.

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Marriage Incentives & Support
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is designed to assist Cured Leprosy Persons who face social and economic challenges in arranging marriages for their daughters.

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Assistance to Parents
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the parents of Cured Leprosy Persons in order to support such parents in successfully bringing up their children against societal intolerance, stigma, discrimination and violence.

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation Treatment For The Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The government of Meghalaya provides rehabilitation treatment for persons with disabilities under the "Disability Rehabilitation Scheme".

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation Assistance- Haryana Silicosis Board
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, silicosis-affected workers confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board will receive a one-time assistance of ₹5,00,000. If the worker dies before receiving the assistance, the amount will be payable to the widow or widower if married, or to one of the living parents if unmarried.

sub_schemes.title: Partial Disability Benefit for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Partial Disability Benefit for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides financial assistance is provided to the nominees/ dependents of a member, in case of his/her partial disability.

sub_schemes.title: Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for vehicle purchases in the transport sector for SEBC unemployed individuals. A loan is provided under the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides 50% of the pension amount or a maximum of ₹ 500/- to the family members of the deceased pensioner.

sub_schemes.title: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide national recognition, financial incentives, and professional encouragement to Indian citizens and institutions contributing significantly to telecom development and its application in sectors such as agriculture, health, education, and commerce.

sub_schemes.title: Panchayat Kalyan Kosh
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office.

sub_schemes.title: Palanhar Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Palanhar Yojana has been started by the state government of Rajasthan to benefit the orphan and needy children of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Paddy Procurement Scheme Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: The "Paddy Procurement Scheme" 2012-13" by the Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, ensures that farmers receive minimum support price for paddy procurement, preventing distress sales and supporting food security.

sub_schemes.title: PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: The "PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). It provides subsidized food grains to enhance their living conditions.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Petrol Subsidy To Persons With Disability
sub_schemes.description: Under the Petrol Subsidy To Persons With Disability scheme handicapped person using motorized vehicles are entitled to 50% subsidy on actual expenditure on the purchase of petrol/diesel subject to fulfillment of other conditions laid down under the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Higher Education For Persons With Special Needs
sub_schemes.description: The Persons with Disabilities Act 1995 indicates that differently-abled persons should have access to education at all levels. In the higher education sector, the University Grants Commission (UGC) is supporting universities and colleges in the country to involve in special education activities.

sub_schemes.title: Pension to the Persons who lost 100% eye sight
sub_schemes.description: “Pension to the Persons Who Lost 100% Eye Sight" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to the differently-abled persons who are 10 years and above in age and have 100% blindness.

sub_schemes.title: Personal Accident Relief for Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme 'Personal Accident Relief for Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Dept. for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons. In this scheme, accident relief is provided to differently abled persons up to a sum of ₹1,00,000/-(Death), & relief is given for loss of both legs/both hand...

sub_schemes.title: Personal Accident Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmers, agricultural laborers, and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Permanent Disability/ Death Benefit for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Permanent Disability/ Death Benefit for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides financial assistance is provided to the nominees/ dependents of a member, in case of his/her death or Permanent Disability.

sub_schemes.title: Permanent Disability Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Permanent Disability Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides pension to the registered beneficiary with at least 1 year of membership with the Board who becomes fully disabled.

sub_schemes.title: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, widows and destitute women aged 18 years and above are eligible for a pension if they are domiciles of Haryana and have been residing in the state for at least one year at the time of application submission.

sub_schemes.title: Pension to the Beneficiary Building Worker Who Has Completed 60 Years
sub_schemes.description: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides a monthly pension to workers who have completed 5 years of service as a registered beneficiary and reached 60.

sub_schemes.title: Pension to Indigent Sportspersons of Odisha
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme relating to "Pension to Indigent Sportspersons of Odisha" was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial support to sportspersons of yesteryears who are living in indigent conditions.

sub_schemes.title: Pension to Unmarried Poor, Incapacitated Women of Age 50 years and above
sub_schemes.description: The 'Pension to Unmarried Poor, Incapacitated Women of age 50 years and above' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension of ₹1,000/- to unmarried, poor, incapacitated women of age 50 years and above.

sub_schemes.title: Pension for Agitators Who were Jailed for 7 Days or Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹6,000 to agitators who were jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement and are unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.

sub_schemes.title: Pension for Journalists’ Family
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension for Journalists’ Family" was launched by the Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give a monthly pension to the wife of a deceased journalist pensioner.

sub_schemes.title: Pension To The Disabled Person
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the pension to the disabled person scheme is providing a pension to disabled persons is multifaceted, but generally centers around promoting social welfare, equity, and inclusivity.

sub_schemes.title: Pension To Widows And Destitute Women-Chandigarh
sub_schemes.description: Under the Pension To Widows And Destitute Women scheme To provide financial assistance to Widows and Destitute Women of Chandigarh.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement, after the Death of the Agitator
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹4,500/- to the dependents (husband/wife) of identified state agitators, excluding those jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand movement, who were not receiving any government pension or in government service.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that aims to provide a monthly pension to registered construction workers who have reached 60 years of age and is a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension Scheme" by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Himachal Pradesh provides registered beneficiaries with a minimum pension of ₹1,000/- per month upon reaching 60 years of age.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a member of the fund who has been working as a building worker for not less than three years shall on completion of sixty years of age be eligible for a pension of ₹3,250/- per month.

sub_schemes.title: Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive health care and financial assistance for medical treatments. It offers hospital services, medical reimbursements, and subsistence allowances for beedi, cine, and non-coal mine workers and their dependants.

sub_schemes.title: Janshree Bima Yojana for Khadi Artisans
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to Khadi artisans. Through this scheme, group insurance benefits are provided to Khadi artisans (spinners and weavers).

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body
sub_schemes.description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee for bringing the dead body of the registered migrant worker in case of death.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Pension-West Bengal
sub_schemes.description: The West Bengal government's Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department launched the "Widow Pension" scheme in 2010. This program aims to support widows facing economic hardship within the state.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance
sub_schemes.description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Government of West Bengal, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee in case of natural death/accidental death of the migrant worker.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability
sub_schemes.description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, that provides one-time assistance to the registered Migrant Worker in case of disability arising out of accidents during work.

sub_schemes.title: The Delhi Family Benefit Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- as a one-time lump sum benefit to families facing financial hardship due to the death of their primary breadwinner.

sub_schemes.title: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to school-going students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000/- to support their pre-matric education.

sub_schemes.title: National family Benefit Scheme-Himachal Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide one-time financial assistance to Below Poverty Line families in case of the death of the main earning member aged between 18 and 59 years.

sub_schemes.title: National Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disablities
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to implement various rehabilitation programs for persons with disabilities through the Community-Based Rehabilitation Worker (CBRW) network and to support their rehabilitation by providing assistive devices.

sub_schemes.title: National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to make Persons with Disabilities self-reliant by providing loan facilities through the Himachal Pradesh Minority Finance and Development Corporation (Channelizing Agency) within the State for establishing self-employment ventures.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up small-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems.

sub_schemes.title: Orunodoi 3.0
sub_schemes.description: Orunodoi, described as 'foremost bead' among the Ashtadash Mukutar Unnoyonee Maala was announced by then HFM in his Budget Speech 20-21. It envisages women empowerment, poverty alleviation and socio-economic inclusion of financially vulnerable women of the state through sustained financial assistanc

sub_schemes.title: Pension Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Pension Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides a monthly pension after completion of 60 years to the eligible registered member.

sub_schemes.title: Nirman Shramik Shiksha evam Kaushal Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide educational assistance and skill development support to registered construction workers and their dependent children to promote education, technical training, and employability.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Re-marriage Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support the rehabilitation of widows by encouraging marriage through a monetary incentive. It provides a grant to bona fide Himachali men (above 21 years) and women (above 18 years) at the time of marriage.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: Widow pension in Uttar Pradesh is a social welfare scheme by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to widows residing in the state. The scheme is administered by the Women Welfare Department of the state government.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Pension (CBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Pension (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- is given to the widow of a registered construction worker who is not receiving a similar benefit from any other Government/ Department/ Board/ Corporation /PSU.

sub_schemes.title: Widow Daughter Marriage Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Department of WCD, Delhi Government is implementing various Financial Assistance for the benefit of different sections through Financial Assistance Cell. Department of WCD is running Widow’s Daughter Marriage(WDM) for the benefit of widows/women in distress.

sub_schemes.title: Widow / Destitute Women Pension Scheme - Punjab
sub_schemes.description: Punjab State Government started a pension for widow and destitute women.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Pension
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides pension benefits to transport workers of the state upon reaching 60 years of age.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, beneficiaries, upon retirement or unfortunate demise, will have 50% of their last drawn amount transferred monthly to their families through a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Funeral Expenses
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides monetary support to help cover funeral costs in the unfortunate event of a beneficiary's demise.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Marriage
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial aid for the marriage of eligible beneficiaries or their dependent sons/daughters (up to two marriages).

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries every 5 years to support the purchase of spectacles, ensuring better eye health and vision.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation
sub_schemes.description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Government of West Bengal, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee of the worker for cremation when the worker dies.

sub_schemes.title: Welfare Services for Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide welfare support and financial assistance for women in distress, including widows, victims of violence, trafficked women, and economically disadvantaged women.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Individual Artisans
sub_schemes.description: “Grant to Individual Artisans” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal, aims to create, support and sustain an enabling ecosystem for strengthening creativity and capacity of the artisans.

sub_schemes.title: Welfare Services for Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide support, rehabilitation, and empowerment to persons with disabilities through financial assistance for healthcare, education, vocational training, and assistive devices.

sub_schemes.title: Welfare Services for Other Socially Disabled Persons (Senior Citizens & Destitute)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and financial assistance to elderly persons and socially disadvantaged individuals lacking family or financial support.

sub_schemes.title: Welfare Services for Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and development support to vulnerable children such as orphans, street children, child labourers, and children affected by HIV/AIDS. It focuses on shelter, education, health, and rehabilitation services.

sub_schemes.title: Walking Device - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The 'Walking Device by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a rollator/walker to orthopedically differently abled children having difficulties in walking.

sub_schemes.title: Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" is an initiative by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation (KMDC) to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities.

sub_schemes.title: Vocational Training in Tribal Areas
sub_schemes.description: The scheme will be implemented for the benefit of the Scheduled Tribes as well as PTGs and can be taken up anywhere in the country but priority will be given to remote tribal areas, areas inhabited by particularly vulnerable tribes, and areas affected by extremist activities.

sub_schemes.title: Vocational Training For VJNT And SBC Candidates Studying In Government Industrial Training Institute
sub_schemes.description: The State Government of Maharashtra has introduced in 2003-04 the scheme to create self-employment for unemployed youths and students of VJNT and SBC who apply for a Vocational Training.

sub_schemes.title: Vocational Training Of Destitute Women And Adolescent Girls
sub_schemes.description: "Vocational Training of Destitute Women and Adolescent Girls" is a scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, a 6-months training is provided in the Trades such as Tailoring & Cutting, Embroidery, and Computer. This is a State Sponsored Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Viswakarma Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme “Viswakarma Pension” was launched by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala to give the pension to traditional workers of Viswakarma Communities.

sub_schemes.title: Vivah Sahayata Yojana - Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: Under the labor department of Madhya Pradesh State, this scheme "Vivah Sahayata Yojana" was started in 2018.

sub_schemes.title: Vivah Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Vivah Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) rupees for the marriage of two children / female members of the family.

sub_schemes.title: Vivah Sahayata Yojana (Labor Welfare Board Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, ₹15,000 is provided per case for the marriage of a daughter (above 18 years of age) of workers/employees working in institutions covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund Act, 1982, or to a female worker herself.

sub_schemes.title: Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu Par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana" for labor workers.

sub_schemes.title: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

sub_schemes.title: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.

sub_schemes.title: Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana" for unorganized worker on 17 January 2018.

sub_schemes.title: Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. It provides production incentives to Khadi spinners and weavers with category-wise differential assistance rates.

sub_schemes.title: Vikaas-Day Care Scheme For Person with Disability Children
sub_schemes.description: Vikaas is a Day care scheme, primarily to expand the range of opportunities available to a person with disability attaining the age of 10 years for enhancing interpersonal and vocational skills as they are on a transition to higher age groups.

sub_schemes.title: Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to honor state agitators who became permanently disabled and bedridden during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement by providing them with monthly financial assistance of ₹20,000/-.
