sub_schemes.title: Vidyasiri food And Accommodation Scholarship Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Vidyasiri-Food and Accommodation Scholarship Scheme (VFAS) is a government initiative in Karnataka that provides financial assistance to students belonging to backward classes pursuing post-matric courses in recognized institutions. Scheme offers a monthly stipend of Rs. 1,500 for10 months

sub_schemes.title: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of widow women.

sub_schemes.title: Veerjyoti Puraskars
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize and award women and girls in the State of Goa who have shown exceptional bravery and courage against atrocities, violence, and/or harassment. It provides a cash prize of ₹20,000/- and a scroll/citation to two awardees annually.

sub_schemes.title: Vasantrao Naik Merit Awards To The Vjnt Students Who Came First In State Or First In Board Of 10th And 12th Standard Examination
sub_schemes.description: Vasantrao Naik Merit Awards to the VJNT students who came First in State or First in Board of 10th and 12th Standard Examination Scheme Announced by Government Of Maharashtra to Scheme to motivate VJNT students for Higher Education.

sub_schemes.title: Vayomadhuram Scheme For Providing Glucometer To Senior Citizens
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Vayomadhuram Scheme for Providing Glucometer to Senior Citizens” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Vasantrao Naik Tanda / Basti Development Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Vasantrao Naik Tanda/Basti Development" is implemented by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The scheme provides essential amenities to the Tandas and Bastis of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes. The scheme focuses on improving access to drinking water, electrification, latrines, drainage, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Varishtha Bunkar Samman Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Varishtha Bunkar Samman Yojana" aims to encourage senior weavers in the handloom sector. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹11,000/- to active weaver members who are 60 years or older and have produced the maximum cloth in their district.

sub_schemes.title: Varnam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Varnam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala to provide financial assistance to Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma/ PG courses through distance education.

sub_schemes.title: Various Awards to Individuals/Organizations who have made Outstanding Contributions in the Field of Social Welfare
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize and honor the exceptional work carried out by individuals and organizations in the field of social welfare, particularly benefiting the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. Under this scheme, awards along with financial assistance are provided as a mark of appreciation.

sub_schemes.title: Vanchit Ikai Samooh aur Vargon ki Aarthik Sahayata Yojana (VISVAS) for Self-Help Groups
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide the benefit of a lower rate of interest to eligible Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and individual beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and Safai Karamcharis (including identified Manual Scavengers, Waste Pickers, and their dependents).

sub_schemes.title: Vahli Dikri Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Vahli Dikri Yojana by the Government of Gujarat under the Women and Child Development Department . The scheme supports girl children by providing financial aid, free education, and insurance, encouraging higher education and reducing dropout rates.

sub_schemes.title: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana focuses on integrated, holistic, and inclusive development of tribal communities. It aims at creation of quality social and civil infrastructure, and sustainable livelihood, employment & entrepreneurship in tribal areas such that the income of every tribal family doubles.

sub_schemes.title: Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows/dependents of soldiers & paramilitary personnel who were martyred in wars, border clashes, or internal security operations. Under this scheme, a one-time grant of ₹10 lakh is provided, subject to eligibility criteria.

sub_schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Uttar Pradesh has introduced an old-age pension scheme for the benefit of the senior citizens in the state. Under this scheme, eligible senior citizens will be provided with financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension.

sub_schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (Genearal)
sub_schemes.description: "Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (General)" scheme provides financial assistance to children in Uttar Pradesh who face various hardships.

sub_schemes.title: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to senior citizens in the UT. The scheme covers persons above 60 years of age who do not have any source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Specially Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: ​The scheme aims to provide a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 to persons with disabilities, including those who are deaf, mute, blind, intellectually disabled, or orthopedically impaired, with a disability level of 40% or more and without any source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Widows
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to widows in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It covers widows who have not remarried and have no source of income.

sub_schemes.title: Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to promote educational inclusivity among minority OBC students by providing financial assistance of ₹900/- for uniforms.

sub_schemes.title: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Abandoned Ladies/Destitute
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to abandoned ladies & destitute women in the UT. The scheme covers women who have been divorced or abandoned by their husband or relatives, have not remarried, & are without any source of income or have only a nominal income.

sub_schemes.title: Uniform Assistance To SC Students
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Gujarat launched a financial Assistance scheme for the student who comes under the scheduled caste.

sub_schemes.title: Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides ₹900/- for three pairs of uniforms to students from NT/DNT Castes in government and aided primary schools.

sub_schemes.title: Unemployment Allowance to Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The Unemployment Allowance To Disabled Person scheme provides financial support to unemployed handicapped individuals who have been waiting for employment for an unduly long period.

sub_schemes.title: Unemployment Allowance To The Educated Unemployed Persons With Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: "Unemployment Allowance to the Educated Unemployed Persons With Disabilities" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Govt. of Manipur. The payment of unemployment allowance will be applicable to all categories of disabilities except Intellectual Disabilities as specified in RoPwD Act 2016.

sub_schemes.title: Unemployment Allowance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced Unemployment Allowance Scheme to provide allowance to eligible educated unemployed youth of Himachal, to enable them to sustain themselves for a certain period.

sub_schemes.title: Unemployment Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Unemployment Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide unemployment allowance to differently-abled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Umbrella Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free umbrellas to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, to protect them from rain and sunlight.

sub_schemes.title: Udyogini Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Udyogini is an innovative scheme to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment, mainly through trade and the service sector. It also provides for a subsidy on loans for undertaking business activities/ micro enterprises through banks, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt/sbc Students Studying In High Schools
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Maharashtra introduced Tuition fees and Examination fees to Vimukta Jati Nomadic Tribes (VJNT)/ Special Backward Classes (SBC) students studying in High Schools scheme to improve interest of VJNT/SBC students.

sub_schemes.title: Tripura Scheme For Incentive To Girl Child
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide an incentive to girl children. Through this scheme, an incentive is offered to the mother of the girl child or her legal guardian on a monthly basis.

sub_schemes.title: Tricycles - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The Department launched the 'Tricycles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute tricycles to deserving orthopedically differently abled persons affected by both lower limbs for their easy mobility

sub_schemes.title: Tribals Development Plan: Subsidy for Purchase of Motorcycle
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist tribal families in Goa to purchase motorcycles for self-employment by offering a government subsidy, thereby promoting economic self-reliance among low-income households.

sub_schemes.title: Tribals Development Plan: Motor Driving Training [Light & Heavy Vehicles]
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide full financial coverage for motor driving training, including courses for Light Motor Vehicles and Heavy Motor Vehicles, specifically recognizing Goa’s future in the transport sector. It benefits eligible Tribal families in Goa whose annual income is below ₹1,20,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Transgender Utthan Kosh – Identity Card for Transgender
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to identify transgender persons and issuing identity cards to them. This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposes, including obtaining a ration card, Aadhaar card, birth certificate, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Transgender Pension Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Transgender Pension Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh for the upliftment and support of transgender persons.

sub_schemes.title: Training Of Motor Driving To VJNT, SBS & OBC
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme that provides light and heavy motor driving, and conductor training to the needy Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes, and Other Backward Class (VJNT, OBC & SBC) candidates.

sub_schemes.title: Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons scheme offers vocational courses for specially-abled individuals, funded by the Government of Mizoram. The centers provide courses in tailoring for females and tailoring/shoemaking for males, with a monthly stipend of ₹250 for the training period.

sub_schemes.title: Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations
sub_schemes.description: The "Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations" scheme provides financial assistance to non-reserved category students who are undergoing training in recognized institutions for competitive recruitment examinations.

sub_schemes.title: Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on January 1, 2018, the "Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme" provides financial assistance to construction workers registered under the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for the purchase of tools and equipment related to their work.

sub_schemes.title: Toposili Bandhu (Old Age Pension) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Toposili Bandhu" (Old Age Pension) scheme was initiated by the Backward Classes Welfare Department and Tribal Development Department of West Bengal Government.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme To Support Orphan Child/Children Of Widows Belonging To Scheduled Tribe Community
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide crucial financial support for food, clothing, and shelter to children of widows and orphans belonging to the ST community Benefits include a monthly fixed maintenance allowance of ₹1,500/- for a widow’s child or ₹2,000/- for an orphan.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme Of Assistance To Persons With Disabilities For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids And Appliances
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme of Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances" is a scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the PwD is provided with Financial Assistance for the Purchase/Fitting of Hearing Aids, Artificial Limbs, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme Of Assistance To Disabled Persons For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids/Appliances
sub_schemes.description: The main objective of the Scheme is to assist needy disabled persons in procuring durable, sophisticated, scientifically manufactured, modern, standard aids and appliances that can promote their physical, social and psychological rehabilitation by reducing the effect of disabilities.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Waiver Of Loans To Handloom And Powerloom Sector
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Welfare Of Children In Need Of Care And Protection
sub_schemes.description: "Scheme for Welfare of Children in Need of Care and Protection" is a Social Welfare Scheme by the Directorate of Women & Child Development, Govt. of Goa. The objective of this scheme is to assist the Voluntary Organizations that cater to the needs of destitute and orphans up to the age of 18 years.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists
sub_schemes.description: A pension scheme by MoC improves the financial and socio-economic status of the old artists and scholars who have contributed significantly in their specialized fields. Still, due to old age, they have to lead a miserable life or are in penury condition.

sub_schemes.title: State Reward to the Recipient of National Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "State Reward to the Recipient of National Award" has been designed by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa as a token of appreciation in order to support and promote the local artists, who have received recognition at the National and International levels.

sub_schemes.title: State Marriage Assistance Scheme For Poor Girls
sub_schemes.description: A social welfare scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Government of Jammu & Kashmir, for Poor Girls of Marriageable Age who belong to either AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or PHH (Priority Households) ration card holder families. The scheme is operational in all the districts across the UT.

sub_schemes.title: State Pre-metric Scholarship For Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The "State Pre-metric Scholarship for Disabled" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students with disability (SwDs) to pursue education. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.

sub_schemes.title: State Programme For Rehabilitation Of Persons With Disabilities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “State Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities” is a state sector ongoing scheme implemented for the welfare and providing rehabilitation services to disabled persons of the state under the Person with Disabilities Act 1995.

sub_schemes.title: State Post-metric Scholarship For Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The "State Post-metric Scholarship for Disabled" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students with disability (SwDs) to pursue higher education.

sub_schemes.title: State Marriage Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The 'State Marriage Assistance Scheme' offers one-time financial aid to female beneficiaries from families holding AAY or PHH ration cards, with the amount directly credited to their Aadhaar-linked bank accounts. Additionally, divyangjan beneficiaries also receive financial assistance.

sub_schemes.title: State Level Awards for Divyang Persons
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, a cash prize of ₹8,000/-, along with a medal and a certificate of appreciation, is awarded to outstanding individuals in categories such as disabled employees, outstanding sportspersons, and best self-employed service providers.

sub_schemes.title: State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, free residential, food, clothing, and healthcare are provided to destitute elderly individuals above 60 years in state-run residential facilities.

sub_schemes.title: State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide rice at subsidized rates to yellow ration card holders in the state, under which 7.50 kg of rice is distributed to each card holder every month at the rate of ₹11.00 per kg.

sub_schemes.title: State Award for the Welfare of the Handicapped
sub_schemes.description: “State Award for the Welfare of the Handicapped” was launched by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. The individuals and institutions are conferred awards on 3rd December every year to encourage them to become economically productive to serve the cause of the Persons with Disability.

sub_schemes.title: National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates. Under the scheme, the eligible households are entitled to 5 kg of food grains per person per month.

sub_schemes.title: National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana - Pink Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive 35 kg of food grains and 1 kg of sugar per ration card at subsidized rates.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme- Bihar
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the bereaved family in the case of the sudden death of the earning member (breadwinner) of the family, provided the family is living below the poverty line (BPL).

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme - Uttar Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: National Family Benefit Scheme or NBFS was launched by the Uttar Pradesh state government to provide financial assistance to those families that are unable to earn the necessities in life.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme- Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families upon the death of the primary breadwinner (main earning member of the family) to help them cope with immediate financial hardships.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme - Gujarat
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide social security to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Under the scheme, a one-time lump sum assistance of ₹20,000 is provided to the widow or unmarried daughter of the deceased, if the primary breadwinner, aged between 18 and 59 years, passes away.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme - Sikkim
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)” was launched in 2016 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, a lump sum amount of ₹ 30,000/- as financial assistance is provided to the bereaved household in the event of the death of the "Primary breadwinner"

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme (Punjab)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "National Family Benefit Scheme (Punjab)" by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children, Government of Punjab, provides a lump sum assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the bereaved household in the event of the death of their breadwinner.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme (Maharashtra)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "National Family Benefit Scheme (Maharashtra)" is a social welfare scheme by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra. Under this scheme, ₹20,000/-. is provided to the family in the event of the death of their primary breadwinner.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "National Family Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir provides ₹20,000/- to ensure social security for bereaved families living below the poverty line in case of death of their breadwinner.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Benefit Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A family welfare scheme under the umbrella scheme ‘National Social Assistance Programme’ (NSAP) by MoRD. In this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the bereaved households in case of the death of the primary breadwinner irrespective of the cause of death.

sub_schemes.title: National Family Assistance Scheme- Chhattisgarh
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the bereaved household in the case of the natural, unnatural, or accidental death of the primary breadwinner of a family living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).

sub_schemes.title: National Family Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "National Family Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides ₹20,000/- to ensure social security for bereaved families living below the poverty line in case of death of their breadwinner.

sub_schemes.title: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjanon Ke Sashaktikaran Men Karyrat Sarveshrestha Sansthan (Private Organization, NGO)
sub_schemes.description: The "Divangjano ke Shashaktikaran Mein Karyrat Sarveshrestha Sansthan" award is given by DoEPwD to an organization working for the empowerment of Persons with Disabilities for a minimum period of 10 years after registration under Society Act/ Trust Act / Section 8 of Companies Act 2013.

sub_schemes.title: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Placement Agency
sub_schemes.description: The "Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Placement Agency" award is given by DoEPwD to the placement agency of PwDs (excluding Govt./State Govt./local bodies). The ceremony of the National Awards is held at Vigyan Bhawan. The National Awards are conferred by the Hon'ble President / Vice President.

sub_schemes.title: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Niyoktha
sub_schemes.description: The "Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Niyoktha" award is given by DoEPwD to the outstanding employers of the disabled under: 1. Government organization. 2. Public Sector Undertaking or Autonomous Body or Local Government Body. 3. Private or Non-Governmental Organization.

sub_schemes.title: National Award for Individual Excellence
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to recognize and encourage individuals working for the empowerment of persons with disabilities, including those covered under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

sub_schemes.title: Nari Niketans
sub_schemes.description: The "Nari Niketans" were established in 1976 by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir wherein deserted /destitute ladies/ widows having no means of livelihood are given admissions. There are seven Nari Niketan in Jammu & Kashmir. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, wedding programs are conducted according to the rituals being practiced in various communities and religions. Another objective of the scheme is to abolish the unwanted and extravagance in wedding ceremonies

sub_schemes.title: Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to distribute 15 Kg of rice per month or equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the differently abled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Free Distribution of Blankets and Chappals to Senior Citizen
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Free Distribution of Blankets and Chappals to Senior Citizen" was launched by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to enable the poor senior citizens, aged 60 years and above and residing in Puducherry, to receive blankets and chappals.

sub_schemes.title: Free Cycles to SC Girl Students Studying in Standard IX (Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana)
sub_schemes.description: The “Free Cycles to SC girl students studying in Standard IX” scheme is administered by the Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. Under this scheme, free bicycles are given to scheduled caste girl students who are studying in Stand

sub_schemes.title: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
sub_schemes.description: To provide high-quality free coaching to economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and eligible beneficiaries of the PM CARES Children Scheme for competitive exams in public and private sector employment and admission into professional courses.

sub_schemes.title: Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya)
sub_schemes.description: The Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya) is being implemented by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa to provide temporary/substitute care for children in difficult circumstances, whose parents are unable to care for them due to illness, death, and desertion of parent, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Foreign Education Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The "Foreign Education Scheme" provides financial assistance for non-reserved category students pursuing higher education abroad after Standard 12.

sub_schemes.title: Palanhaar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and financial assistance to children aged 0 to 18 years requiring special care and supervision in Rajasthan. It ensures their upbringing, education, and overall development through recognized guardians called “Palanhaar”.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Scheme-SC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities and financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students of Rajasthan to support their education. It offers ₹2,000/- per student per month for hostel-related expenses to ensure better learning opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Scheduled Caste students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-OBC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Other Backward Class(OBC) students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SBC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Specially Backward Class (SBC) students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Scheme-ST
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities and financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan to support their education. It offers ₹2,000/- per student per month for hostel-related expenses to ensure better learning opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-General
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to General category students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Scheme - Cleaner Class
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities and financial assistance to Safai Karmi community students of Rajasthan to support their education. It offers ₹2,000/- per student per month for hostel-related expenses to ensure better learning opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-ST
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Resdential School Scheme-ST
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality education to ST students in a clean and educational environment through residential schools established with financial assistance from KFW Germany and the State Government.

sub_schemes.title: Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide insurance benefits in cases of natural death, accidental death, and disability to BPL and Aastha Card holders.

sub_schemes.title: Resdential School Scheme-Nishkarmaniya Pashupalak
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality education to students belonging to the Nishkarmaniya Pashupalak community in a clean and educational environment through residential schools established with financial assistance from KFW Germany and the State Government.

sub_schemes.title: Resdential School Scheme-SBC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality education to SBC students in a clean and educational environment through residential schools established with financial assistance from KFW Germany and the State Government.

sub_schemes.title: Resdential School Scheme-SC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality education to SC students in a clean and educational environment through residential schools established with financial assistance from KFW Germany and the State Government.

sub_schemes.title: Residential School Scheme - Bhikshavriti aur Avanchaniyevrati Main Lipt
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality education to students belonging to the beggary and undesirable activities (Bhikshavrati aur Avanchaniyevrati community) in a clean and educational environment through the residential schools.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Policy - Funeral Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide funeral assistance to the dependents of a Pneumoconiosis victim.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Policy – Provision for Sustenance of Family
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide sustenance support to eligible families affected by Silicosis and offer widow pension to wife and/or benefits under Palanhar.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Policy – Pneumoconiosis Rehabilitation Pension
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide rehabilitation pension support to individuals suffering from Silicosis.

sub_schemes.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500/- through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to eligible women in Delhi.

sub_schemes.title: Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: “Jai Johar (Old Age Pension)” is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development Dept, Govt of West Bengal. The scheme is aimed at the ST residents of West Bengal of the age of 60 years and above. A monthly pension of ₹ 1,000/- is transferred to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a unique family identification system in Rajasthan through the Jan Aadhaar Card, ensuring easy, transparent, and simplified delivery of government scheme benefits to residents.

sub_schemes.title: National Startup Awards
sub_schemes.description: The National Startup Awards by Startup India aims to recognize and reward outstanding startups and ecosystem enablers building innovative products or solutions and scalable enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: National Metallurgist Award
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, outstanding metallurgical contributions are recognized, and excellence in operations, R&D, waste management, and energy conservation is promoted.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in pig farming by providing a one-time capital subsidy of up to ₹30 lakh to eligible entrepreneurs and organizations to establish breeder farms.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme aims to enhance per-animal productivity, reduce inbreeding, and minimize sexually transmitted diseases in pigs. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing semen processing labs at government pig farms.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Establishment of Entrepreneurship for Breed Development of Rural Poultry
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in rural poultry farming. Through this scheme, a 50% capital subsidy is provided for establishing Parent Farms, Rural Hatcheries, and Brooder cum Mother Units.

sub_schemes.title: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Infrastructure & Technology Support: URBAN HAAT" is introduced is to set up a permanent marketing infrastructure in towns/ metropolitan cities to provide direct marketing facilities to handicrafts artisans/handloom weavers, enabling them to sell their products to wider target audience.

sub_schemes.title: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
sub_schemes.description: In the scheme "Infrastructure and Technology Support: EMPORIA" assistance would be provided for the setting up of emporia. These would be set up in commercially viable locations in the implementing agencies' own/rented buildings.

sub_schemes.title: National Geoscience Awards
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to honour individuals and teams for extraordinary achievements and outstanding contributions in the field of mineral discovery & exploration, fundamental / applied geosciences, mining and allied areas.

sub_schemes.title: Gujarat Textile Policy: Interest Subsidy (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.title: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance for Quality Certification
sub_schemes.description: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

sub_schemes.title: Group Supply Of Goats And Sheep
sub_schemes.description: Group supply of goats and sheep refers to the practice of selling or distributing goats and sheep in groups, rather than as individual animals. In Maharashtra, this practice is common among farmers, livestock traders, and cooperative organizations.

sub_schemes.title: Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the adoption of rooftop solar energy among domestic consumers in Uttarakhand by providing financial support and enabling them to generate clean, renewable electricity, reduce their electricity bills through net metering.

sub_schemes.title: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.

sub_schemes.title: Green Business Scheme - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹2.00 lakhs are provided to Scheduled Caste residents of Haryana for undertaking income-generating activities that help mitigate the greenhouse effect, such as e-rickshaws, compressed air vehicles, solar energy gadgets, polyhouses, and similar eco-friendly ventures.

sub_schemes.title: Grants Provisioned under Uttarakhand Tourism Policy, 2023
sub_schemes.description: The aims to promote sustainable tourism development in the state by encouraging private and institutional investment in the tourism sector through targeted financial incentives and subsidies.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)
sub_schemes.description: The SWAWLAMBHAN Scheme by the Govt. of Goa provides financial assistance to Mahila Mandals/Self-Help Groups for training/orientation for members of the Mahila Mandal/Self-Help Groups for generating their own activity for self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges
sub_schemes.description: "Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges"reimburses payments made to Consultancy and certification agencies towards acquiring such Quality Certification subject to a ceiling of ₹ 2,00,000/- for National level certification and ₹ 10,00,000/- for International level Certification.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme
sub_schemes.description: “Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme” is for the educational institutes in Goa, affiliated with a recognized public university. They can avail of a one-time grant towards capital expenses for setting up an incubator within their institute campuses.

sub_schemes.title: Gramodhyog Vikas Kendra
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide infrastructure facilities at village level to artisans through Common Facility Centers. Registered Non-Governmental Organizations, cooperative societies and trusts receive financial assistance up to ₹13,00,000/- for building infrastructure, training, equipment, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for developing the logistics and warehousing industry in Goa. It offers a capital subsidy of 10% or 15% (up to ₹50,00,000/- yearly) towards fixed asset investment for eligible logistics and warehousing entities.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial allowance for upgrading transportation infrastructure by installing tracking devices on goods carriers. It offers a reimbursement of 50% of the installation expenditure, capped at ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per device, to eligible entities.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support environmentally sustainable industrial development while accelerating investment in Goa. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement equal to 50% of the expenses incurred for establishing a Quality Management System, capped at ₹5,00,000/- per Entity.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Logistics Management Software
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance operational efficiency in logistics and warehousing by subsidizing the cost of purchasing and installing Logistics Management Software. Eligible entities can receive a one-time reimbursement of 50% of the expenditure, capped at ₹2,00,000/- per installation.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Charges
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing Stamp Duty and Registration Charges paid by prospective developers engaged in the establishment of Logistics and Warehousing projects. The scheme provides 100% reimbursement, capped at ₹10,00,000/- for Stamp Duty.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Electricity Duty
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. This component offers a 100% annual reimbursement of electricity duty, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000/-, to eligible Cold Chain Units.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Skill Development
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides reimbursement of 50% of the cost incurred for skill upgradation and training manpower, limited to a maximum of ₹5,000/- per person employed in the Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans
sub_schemes.description: The subsidy aims to support the logistics and warehousing sector by reimbursing 50% of the annual interest paid on construction loans. The benefit is capped at ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs) annually per project and is available for up to 05 consecutive years for eligible entities.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008
sub_schemes.description: "Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008" aimed to promote industrial growth, revive sick units, and provide employment to local youths. Additional subsidies and incentives were given to eligible manufacturing units, with a focus on local employment and industrial development.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme, 2008
sub_schemes.description: "Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme" aimed to encourage industrial units to obtain certifications and patents for quality standards. It provided financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000/- to eligible industries and service sectors.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Goa State Export Market Development Scheme" encouraged Goan industries to improve export markets and support them in establishing their goods firmly in the export market. It provided interest-free loans up to ₹5,00,000/- for participating in exhibitions and market study tours abroad.

sub_schemes.title: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to boost self-employment in Goa and subsidize Capital Investment to encourage the creation of fixed assets. The scheme provides a 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment to individuals, partnership firms, or groups of individuals who have availed loans for approved self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.

sub_schemes.title: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.

sub_schemes.title: Generator Subsidy
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Generator Subsidy" is introduced with the objective of assisting all new and existing Micro, Small, and Medium Manufacturing Enterprises through a subsidy of 25% on the cost of the generator purchased (up to 320 KVA capacity), subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000.

sub_schemes.title: Gatidhara Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance of Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance of Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide subsidy for the investment made in Gross Fixed Capital investment (GFCI).

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Quality Certification
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance of Interest Subsidy” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to extend support to MSME to get quality certification to introduce quality products in competitive markets.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Zed Certification
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Zed Certification” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, was introduced to urge industries, especially (MSMEs), to manufacture goods in the country with “Zero Defects”.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Saving In Consumption Of Energy And Water
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Saving In Consumption Of Energy And Water” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, DNH & DD, aims to provide assistance to the existing/ new Enterprise for taking action for saving in consumption of Energy and Water.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance To Small And Medium Enterprises (SME) For Raising Of Capital Through SME Exchange
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance SME For Raising Of Capital Through SME Exchange” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide One-time assistance of expenditure incurred on raising of fund through SME Exchange.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Capital Investment In Solar Power Generation
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Capital Investment In Solar Power Generation” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, by the Dept. of Industries, DNH & DD, aims to encourage MSMEs to use Solar Power through providing Capital subsidy for setting up of Solar Power Plant for generation of power.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Handicraft Artisans: Assistance For Capital Investment For The Handloom And Handicrafts Artisans Of The U.T. Requiring Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Machinery Or Raw Materials
sub_schemes.description: This is a sub-scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)”, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, that aims to provide financial assistance for purchase of machinery or raw materials for development of their business.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Handicraft Artisans: Assistance For Capital Investment To Uplift The Economic Condition Of Artisans/ Persons
sub_schemes.description: This is a sub-scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)”, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, that aims to provide additional tools/equipment to SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities to generate adequate income and self-employment.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Assistance To Setup Large/Mega/Ultra-Mega Tourism Projects
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to attract high-value private investment for developing Large, Mega, and Ultra-mega tourism projects in the state. It offers financial assistance of up to 30% of the capital investment to investors who meet minimum investment thresholds and generate employment for Madhya Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Cottage Industries: Financial Assistance To Cottage Industries
sub_schemes.description: “Financial Assistance To Cottage Industries'' under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)”, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide financial assistance to Cottage Industries on the term loan taken through banks.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Entrepreneurship Under Skill Development
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Entrepreneurship Under Skill Development” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, DNH & DD, aims to provide assistance to budding entrepreneurs and their staffs to undergo Entrepreneurship /Management training.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Patent Registration /Trade Mark Registration
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Patent Registration/ Trade Mark Registration” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to extend support for obtaining Patent Registration/ Trade Mark Registration.

sub_schemes.title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Participation In Industrial Exhibitions Abroad
sub_schemes.description: “Assistance For Participation In Industrial Exhibitions Abroad” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, by the Dept. of Industries, DNH & DD, aims to promote the Products and Services of the territory abroad and their businesses to expand the customer base all over the world.

sub_schemes.title: Internet Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2018, the "Internet Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "IT Policy Schemes" by the Dept of IT, Govt of Goa. The objective is to provide Internet Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa. 25% reimbursement on high-speed bandwidth, subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000 per annum.

sub_schemes.title: International Cooperation Scheme- Capacity Building of First Time MSE Exporters
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering export market by providing reimbursement of various costs incurred by first time MSE exporters on export shipments.

sub_schemes.title: International Cooperation Scheme: Market Development Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering the export market by facilitating their participation in international exhibitions/fairs/conferences/seminars/buyer-seller meets abroad.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage SC/ST entrepreneurs to establish micro or small-scale service enterprises & to expand, diversify, or modernize their existing units. Under this scheme, a loan amount ranging from a min. of ₹20.00 lakhs to a max. of ₹1,000.00 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4%.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2008
sub_schemes.description: "Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2008" boosted economic growth by providing interest subsidies to Micro and Small Enterprises. The scheme offered financial incentives to new enterprises, making their operations more viable and promoting industrial growth.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subvention Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide institutional credit for capital investments at reasonable interest rates and is implemented through the Karnataka State Financial Corporation (KSFC) in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. It provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan (up to ₹25,00,000/- per year, or ₹27,50,000/- for women/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants) to eligible industries.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Smaller Business Units
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2018, the "Internet Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "Information Technology Policy Schemes" by the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. The objective and the scope of this scheme is to provide Internet Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa.

sub_schemes.title: Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme”, the projects which show immense promise and potential will be eligible for a grant of 30% of the loan interest amount, for the purpose of repayment of the interest component of a loan availed.

sub_schemes.title: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Reimbursement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: “Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme” is a part of the Startup Policy 2017. The objective of the policy is to make Goa an aspirational geographical and human resource base for startups. The objective is to invite the best entrepreneurial minds and build a robust startup ecosystem.

sub_schemes.title: Intellectual Property Right Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Intellectual Property Right Scheme offers legal and intellectual property filing support including patents, trademarks, copyrights, designs, geographical indications (GI) etc.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice Board, Department of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Commerce.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: Karnataka (Ha.) and other States
sub_schemes.description: To motivate growers in Karnataka and other states to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseased, old, and senile plantations, and to promote area expansion under cultivation.

sub_schemes.title: Installation of Ropeway Infrastructure for Transport in Inaccessible Tourist Places or Forest Areas
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance connectivity in inaccessible tourist and forest areas by installing ropeways. It provides a Capital Investment Subsidy of 40% up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to private investors establishing ropeway infrastructure with a minimum investment of ₹1,00,00,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Innovations for Defence Excellence
sub_schemes.description: Aimed at creation of an ecosystem to foster innovation and technology development in Defence and Aerospace by engaging Industries (incl MSMEs, start-ups, individual innovators R&D institutes, academia) and provide them grants and other supports to carry out R&D innovation for adoption in D&A Sector

sub_schemes.title: Industrial Sector Scheme (HSFDC)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from BPL families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural & urban areas for various self-employment income-generating activities such as carpentry, leather and leather goods manufacturing, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Industrial R&D Promotion Programme: Recognition Of In-House R&D Units
sub_schemes.description: DSIR is operating a scheme called "Recognition of In-House R&D Units" with the objective of granting recognition & registration to in-house R&D units established by the corporate industry. The In-house R&D units are expected to be engaged in innovative research & development activities.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives to Women Entrepreneurs Scheme, 2008
sub_schemes.description: "Incentives to Women Entrepreneurs Scheme, 2008" aimed to encourage women entrepreneurship and promote self-employment by providing additional incentives such as interest subsidies and preferential treatment under capital contribution schemes. The scheme benefited women-owned industrial units.

sub_schemes.title: Incubation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Incubation Scheme aims to promote and support untapped creativity and to promote adoption of latest technologies in MSMEs that seek the validation of their ideas at the proof-of-concept level.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to address the skill gap in Goa by supporting industrial units to provide demand-driven Short Term Training Courses through recognized institutions, thereby creating manpower suitable for the industry. It offers reimbursement for 60% of training costs up to ₹60,000/- per trainee.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to incentivize investments by existing and new units in environmentally friendly initiatives. It provides financial support through reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment to eligible manufacturing units.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives to Encourage Consumption of Local Raw Material Scheme, 2008
sub_schemes.description: "Incentives to Encourage Consumption of Local Raw Material Scheme, 2008" promoted the use of local raw materials, supporting local manufacturers and village economies. It offered Sales Tax reimbursement and subsidies on power and water bills to eligible Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives To Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage consumption through local purchases and support the economies of ancillary units, local Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, and traders. It provides a reimbursement of 2% (up to ₹5,00,000/- annually) on eligible local purchases to eligible manufacturing units in Goa.

sub_schemes.title: Incentives by MSME Department for Setting Up of Aromatic Industries in Aroma Park located at SIIDCUL, Kashipur - Centre for Aromatic Plants
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment and growth of aromatic industries in Aroma Park, SIIDCUL, Kashipur by providing financial incentives, concessional facilities, and technical support to entrepreneurs, thereby fostering industrial development and economic growth in the region.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers
sub_schemes.description: The "Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers" is aimed at improving the financial condition of minority communities involved in silk reeling and spinning. The corporation will provide loans to support working capital and basic infrastructure for silk spinners.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Work Force Welfare Assistance
sub_schemes.description: “Work Force Welfare Assistance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for paying contribution towards ESI and EPF.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fees
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fees” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement for stamp duty and registration fee paid by it for the purpose of registration of documents.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Water Conservation/ Environment Compliance
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Water Conservation/ Environment Compliance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement for expenditure incurred towards cost of captive sound pollution control devices.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of the expenditure incurred for obtaining certification from approved Institutions/ Research Labs.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Waiver of Electricity Duty
sub_schemes.description: “Waiver of Electricity Duty” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of electricity duty on the electricity consumed for the manufacturing activity.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Patent Registration
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Patent Registration” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred by it for obtaining Patent Registration.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Energy Efficiency
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Energy Efficiency” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement for the cost of energy audit and installations for energy conservation as per energy audit.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide refund of Net SGST paid to the Government of West Bengal for its approved project.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan
sub_schemes.description: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Bank to an approved project.

sub_schemes.title: Improved Cultivation and Advanced Retting Exercise (I-CARE)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support small and marginal jute growers with adequate pre and post harvesting operations to improve fiber quality and receive higher prices. The scheme provides 100% certified seeds at subsidized rates, free mechanical equipment, microbial consortiums, retting ponds.

sub_schemes.title: House of Himalayas
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide recognition and market reach to local Himalayan products of Uttarakhand through improved branding, packaging and sales. Under this scheme, local producers and self-help groups are supported to enhance their products’ quality, branding and market access.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministers Green Taxi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme promotes clean mobility and electric vehicle adoption in the Greater Shillong Planning Area, while supporting green entrepreneurship and sustainable transport through financial incentives.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme" by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides working capital assistance of up to ₹10,000, promotes regular loan repayment, and trains entrepreneurs in business practices. The scheme targets small traders.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Existing Assets
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist the units who are in existence for a minimum period of 2 years with good track record. The assistance is provided for purchase of existing land, building and machinery with prescribed residual life. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Ex-Convicts
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Ex-Convicts” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. This scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice to help those released from jail from poor economic conditions to find their livelihood.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to facilitate the self-employment of unemployed disabled persons. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities for self-employment, small-scale business, and agro-based project. This scheme is 100% funded by Govt. of Maharashtra.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to industrial units, hospitals, and educational institutions in the State of Goa to obtain quality certifications and register Intellectual Property Rights, thereby enhancing their competitive strength in global markets and promoting innovation.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Youth Groups
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment & entrepreneurship among rural youth by providing financial support. Financial assistance is provided to Mangal Dals affiliated with the department to help them start employment-oriented projects in 18 identified business sectors.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana" under Seven Nishchay-2, aims to develop undeveloped and unutilized private land in Bihar for fish-based integrated aquaculture. With a budget of ₹2972.79 lakh, the scheme targets the sustainable development of 600 hectares of Chaur land, enhancing fish.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas Evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra
sub_schemes.description: The scheme empowers tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project cost.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups (GTKVN)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to economically empower women from Thakor and Koli castes through self-employment opportunities via Self Help Groups (SHGs). Under this scheme, eligible members of SHGs receive a loan up to ₹60,000/- at low interest to start or expand small-scale businesses/enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

sub_schemes.title: Microcredit Finance Scheme- Self Help Groups (DAADC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment for SC individuals. It offers microloans to start small businesses and become economically self-sufficient.

sub_schemes.title: Migrants Employment Generation Programme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Tamil Nadu has launched the “Migrants Employment Generation Programme (MEGP)” for the Non-Resident Tamils, who returned back to Tamil Nadu due to Covid-19 Pandemic.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme promotes self-employment among Nomadic and Denotified Tribes by offering loan up to ₹1,25,000 at a concessional interest rate to help start small-scale businesses or enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under the scheme, small loans of ₹1,00,000/- are provided to members of SHGs, either directly or through the SHGs, to meet the needs of the poorest among the poor.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes &d Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under the scheme, small loans of ₹1,50,000/- per beneficiary are provided to members of Self-Help Groups (SHGs), either directly or through the SHGs.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC- Haryana
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, loan is provided to Safai Karamchari and their dependents for projects with a maximum cost up to ₹1,00,000/- per beneficiaries for small and petty trade/business and various income generating activities.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Credit Finance
sub_schemes.description: Under the Micro Credit Finance Scheme, beneficiaries from the Charmkar Community receive financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 at an interest rate of 5% per annum. This assistance includes a subsidy of ₹10,000, with the remaining amount provided as a loan.

sub_schemes.title: Micro Credit Finance (NSFDC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Under this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from the SC community for units costing up to ₹1,40,000/- for income-generating activities.

sub_schemes.title: Merit Loan Scheme for Good Borrowers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist the units of PIPDIC whose loan accounts are classified as Standard Assets continuously for 3 years. The assistance is provided for construction of additional building, purchase of additional machineries & equipments essential for expansion /modernisation / diversification.

sub_schemes.title: Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in sericulture and weaving by providing financial support. It also focuses on strengthening Eri and Muga silk production and promoting Meghalaya’s yarn and fabric in national and global markets.

sub_schemes.title: Meghalaya Cinema Theatre Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme's objective is to promote youth entrepreneurship and employment in Meghalaya by supporting cinema theatres while preserving the state’s cultural heritage.

sub_schemes.title: Meghalaya Any Business Venture Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Meghalaya Any Business Ventures Scheme, part of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program, provides financial support to 50 entrepreneurs across the state to start their own businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide loans of up to ₹5,00,000/- at a simple annual interest rate of 5% to youths from minority communities (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi) for generating employment.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance for special project proposals received in the interest of the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati / Anusuchit Janjati Udyami Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance for setting up businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st August 2014.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Yuva Udyami Yojana
