sub_schemes.description: The state government of Manipur has introduced the 'Startup Manipur' initiative, aimed at promoting sustainable economic development and generating significant employment opportunities in the region.

sub_schemes.title: Stand-Up India
sub_schemes.description: A scheme by Ministry of Finance for financing SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs by facilitating bank loans for setting up a greenfield project Enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading sector and activities allied to agriculture.

sub_schemes.title: Stamp Duty Refund
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Haryana offers reimbursement of stamp duty charges to incentivize industrial investment and infrastructure development across the state. This scheme provides financial relief on stamp duty paid during land or property registration for eligible sectors and locations.

sub_schemes.title: Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Through “Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme”, in case of land/ developed area purchased/ leased by Start-ups/ incubators/ accelerators, the stamp duty for land area lease/ sale transaction for start-ups/incubators/ accelerators will not exceed ₹ 100/-, and the excess amount paid will be reimbursed.

sub_schemes.title: Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative
sub_schemes.description: Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative is a scheme to provide financial assistance to youth of Union Territory of J&K for establishing their business units with a special focus on high-growth entrepreneurship.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing new enterprises or upgrading existing small-scale units.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: State Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)
sub_schemes.description: “State Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Department, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide Capital Investment Subsidy for its approved project to an eligible micro or small enterprise.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)
sub_schemes.description: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Commercial Bank to an eligible micro or small enterprise.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance (WCS)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance” incentives by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred by it towards the cost of captive Effluent Water Treatment Plant for wastewater recycling and/ or other pollution control devices.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of the expenditure incurred for obtaining certification from approved Institutions/ Research Laboratories.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for obtaining Patent Registration.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide refunds for net SGST paid to the Government of West Bengal.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES)
sub_schemes.description: “Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement for the cost of energy and installations for energy conservation as per energy audit.

sub_schemes.title: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Power Subsidy (PS)
sub_schemes.description: “Power Subsidy (PS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide power subsidy on the electricity consumed for the manufacturing activity to an eligible micro or small enterprise.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Spice Slicing machines ( nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to promote the adoption of Spice Slicing Machines to mechanize post-harvest processing, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the quality of spices for export.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: HRD for implementation of the proposed program: Engaging Spice Extension Trainees
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to assist the Spices Board in implementing its programmes while improving the employability of technically qualified unemployed youth belonging to SC/ST and other eligible categories by engaging them as Spice Extension Trainees.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: QGBG (Quality Gap Bridging Group) - Spice Producer’s Groups in Identified Clusters
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to strengthen the capacity of Spice Producer Groups (SPGs) to produce spices that meet quality, safety, and traceability standards by providing support to identified groups.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Handicraft Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Handicraft Sector by providing financial assistance to eligible enterprises. It offers interest subsidy or capital subsidy to support investment in plant and machinery.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Industrial Gases Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote large-scale investment in the Industrial Gases Sector by providing additional fiscal incentives. It supports eligible enterprises through extended investment subsidy and electricity duty exemption.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): M-Sand Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the manufacturing of M-Sand by providing financial incentives to enterprises making investment of ₹2 crore or above.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): MSME Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support MSME sector enterprises by providing one-time financial assistance and reimbursements for water conservation, green measures, quality certification, technology acquisition, innovation, and fundraising.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Leather, Footwear and Accessories Sector, Gems & Jewellery Sector, Mineral Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Leather, Footwear and Accessories, Gems and Jewellery, and Mineral sectors by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises. It supports investment in plant and machinery through interest subsidy or capital subsidy, subject to specified limits.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Medical Device Manufacturing Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Medical Device Manufacturing Sector by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Start-ups
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to support start-ups by providing additional investment incentives to encourage new enterprises and innovation. It offers an additional investment subsidy to eligible start-ups to promote sustainable business growth.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Textile Sector and Apparel Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Textile and Apparel Sector by providing capital subsidy and interest subsidy on eligible investments. It supports technology upgradation, environmental compliance, and modernization of plant and machinery.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Solar Equipments Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Solar Equipments Sector by providing additional financial incentives to eligible enterprises. It supports investment, employment generation, energy cost reduction, and access to finance.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Wind Turbine Manufacturing Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Wind Turbine Manufacturing Sector by providing additional financial incentives to eligible enterprises. It supports industrial growth and employment generation through subsidies and duty exemptions.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Mint distillation (nos)
sub_schemes.description: To motivate the Mint growers to set up modern field distillation units lined with Stainless steel in their fields to improve the efficiency of distillation unit as well as to improve the quality of oil for exports.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Nutmeg /clove drier (nos )
sub_schemes.description: To popularize the drying of nutmeg / clove hygienically using mechanical dryers among the farmers to produce quality nutmeg, mace and clove for exports

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Large Cardamom Driers (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved drying equipment, thereby enhancing the quality of large cardamom for domestic and export markets.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Large Cardamom in NE, Kalimpong & Darjeeling District (nos)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage large cardamom growers to adopt Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for drying cardamom, thereby improving the quality of the produce and enhancing its suitability for export.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote easy establishment of enterprises in Rajasthan by providing interest subsidy based loans through banks to create new employment opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Testing Laboratory
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of accredited Testing Laboratories by providing capital subsidy to eligible enterprises. It supports investment in plant and machinery or equipment to strengthen testing and quality infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Social Infrastructure
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the development of social infrastructure in RIICO Industrial Areas and urban areas by providing capital subsidy to eligible enterprises and special purpose vehicles. It supports creation of parking facilities, worker housing, healthcare, and childcare infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Cold Chain in Pharmaceuticals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of Cold Chain facilities in the Pharmaceuticals sector by providing capital subsidy to eligible enterprises. It supports investment in plant, machinery, and equipment to strengthen pharmaceutical cold storage infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Infrastructure for Value-Addition or Preservation of Agricultural Products
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote infrastructure for value-addition or preservation of agricultural products in rural areas by supporting agro-processing enterprises. It provides capital subsidy on plant and machinery and refrigerated vehicles for eligible investments.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): IT Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the development of IT Parks by providing interest subsidy to eligible IT sector enterprises. It supports investment in IT infrastructure through financial assistance on term loans.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): IT Park
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote development of IT Parks by providing interest subsidy on term loans for infrastructure development. It supports eligible enterprises making investment of ₹15 crore or more by reducing financing costs for IT Park projects.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Logistic Infrastructure
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the development of logistic infrastructure in the State by providing financial support to eligible enterprises and Special Purpose Vehicles. It offers interest subsidy and capital subsidy for Multi-Modal Logistics Hubs, Logistic Parks, and Warehouses.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Common Utility Centre
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of Common Utility Centres by providing capital subsidy to support shared industrial infrastructure. It encourages investment in plant, machinery, and equipment to strengthen collective facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Industrial Park
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage the development of Industrial Parks by providing financial incentives for creating common infrastructure. It offers capital subsidy or interest subsidy to eligible enterprises or Special Purpose Vehicles making large-scale investments.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Start-ups (Service Enterprises in Thrust Sectors)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of start-ups by providing additional investment-based financial incentives. It supports eligible start-ups through an additional investment subsidy linked to State tax contribution.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Food Processing Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Food Processing Sector by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Auto-Component Sector, Electronic System Design Manufacturing (ESDM) Sector, Chemical Sector, Petrochemical Sector, Petroleum Ancillary and Pharmaceutical Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage large investments in the Auto-Component, ESDM, Chemical, Petrochemical, Petroleum Ancillary, and Pharmaceutical sectors. It provides interest subsidy or capital subsidy to support investment in plant and machinery.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): DMIC Area
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote industrial investment in the DMIC Area by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises. It offers interest subsidy or capital subsidy to support investment in plant and machinery.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Benefits to Manufacturing Enterprise
sub_schemes.description: This scheme-component aims to generate employment opportunities and promote rapid, sustainable and balanced economic growth in the State of Rajasthan.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Electric Vehicle (EV)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote Electric Vehicle manufacturing by providing financial incentives to eligible Automobile Sector enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Bio-Technology Sector
sub_schemes.description: This scheme component aims to promote investment in the Bio-Technology Sector by providing additional financial incentives to eligible enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Agro-Processing Sector
sub_schemes.description: This scheme-component aims to provide interest subsidy or capital subsidy to enterprises making an investment in the Agro-Processing Sector.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Ceramic and Glass Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Ceramic and Glass Sector by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises. It offers investment subsidy and interest subsidy to support industrial growth and capital investment.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Dairy Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote investment in the Dairy Sector by providing financial incentives to eligible enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS): Defence Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote large-scale investment in the Defence Sector by providing interest subsidy on term loans and electricity duty exemption. It supports enterprises investing ₹100 crore and above to strengthen defence manufacturing infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Incentive for Setting up a Power Sub Station
sub_schemes.description: The “Incentive for Setting up a Power Sub Station” under the “SAIP for MSMEs” scheme, facilitates the Private Industrial Park in the provision of quality power.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
sub_schemes.description: “Reimbursement of Stamp Duty” under the “SAIP for MSMEs” scheme, aims to provide reimbursement of stamp duty paid by the SPV for registration of land documents.

sub_schemes.title: National Energy Conservation Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to recognize and reward organizations for their exemplary efforts in energy conservation and energy efficiency.

sub_schemes.title: National Bio Energy Programme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the use of biogas as a clean and renewable energy source, help livestock farmers set up biogas plants, reduce the use of conventional fuels, and support eco-friendly rural development in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme" is a initiative of Jammu & Kashmir State. This scheme is provide the financial help to the youth to empower them and promote the self employment.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Annadoot Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to unemployed youth/women for 7 years by involving them in the transport of food grains from Madhya Pradesh State Civil Supplies Corporation centers to fair price shops. Benefits include an interest subsidy/grant.

sub_schemes.title: Free Bus Pass for Media Persons
sub_schemes.description: "Free Bus Pass for Media Persons" scheme by the Dept of Information & Publicity, Puducherry, aims to provide a free bus pass facility to media persons working in Puducherry in Puducherry Road Transport Corporation buses (except town buses) to undertake journeys for their professional requirements.

sub_schemes.title: HRIDAY: Heritage City Development & Augmentation Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 21st January 2015, the scheme "National Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana", also known as "HRIDAY" is a central sector scheme by the Ministry of Tourism. The scheme was introduced to bring together urban planning, economic growth, and heritage conservation.

sub_schemes.title: Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy
sub_schemes.description: The policy aims to transition Gujarat's transportation sector towards electric mobility and establish the state as a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles. It provides subsidies for electric vehicle purchases and charging infrastructure development to promote sustainable transportation.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings
sub_schemes.description: "Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings" was introduced by the Directorate of Education, Goa. The scheme provides grant-in-aid to address urgent minor repairs required in Government School buildings.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. In this scheme, a fixed sum ₹ 300/- per month shall be paid as Transport Allowance to the differently abled individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of Subsidy For Setting up of Ice-Plant /Cold Storage/Fish Processing Unit
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to preserve fish and fishery products by facilitating the establishment of Ice Plant-cum-Cold Storage Units and Fish Processing Units. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can avail a 10% subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Gramodhyog Vikas Kendra
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide infrastructure facilities at village level to artisans through Common Facility Centers. Registered Non-Governmental Organizations, cooperative societies and trusts receive financial assistance up to ₹13,00,000/- for building infrastructure, training, equipment, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of electric two-wheelers to construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.

sub_schemes.title: GROUP WORKSHED SCHEME
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the establishment of worksheds for shuttleless looms in an existing or new cluster, which will provide the required scale of economy for business operations.

sub_schemes.title: GST Exemption Certificate Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "GST Exemption Certificate Scheme" has been introduced by the Dept. of Heavy Industries, for issuing certificates to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) having a disability percentage equal to or greater than 40%. The scheme provides GSC Concession to orthopedically disabled persons on purchase of car.

sub_schemes.title: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide a petrol subsidy of ₹250 per month for two-wheelers to eligible NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The scheme provides free bus passes to all the differently abled persons to facilitate their mobility/transport in buses run by the Government and NGOs.

sub_schemes.title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to strengthen the fisheries value chain by providing transportation support to fish farmers. Under this scheme, eligible fish farmers receive a subsidy of 25% of the actual cost on the purchase of a commercial four-wheeler vehicle used for fisheries-related activities.

sub_schemes.title: Infrastructure and Technology Support
sub_schemes.description: The sub-scheme “Infrastructure and Technology Support” aims to develop world-class infrastructure in the country to support handicraft production, enhance product quality, and reduce costs to enable it to compete in the global market.

sub_schemes.title: Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Central Smart Surveillance Unit (CSSU)
sub_schemes.description: The component aims to establish a Central Smart Surveillance Unit for continuous remote supervision of all Central Government-funded Grant-in-aid institutions and Training and Coaching centres using Closed-Circuit Television cameras and electronic devices.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme offers financial incentives (capital subsidy, interest subvention, and electricity duty reimbursement) to private/NGO entities establishing new super specialty hospitals (50+ beds) in Gujarat, targeting underserved areas.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministers Green Taxi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme promotes clean mobility and electric vehicle adoption in the Greater Shillong Planning Area, while supporting green entrepreneurship and sustainable transport through financial incentives.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery-Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance To Institutions/Societies Belonging To Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Institutions/Societies Belonging to Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance For Renovation And Special Repair Works To Hindu Religious Institutions Situated In Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- for renovation and special repairs, specifically targeting the purchase of building materials. The intended beneficiaries are Hindu religious institutions situated in Economically Weaker Section Areas or Adi-Dravidar Colonies.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana" to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks & remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme aims to encourage scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, backward classes entrepreneurship by providing financial support to purchase buses.

sub_schemes.title: Mhaji Bus Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides a subsidy of ₹3/- per kilometer operated, 50% reimbursement of the annual insurance premium paid up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-, and assistance of ₹10,00,000/- for replacing buses older than 15 years with new buses having a minimum seating capacity of 27.

sub_schemes.title: Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme promotes alternative tourism and supports rural and eco-tourism in the state. It encourages entrepreneurship by providing financial assistance for operating motorcaravans and aims to create employment opportunities while offering unique travel experiences across Meghalaya.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakaar Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Training and Rehabilitation in Case of Permanent Disability due to Accident
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to rehabilitate drivers and conductors who suffer permanent disability due to accidents by providing skill training for alternative employment to the beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Chief Minister Self-Employment Scheme for Drivers/Conductors
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to support self-employment for registered drivers and conductors by providing financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles to eligible beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monetary support for the marriage of daughters of registered drivers and conductors.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides accident insurance coverage to registered drivers and conductors, offering financial protection in the event of accidental death or permanent disability.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Sarathi Shri Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one of the state's best driver "Sarathi Shri" award, which includes a cash prize, a certificate of appreciation, and a trophy.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Scholarship
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide scholarship support for the education of registered drivers, conductors, and their dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Medical Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide healthcare and medical assistance to registered drivers, conductors, and their families. Medical benefits are delivered through existing state health schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible registered drivers and conductors to support their maternity-related needs during childbirth.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Gratuity Assistance in case of Death
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide social security to registered drivers and conductors by offering gratuity assistance for funeral expenses to families in the event of an accidental death.

sub_schemes.title: New Generation Innovation Network
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to create an ecosystem that promotes innovation in educational institutions. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to host institutes and student teams for running incubators and for student projects.

sub_schemes.title: Development Of Playfield Under CMSGUY
sub_schemes.description: "Development of Playfield" is an Infrastructure Development Scheme by the Assam Youth Development Mission Society (AYDMS) formed under CMSGUY Scheme. It has been decided to develop 500 Football Playfields during 2017-18 in the first phase of operation of the scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Cycle Anudaan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: A labor department initiated a scheme "Cycle Anudan Yojana' in 2018 for the construction worker of Madhya Pradesh and provide them financial assistance for cycle.

sub_schemes.title: Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2012.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar State Madarsa Strengthening Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme was launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Govt. of Bihar, to improve quality of education in recognized Madarsas. Under this scheme, state government provides essential facilities & infrastructure to Madarsas recognized by the Bihar State Madarsa Board & other government Madarsas.

sub_schemes.title: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure
sub_schemes.description: The revitalized and farmers’ income enhancing centric sub-scheme Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI) of Integrated Scheme for Agricultural Marketing (ISAM) is meant for holistic development of agricultural value chain critically focusing each linkage of post-harvest value chain.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance for Administering Road Safety Advocacy and Awards for the Outstanding Work Done in the Field of Road Safety
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the Scheme is to stimulate and encourage opportunities for various agencies through participation, in order to create awareness on road safety.

sub_schemes.title: Shahari Waqf Sampatti Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, interest free loan to Waqf Boards (WBs)/waqf institutions is granted to various Waqf Boards and Waqf Institutions in the country for construction of economically viable buildings on the Waqf land, such as commercial complex, marriage halls, hospitals, cold storage etc..

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Assistance for the Prevention of Alcoholism & Substance (Drugs) Abuse and for Social Defence Services: General Grant-in-Aid Programme for Financial Assistance in the Field of Social Defence
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to meet needs falling within the mandate of the Ministry which cannot be met under its regular schemes and support such initiatives of an innovative/pilot nature in the area of welfare and empowerment of the Ministry’s target groups, as cannot be supported under its regular schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
sub_schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Surakshaevam Utthaan Mahabhiyan Yojana (PM-KUSUM Scheme) was launched in March 2019 by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), to subsidize farmers to install solar irrigation pumps for cultivation. Each farmer will receive a 60% subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: E-YUVA Scheme: E-YUVA Centers
sub_schemes.description: E-YUVA Centers are housed within the University/Institute set-up. It acts as an anchor and extends requisite support and mentoring to students. Each EYC has a BIRAC-supported pre-incubation space which offers infrastructure and equipment for basic research and experimentation by selected students.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote livelihood generation and income enhancement of tribal communities through value addition, processing, and marketing of tribal products.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
sub_schemes.description: With the objective of providing rural connectivity, the Government of India launched the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (referred to as PMGSY-I hereinafter) on 25th December 2000 to provide all-weather access to eligible unconnected habitations.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to develop selected villages with significant Scheduled Tribe population into model villages by providing basic infrastructure and improving socio-economic conditions.

sub_schemes.title: ECCE (Early Childhood Care and Education)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides quality early childhood care, development, and pre-primary education for children between the ages of 3 to 6 years. The scheme ensures safe, child-friendly infrastructure with furniture, TLM, & facilities in co-located Anganwadi centres within government school premises.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s Yatra Scheme to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s life in India
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist the people who want to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s life in India. It provides comprehensive financial assistance, with all expenses for the tour programme fully borne by the Department, targeting SC/ST applicants of Puducherry.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar’s Electric Auto (e-Auto) Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to socially and economically empower Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe women by supporting them in income-generating activities through electric autos. It provides a subsidy up to 75% of the cost (maximum ₹3,00,000/-) for electric autos to Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe women.

sub_schemes.title: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: Small Road Transport Operators Loan (SRTO Loan)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to small-scale road transport operators through loans up to ₹10,00,000/- with 13% rate of interest.

sub_schemes.title: District Innovation And Challenge Fund
sub_schemes.description: The objectives of the "District Innovation and Challenge Fund (DICF)" are to Instill a sense of competitiveness amongst the Deputy Commissioners for developmental interventions, and to bring innovation in the design, planning, and implementation of critical infrastructure.

sub_schemes.title: Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: "Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)" aims to provide safe play areas for healthy recreation and sports to urban communities. Assistance is provided to develop safe play areas in urban spaces.

sub_schemes.title: Establishment of Cow Shelters
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide proper shelter and care to unprofitable, abandoned, or roaming cattle by supporting eligible organizations in establishing and maintaining cow shelters with financial assistance from the state government.

sub_schemes.title: Concession in Railway Travel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Concession in Railway Travel" was launched by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Tamil Nadu. Under the scheme, individual artists and troupes are allowed to travel in the train on concession by the Railways. A concession certificate will be issued by Mandram.

sub_schemes.title: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "AICTE - Grant for Augmenting Infrastructure in North Eastern Region (GAINER)" was introduced by AICTE to enhance the functional efficiency of the technical institutes located in far-flung areas of North East India, by addressing deficiencies in water, electricity, and internet.

sub_schemes.title: "Infrastructure Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries"
sub_schemes.description: The "Infrastructure Subsidy" is a Component of the "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries" Scheme by the Industries and Commerce Department, Puducherry. 25% subsidy is provided to the industrial units who have made investments on buildings.

sub_schemes.title: "Infrastructure Development Subsidy (For IT/ITES)" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Capital Intensive Industries"
sub_schemes.description: Through this scheme, 30% Subsidy subject to a max. of ₹1,00,00,000/- will be granted on the investment made on building with a minimum extent of 50,000 sq.ft. constructed area, by the infrastructure developers/industries for leasing out to Information Technology industries or for own industrial use.

sub_schemes.title: Annual Tour to the Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: “Annual Tour to the Differently Abled Persons” was launched by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry to allow the PwDs to see the places of cultural and historic importance and acquaint themselves with various aspects of our cultural heritage.

sub_schemes.title: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
sub_schemes.description: The Amma Two-wheeler is a scheme that will empower working women in Tamil Nadu State.

sub_schemes.title: Auto Rickshaw Regulation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to regulate auto rickshaw operations by enforcing standardized permits and compliance conditions statewide to ensure safety and uniformity.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Mission For Rejuvenation And Urban Transformation
sub_schemes.description: Providing basic services (e.g. water supply, sewerage, urban transport) to households and building amenities in cities which will improve the quality of life for all, especially the poor and the disadvantaged is a national priority.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Bhujal Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the management of groundwater resources in water-stressed areas. It provides institutional strengthening and financial incentives to Gram Panchayats and local communities for sustainable groundwater management and water-efficient practices.

sub_schemes.title: Vehicle Loan Scheme (GTKVN)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among youth from the Thakor and Koli communities by providing loans of up to ₹4,00,000/- for the purchase of commercial vehicles such as auto-rickshaws, loading rickshaws, or a Maruti Eeco van to start an income-generating transport business.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads
sub_schemes.description: The "Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce. The scheme aims to assist SSI units for the Development & Maintenance and Construction of Roads.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Construction of Multipurpose Community Halls in Areas Inhabited by Tribal Community (Sanskruti Bhavan)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide essential infrastructure by constructing Multipurpose Community Halls (Sanskruti Bhavan) in villages primarily inhabited by Scheduled Tribe Communities. Benefits include a facility that serves as a marriage hall, training center, and recreation room.

sub_schemes.title: Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana (SKSPTYY) is a scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022 to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers for undertaking pilgrimage.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Financial Assistance to IHMs/FCIs/IITTM/ICI/NCHMCT/PSUs
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide Central Financial Assistance for setting up, expanding, upgrading, and replacing equipment for institutions involved in tourism and hospitality education and capacity building. Benefits include capital grants for construction and equipment.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme of Development Assistance to Colleges for the Construction of Buildings
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide development assistance to Colleges to help in the consolidation and expansion of infrastructure. Financial assistance is provided to eligible Colleges for the construction and renovation of essential buildings like classrooms, laboratories, and hostels.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Setting Up of Plastic Parks
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to increase the competitiveness and value addition in the plastic processing industry through cluster development. It provides grant-in-aid up to ₹40,00,00,000/- for common infrastructure benefits intended for Special Purpose Vehicles and local enterprises.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehicles, including goods and passenger vehicles. It provides term loans covering up to 70% of the vehicle cost, excluding road tax and insurance, repayable over a max. of 58 monthly instalments.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Setting Up of Centre of Excellence
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide strategic funding for collaborative research and development in the chemicals and petrochemicals sector. It provides a grant of up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to existing Government universities and organizations for research equipment, staff, and technology commercialization.

sub_schemes.title: Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve power infrastructure in coastal taluks by addressing corrosion issues, ensuring adequate voltage, and continuous electricity supply. Benefits include reduction in motor burnout, prevention of industrial losses, and providing new agricultural electricity connections.

sub_schemes.title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen - Waste Management) - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable solid and liquid waste management in rural Uttarakhand by providing necessary infrastructure and facilities to ensure cleaner villages, improved sanitation, and better public health.

sub_schemes.title: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for purchasing e-bikes at a subsidised rate. The benefits include making it more convenient for journalists to gather and disseminate news, with the intended beneficiaries being eligible Goa-based journalists.

sub_schemes.title: Rental Housing Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide rental housing to individuals and families from lower and middle-income groups, address housing shortages, prevent unauthorized settlements, and promote orderly urban development. It benefits Grade Third and Grade Fourth employees and eligible non-government individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2014–2015, the scheme "Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive (PRASAD)" is a Central Sector Scheme by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. The scheme focuses on developing and identifying pilgrimage sites across India to enrich the religious tourism experience.

sub_schemes.title: Phase-II Of The Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme
sub_schemes.description: Phase-II of the Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme, this programme is introduced by Ministry of New & Renewable Energy(MNRE), GoI with JAKEDA as a nodal agency in the UT of J&K for achieving cumulative capacity of 220MW under 20MW Residential Scheme and 200 MW Jammu Solar City “Solar City.

sub_schemes.title: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Vigyaan Gram Sankul Pariyojana
sub_schemes.description: The project aims to promote sustainable rural development through the application of science & technology to enhance livelihoods in selected villages throughout Uttarakhand. Under the project, rural development initiatives are implemented through the formation of village clusters across the state.

sub_schemes.title: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.

sub_schemes.title: Padma Awardee Free Travel Facility
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to eligible Rajasthan residents who are Padma Award recipients and gallantry medal awardees, as a mark of honor and recognition for their distinguished service.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for the person Who is Honored by Presidential Police Medal / Police for Gallantry Award for Retirement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to retired persons who are residents of Rajasthan and have been honored with the Presidential Police Medal or Police for Gallantry Award.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for the Gallantry Medal Holders of the Armed Forces
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to armed forces personnel and recipients of gallantry medals.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for the Teachers Awarded at the National and State Level
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to teachers who are residents of Rajasthan and have received national or state level awards in recognition of their excellence in the field of education.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for the BSF, CRPF and RAF Personnel Who is Honored by Presidential Police Medal / Police for Gallantry Award
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to Rajasthan resident BSF, CRPF, and RAF personnel who are recipients of the Presidential Police Medal or Police for Gallantry Award.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for State Medalists in International Level Sports Events
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to state residents who have won medals at international level sports events and represented India.

sub_schemes.title: Zero Ticket Bus Travel Scheme for Women
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide to eligible women/ transgender beneficiaries of Tamil Nadu under the Zero Ticket Bus Travel Scheme for Women, Free of Cost Travel in Government of Tamil Nadu Buses. No Need to Pay any Fare up to 30 Kilometers.

sub_schemes.title: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs," was launched by the Dept of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt of Maharashtra. Each VJNT family will receive a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet).

sub_schemes.title: Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides a pass of ₹ 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus to the registered workers for purchasing.

sub_schemes.title: Tribals Development Plan: Purchase of Tourist Taxi
sub_schemes.description: This sub-scheme aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) families by providing financial assistance to purchase tourist taxis for self-employment in Goa’s growing tourism industry. It supports tribal households in transitioning from traditional occupations to sustainable livelihood opportunities.

sub_schemes.title: Tribals Development Plan: Subsidy for Purchase of Motorcycle
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist tribal families in Goa to purchase motorcycles for self-employment by offering a government subsidy, thereby promoting economic self-reliance among low-income households.

sub_schemes.title: Tribals Development Plan: Motor Driving Training [Light & Heavy Vehicles]
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide full financial coverage for motor driving training, including courses for Light Motor Vehicles and Heavy Motor Vehicles, specifically recognizing Goa’s future in the transport sector. It benefits eligible Tribal families in Goa whose annual income is below ₹1,20,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that region, and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country.

sub_schemes.title: Travel Concession To The Differently Abled Persons In State Owned Transport Corporation Buses
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced Differently Abled Persons In Stated Owned Tranportat Corporation buses.

sub_schemes.title: Transport Loan Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Transport Loan Scheme" aims to promote self-employment among target groups by providing term loans for Light Motor Vehicles. The scheme benefits Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Safai Karamcharis with financial assistance up to ₹5,00,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide loans for the purchase of auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. Through this scheme, financial assistance for vehicle purchase is provided to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Soft Loan To The Grant-in-aid/ Non-grant In Aid Institutions For Maintenance And Upgradation Of Infrastructure Facilities
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to support the efforts of the management of the Non-Government aided institutions/non-grant-in-aid institutions for the upgradation and maintenance of infrastructural facilities for promoting a conducive atmosphere for learning.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Persons With Orthopedic Disability/Locomotor Disability
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to persons with orthopedic or locomotor disabilities to ensure mobility, accessibility, and social inclusion.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel for Special Abled Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility to specially abled persons by allowing them to travel without fare in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Leprosy Cured Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to leprosy-cured persons with disabilities to support their mobility and social inclusion.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Person Suffering from Various Diseases
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility to eligible persons suffering from specified serious diseases by allowing them to travel without fare in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses.

sub_schemes.title: Journalist Free Travel Facility (Luxury)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities to accredited journalists to support professional mobility through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation express bus services.

sub_schemes.title: Journalist Free Travel Facility (Express)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities to accredited journalists to support professional mobility through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation express bus services.

sub_schemes.title: Travel Concessional Facility for Senior Citizens Aged 60 Years to 80 Years
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide concessional travel facility by offering 50% fare concession to senior citizens aged 60 years to 80 years while travelling in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses.

sub_schemes.title: 75 Percent Concession in Travel Fare for Cancer Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide 75% concession in travel fare to cancer patients and 50% concession to their accompanying person for travel from home to hospital and back in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation bus services.

sub_schemes.title: 25 Percent Concession in Travel Fare for Tribals of Tribal Areas of Rajasthan State
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a 25% concession in travel fare for tribals belonging to the tribal areas of Rajasthan State while traveling in local ordinary bus services.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Hemophilia Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide concessional travel support to Hemophilia patients along with one accompanying person by offering bus fare discounts for travel from home to hospital for treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Persons With Blindness/Visual Impairment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses for persons with blindness/visual impairment along with one companion.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel for People With Dementia
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses for people suffering from dementia or mental disability, along with one companion.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Widows of Soldiers Martyred in War, their Dependent Minor Children, and Parents
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation buses to widows of soldiers martyred in war, their dependent minor children, and parents.

sub_schemes.title: 75 Percent Concession in Travel Fare for Non-Communicable Leprosy Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a 75 percent concession in travel fare to non-communicable leprosy patients for travel from home to hospital and back for medical treatment through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation services.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Persons With Low Vision Disability
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to persons with low vision disability to support mobility, accessibility, and social inclusion.

sub_schemes.title: Concession Travel for Licensed Coolies of RSRTC
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a 50% concession in passenger fare to licensed coolies of Rajasthan State Transport Corporation while travelling on municipal bus services for work-related commuting.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Appearing in Interviews for Competitive Examinations Conducted by UPSC/RPSC/RSMSSN
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility to eligible candidates appearing in interviews of competitive examinations conducted by UPSC, RPSC, and RSMSSN by enabling cost-free journey through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation services.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Thalassemia Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide concessional bus travel facilities to Thalassemia patients for commuting between their residence and hospital for medical treatment.

sub_schemes.title: 30 Percent Concession in Travel Fare for Women/Girls
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide affordable and accessible public transport by offering a 30 percent concession in travel fare to women and girls traveling within the Rajasthan State boundary.

sub_schemes.title: Concessional Travel Facility for Home Guard Personnel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide concessional travel benefits to serving Home Guard personnel by allowing fare relaxation in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Hearing Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in ordinary, express, and night bus services operated by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation to hearing impaired persons residing in Rajasthan.

sub_schemes.title: Concessional Travel Facility for Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide a 50% concession in bus fare to eligible students for travel between their residence and educational institution within a specified distance.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Tribal Girls Studying up to Class 8th in Scheduled Caste and Tribal Areas of the State
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility from home to school to tribal girls studying up to Class 8 in Scheduled Caste and Tribal Areas of Rajasthan, thereby ensuring uninterrupted access to education.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Widows of Freedom Fighters
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to widows of freedom fighters receiving pension under the Freedom Fighters Samman Pension Scheme, along with one companion.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for Women/Girls on Women’s Day and Raksha Bandhan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities to women and girls of Rajasthan on International Women’s Day and Raksha Bandhan through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses up to the Rajasthan state border.

sub_schemes.title: Free Travel Facility for the Mentally Challenged
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation buses to mentally challenged persons along with one companion.

sub_schemes.title: Hospitalisation Relief Scheme
sub_schemes.description: This scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana financial assistance is provided to construction workers who suffer temporary disabilities due to accidents or diseases & hospitalized for five or more days.

sub_schemes.title: Home for Visually Challenged Person
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Home for Visually challenged Person" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to take care of the male persons who are visually impaired and who lack care and protection in society and are deprived of basic needs.

sub_schemes.title: Home for Mentally Challenged Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Home for Mentally Challenged Children" by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, aims to provide care for children facing mental challenges, i.e. low Intelligence Quotient (IQ). The scheme offers free boarding and lodging, uniform sets, daily living needs, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: By the labor department of Rajasthan started "Hita-Dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana" for the construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Healthy Lifestyle for School Children through Ayurvidya-AYUSH
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote and develop a healthy lifestyle among school children through the principles and practices of AYUSH. Under this initiative, free AYUSH-based health services and medicines are provided to children registered in government schools.

sub_schemes.title: Health Minister’s Discretionary Grant
sub_schemes.description: A health scheme by Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for financially poor patients to defray a part of the expenditure on Hospitalization/treatment in Government Hospitals,for life threatening diseases covered under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN), in cases where free medical facilities aren't there.

sub_schemes.title: Health Check-up (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: Registered construction workers having continuous membership of the Board can avail an amount of ₹5,000/- once in a year for his/ her annual health checkup in any Hospital.

sub_schemes.title: Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote the health and well-being of pregnant women and newborns by providing Ayurvedic-based healthcare services and treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Hemoglobinopathy - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive care, support, and treatment to patients suffering from Thalassemia and Hemophilia in Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance in the form of one-time grants to patients undergoing medical treatment in connection with T.B., Cancer and other malignant diseases. This scheme provides one-time financial assistance to patients belonging to the Tea Tribes community.

sub_schemes.title: Free Blood to Patients - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure the availability of blood free of cost to all patients admitted in government hospitals across the state. Under this scheme, blood is provided free of cost by government blood banks to all in-patients who require transfusion during treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to conduct health check-ups for male Shramyogis above 45 years of age and female Shram Yogis above 35 years of age who are working in the organized sector in the state of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Fund of Funds for Startups
sub_schemes.description: Launched in January 2016 under Startup India, the Fund of Funds for Startups is managed by SIDBI. It supports DPIIT-recognized startups indirectly by investing in SEBI-registered AIFs, which must invest at least twice the FFS contribution.

sub_schemes.title: Free Medical Card for Media Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides free medical facilities to press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. This will include free treatment in Government hospitals /institutions with entitlement to A-Class Special Wards..

sub_schemes.title: Free Medical Assistance (Gujarat)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for expensive medical treatments to Scheduled Tribe individuals. Through this scheme, monetary aid is provided to Scheduled Tribe individuals suffering from various diseases and for serious maternity cases and anaemia in women.

sub_schemes.title: Journalist's Medical Welfare Scheme - Assam
sub_schemes.description: The Journalist's Medical Welfare Scheme was first implemented in 2012 by the Government of Assam. Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the accredited and recognized journalists of Assam for their medical treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women. It offers cash assistance for institutional and home deliveries, along with antenatal and postnatal care support, primarily benefiting poor pregnant women across India.

sub_schemes.title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free healthcare services to pregnant women and infants up to one year of age, including free treatment, medicines, diet, and transport facilities in government hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Janani Bal Suraksha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This health initiative aimed at improving maternal and infant health by increasing institutional deliveries, reducing infant and maternal mortality rates, and promoting immunization in Bihar.

sub_schemes.title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide completely free and cashless delivery, including caesarean section, for pregnant women at government health facilities along with free treatment for sick newborns and infants.

sub_schemes.title: Janani Sahayogi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free and safe delivery and newborn care services to BPL families by offering free treatment to pregnant women in government and accredited private hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Funeral Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 13th August 2013, the "Funeral Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. Madhya Pradesh provides ₹3,000/- for the last rites of destitute or unclaimed bodies. The scheme also supports families registered under labour schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Toll Free 104 Helpline
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide the general public with round-the-clock (24×7×365) access to reliable health information and medical advice through the toll-free number 104.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Child Development Services: Chandigarh
sub_schemes.description: The Integrated Child Development Service (ICDS) Scheme providing for supplementary nutrition, immunization and pre-school education to the children is a popular flagship programme of the government. Launched in 1975, it is one of the world’s largest programmes providing for an integrated package of

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Child Development Services Scheme
sub_schemes.description: In Nagaland, the ICDS programme was launched in the year 1975 in the Jalukie block of Peren district with 50 Anganwadi centres. The programme has since grown and at present, there are 60 (sixty) ICDS projects in 11 (Eleven) districts of the State.

sub_schemes.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
sub_schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme"is a pension scheme by the Department Of Social Welfare Jammu and Kashmir. In this scheme, a pension of ₹1000/- is provided to differently-abled individuals from 'Below Poverty Line'.

sub_schemes.title: Indian Community Welfare Fund
sub_schemes.description: A scheme by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for the welfare of Overseas Indians; assisting them in distress situations. ICWF has also been a critical support in emergency evacuation of Indian nationals from conflict zones, countries affected by natural disasters and other challenging situations.

sub_schemes.title: Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector
sub_schemes.description: The scheme offers financial incentives (capital subsidy, interest subvention, and electricity duty reimbursement) to private/NGO entities establishing new super specialty hospitals (50+ beds) in Gujarat, targeting underserved areas.

sub_schemes.title: Immunization Programme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: This initiative aims to protect every child from preventable, life-threatening diseases by providing free and timely vaccination as per the National Immunization Schedule.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Chief Minister Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme provides quality health care to the eligible person through empanelled government and private hospitals to reduce the financial hardship to the enrolled families and move towards universal health coverage by effectively linking with public

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists
sub_schemes.description: The Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department scheme was launched by the "Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists". The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to four journalists for medical treatment from the Chief Minister’s Public Relief Fund.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar” was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura, to provide financial assistance of ₹500/- to pregnant women through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for antenatal checkups at any health facility.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kishori Swasthya Yojna
sub_schemes.description: This initiative by the State Government aimed at reducing school dropout rates among adolescent girls by providing free sanitary napkins, promoting hygiene, and supporting their overall health.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar Yojana" by the Department of Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare, Government of Jharkhand, provides medical grants of up to ₹5,00,000/- for the treatment of critical illnesses and supports acid attack victims.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The state government has announced the implementation of 'Universal Health Coverage' in the state in the budget announcement 2021-22, in compliance of which Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme was started in the state from May 1, 2021.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment, covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the health of pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) by providing nutritious food, including eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Aarogya Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana, launched on 1 May 2021, aims to reduce medical expenses by offering free treatment for 1,798 procedures in government and empanelled private hospitals. Eligible NFSA, SECC 2011 families, contract workers, small farmers, and others can avail benefits.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits of ₹ 30,000/- to the registered women members and wives of male members for upto 2 children.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance maternal and child health by providing nutritional support to first-time pregnant women and mothers of young children during the crucial first 1000 days of life.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Check-Up facility (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide medical check-up facilities to registered construction workers through door-to-door visits, health camps, and collection centers.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries" scheme under the Labour and Employment Department HP, provides financial support for healthcare. It covers ₹50,000 for outdoor treatment, ₹1,00,000 for indoor treatment, and ₹5,00,000 for critical illnesses each year, upon submission of valid medical bills.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, medical assistance of ₹1,00,000/- for the treatment of serious ailments for registered worker and his/her family members. (the benefit can be availed only after 26th July 2014 as the benefit is covered under the Mediclaim & Personal Accident Insurance scheme).

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance" scheme provides financial assistance to Construction Workers hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or disease. The financial assistance shall be ₹500/- for the first 5 days and ₹50/- each for the remaining days, subject to a maximum of ₹1,5000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" was launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept, Delhi. The registered workers are given medical assistance upto ₹ 10,000/- in case of being hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or disease.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance for the Construction Worker
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides medical expenses for the treatment of the registered beneficiary and /or his dependents.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (Karmika Arogya Bhagya) (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance (Karmika Arogya Bhagya)'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to registered construction workers and their dependents for hospitalisation expenses in recognised hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (NBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Assistance" scheme by the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to registered beneficiaries and their family members for hospitalization.
