sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (MBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Through the "Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker who is hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or any disease is provided with ₹400/- for the first 5 days and ₹40/- for the remaining days, subject to a maximum ₹2,000/-.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides medical assistance to the Building & Other Construction Workers, who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization due to accident or illness.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: Medical assistance shall be provided to Building & Other Construction Workers who are registered under A.B.O.C.W.W.B. during hospitalization, partial disability & for critical diseases such as Cancer, Heart attack, Failure of kidney, Liver cirrhosis etc. as per the decision of the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Assistance (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Medical Assistance” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya') (MPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The "Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya')" under the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000/- per year to the registered workers and their families in approved hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana" is a Medical Assistance scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 15,000/- for the first two deliveries of the registered female worker.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefits Scheme (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: "Maternity Benefits Scheme" provides an amount equivalent to 90 days of the minimum wages set by the State Govt. for unskilled workers at the time of childbirth. The applicant should be a female construction worker who has completed one year of membership with the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries" scheme under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to pregnant women registered as beneficiaries and wives of registered beneficiaries. The assistance can be availed up to two times.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to registered women construction workers for the birth of upto two (2) children.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the female construction workers and spouse of the male workers to support childbirth-related expenses maximum for two living children.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh has proposed and implemented the scheme “Maternity Benefit Scheme” for Registered Workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit For Female Workers- JKBOCWWB
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit for Female Workers" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, is a welfare program that provides maternity benefits to eligible registered female workers up to two times in their lifetime.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The “Maternity Benefit” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits to the female beneficiaries subject to a maximum of two children who are registered beneficiaries for a period of more than one year under the board.

sub_schemes.title: Maternity Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Maternity Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to uplift Scheduled Tribe communities through education, health, & economic initiatives. Financial grants, equipment, & training programs are provided for holistic village development.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana, is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat on 4th September 2012. It was initially launched only to cater to people who fall under the lowest income groups of the state i.e. Below Poverty Line (BPL).

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the health of children between 3 to 6 years of age by providing them fortified and flavored milk containing Vitamins A and D, four days a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana" by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand aims to provide quality healthcare services to eligible families. Beneficiaries receive ₹15,00,000/- per family per year as health insurance coverage for advanced medical treatments.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Sahara Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The State Government has launched the 'Sahara Scheme' to provide financial assistance of Rs. 3000 per month to the patients belonging to the economically weaker sections of the society, who are suffering from specified diseases such Parkinson, Malignant Cancer, Paralysis etc.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE
sub_schemes.description: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE is a health insurance scheme providing cashless treatment coverage up to Rs. 5.00 lakh per year per family in empanelled hospitals. It aims to cover families not included in the Ayushman Bharat scheme.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhmantri Sehat Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "AYUSHMAN BHARAT PM-JAY MUKH MANTRI SEHAT BIMA YOJNA” is a flagship State Health Insurance Program of the Government of Punjab.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides accident insurance coverage to registered drivers and conductors, offering financial protection in the event of accidental death or permanent disability.

sub_schemes.title: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Medical Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide healthcare and medical assistance to registered drivers, conductors, and their families. Medical benefits are delivered through existing state health schemes.

sub_schemes.title: Mobile Lab Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Mobile Lab Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement of expenditure incurred by the beneficiaries and their dependents for the treatment of silicosis.

sub_schemes.title: Kishori Balika Yojana- Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to create awareness among adolescent girls aged 14 to 18 years about nutrition, health, and life cycle issues, and also provides supplementary nutrition for 300 days in a year.

sub_schemes.title: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide safe, timely, and free transportation for pregnant women and newborn babies (0 - 1 year) to access healthcare services, including travel from home to the hospital and from the hospital back home.

sub_schemes.title: Khushi Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Odisha had introduced a scheme named "Khushi" which aims to provide Free sanitary napkins to all girls in Government and aided schools from class 6th to 12th.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members for medical treatment expenses. It covers major or minor surgical treatment costs in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses.

sub_schemes.title: KCR Nutrition Kit
sub_schemes.description: KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Telangana, India, aimed at providing nutritious food to pregnant. The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the nutritional status of pregnant women.

sub_schemes.title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana, launched by the Government of Maharashtra, offers cashless treatment for identified diseases through a network of government and private healthcare providers.

sub_schemes.title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance for serious illness, accident, or calamity-related medical treatment to artists and litterateurs.

sub_schemes.title: Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide eligible BPL families with free treatment cards by issuing health access cards within a fixed time limit.

sub_schemes.title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU)
sub_schemes.description: The objective of this scheme is to provide socio-financial security to eligible residents of Haryana. The scheme provides financial assistance in the event of death (natural/accidental) or permanent disability (caused by an accident) of a family member whose annual income is less than ₹1.80 lakh.

sub_schemes.title: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana
sub_schemes.description: To facilitate and take the medical services to the next level, the State of Goa envisaged the present scheme to provide its people with quality medical care and treatment of diseases, hospitalization and surgery through Government and private hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Day Care - cum - Recreation Centre and Physiotherapy Unit
sub_schemes.description: Through the scheme “Day Care - cum - Recreation Centre and Physiotherapy Unit" under "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)", the senior citizens are provided free physiotherapy given by the physiotherapist, as advised by the doctors.

sub_schemes.title: Dai Didi Mobile Clinic Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Government of Chhattisgarh state, started a scheme named "Dai Didi Clinic Scheme" in 2020.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to accord quality and cashless healthcare services to the indigenous people of the state and government employees and reduce out-of-pocket (OOP) expenses during major illness and hospitalization, thereby envisaging universal healthcare for all sections of society.

sub_schemes.title: Cancer Suraksha Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Kerala launched the “Cancer Suraksha Scheme” on 1st November 2008 for children below the age of 18 who suffer from cancer and belong to such families which are too poor to afford treatment. This scheme was launched under Kerala Social Security Mission.

sub_schemes.title: Cancer Day Care Centre - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure early detection & timely treatment of cancer by providing accessible & affordable healthcare services within the state. Under this initiative, free screening for common cancers such as oral, breast, & cervical cancer is being conducted across all districts of Uttarakhand.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The “Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases” has been implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB) to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for 15 types of occupational diseases and 23 types of serious injuries.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance For Major Ailments (Karmika Chikitsa Bhagya) (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Assistance For Major Ailments (Karmika Chikitsa Bhagya)'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support to registered construction workers and their dependents for medical expenses related to specified major ailments.

sub_schemes.title: Delhi Arogya Kosh
sub_schemes.description: "Delhi Arogya Kosh” (DAK) provides Financial assistance to needy eligible patients for treatment of any illness/treatment/intervention required by the patient undergoing treatment in a Government Hospital run by Delhi Government or Central Government or Autonomous Hospital under the State Government

sub_schemes.title: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) - "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation"
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to establish professional, well-trained, motivated and adequately equipped workforce for maintenance and management of sewers and septic tanks, addressing the critical need to eliminate fatalities resulting from workers entering sewers and septic tanks without proper safety measures.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide fixed-day assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care universally to all pregnant women in 2nd and 3rd trimester on the 9th of every month. It offers free comprehensive antenatal care services at government health facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme is to provide maternity benefits to women belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections of society. For first child the maternity benefit of ₹5,000 is provided in two instalments under PMMVY and second child, it is ₹6,000 is to be provided subject to second child is girl.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
sub_schemes.description: The "Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package: Insurance Scheme for Health Workers Fighting COVID-19" by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India aims to offer financial protection to healthcare workers involved in COVID-19 duties.

sub_schemes.title: Distribution of Female Menstrual Hygiene Kit for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Distribution of Female Menstrual Hygiene Kit for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides Menstrual Hygiene Kit to registered female beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
sub_schemes.description: AB PM-JAY is a health insurance scheme for low-income families in rural and urban areas. The scheme aims to provide affordable healthcare facilities to the Poor. It is the largest health assurance scheme in the world which aims at providing a health cover of ₹5,00,000/- per family per year.

sub_schemes.title: Swachh Bharat Mission – Grameen PHASE I
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to eliminate open defecation and improve rural sanitation by supporting toilet construction and promoting usage among poor and marginalized rural households.

sub_schemes.title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
sub_schemes.description: A sanitation scheme for Visual cleanliness through Open Defecation Free (ODF) sustainability and effective management of solid and liquid waste in villages.

sub_schemes.title: Swachh Bharat Mission – Urban 2.0
sub_schemes.description: A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households.

sub_schemes.title: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: SUMAN Yojana is a maternity benefit initiative by MoH&FW. This program provides affordable and quality healthcare solutions to pregnant women and newborns. The scheme provides zero expense access up to six months after delivery. Upto antenatal check-ups during the 1st trimester are provided.

sub_schemes.title: Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals belonging to SC category suffering from incurable & serious diseases. Under this scheme, Medical Assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients diagnosed with life-threatening conditions such as TB, Leukemia, & other critical illnesses.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
sub_schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to make quality generic medicines available to all at affordable prices.

sub_schemes.title: Unique Disability Identity - DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: UDID Card or Unique Disability Identity card is an initiative by Government of India with a view of creating a National Database for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). Under the UDID project Disability Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card is issued to each PwD through online platform.

sub_schemes.title: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyaan - DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme ensures holistic and sustainable development of tribal communities, building on PMJANMAN. It promotes inter-ministerial convergence across 17 ministries with 25 focused interventions. Gap analysis by departments guides need-based funding to bridge development gaps effectively.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Containing Population Decline of Small Minority Communities
sub_schemes.description: The objective of the scheme is to reverse the declining trend of Parsi population by adopting a scientific protocol and structured interventions, stabilize their population and increase the population of Parsis in India.

sub_schemes.title: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India has announced the scheme for incentives for nutritional support to TB patients. This scheme will be called “Nikshay Poshan Yojana”.

sub_schemes.title: NAMO Shree Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure proper nutritional support to pregnant women and lactating mothers and encourage institutional deliveries. It provides financial assistance of ₹12,000/- to eligible women beneficiaries covering expenses from conception to delivery.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
sub_schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to make quality generic medicines available to all at affordable prices.

sub_schemes.title: Poshan Sudha
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is a government initiative to provide nutrition and healthcare support to pregnant and lactating mothers in tribal districts of Gujarat.

sub_schemes.title: Procedure for Making Medical Certificate (for Certifying Disability)
sub_schemes.description: The certificate aims to ensure that persons with disabilities can easily obtain authentic medical certification required to avail benefits under various social welfare schemes, including disability pensions, scholarships, healthcare facilities, and employment reservations.

sub_schemes.title: Prime Minister's Award for Yoga
sub_schemes.description: The purpose of the Award is to recognize and felicitate individual(s)/ organization(s) who have made a significant impact on society for a sustained period by way of promotion and development of Yoga

sub_schemes.title: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
sub_schemes.description: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for Individual for Non BPL whose family income should be at least 2lakhs per annum.

sub_schemes.title: Promotion of Institutional Delivery
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote safe and institutional deliveries by providing free accommodation to pregnant women, especially from disaster-prone areas, near district hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Kishori Balika Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide vocational, health, and hygiene training to adolescent girls. Through this scheme, training and material assistance are provided to the girls.

sub_schemes.title: Kishor Swasthya Paramarsh Clinic - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: This initiative aims to promote the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of adolescents aged 10 to 19 years by providing free health counselling and guidance.

sub_schemes.title: Old Age Homes - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The "Old Age Homes" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme is to bring qualitative improvement in the living standards of old people of the state.

sub_schemes.title: Odisha State Treatment Fund
sub_schemes.description: The Odisha State Treatment Fund will provide financial assistance for treatment of the poor patients suffering from life threatening disorders & diseases. The financial assistance will be released to the Medical Institutions where the patient undergoes treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Nishulk Swasthya Jaanch Yojana - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure accessible, affordable and quality healthcare services for all citizens of Uttarakhand by providing free diagnostic tests across government healthcare facilities.

sub_schemes.title: Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Nirman Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana " is a scheme by the government of Uttar Pradesh, to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Niramaya Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Department of Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named "NIRAMAYA" - a Free Medicines Distribution Scheme. The aim is to provide quality essential medicines for all kinds of diseases to patients visiting government health facilities at free of cost.

sub_schemes.title: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme ,launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aims to provide affordable health insurance to the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Adolescent Girls Nutrition
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance nutritional support for all adolescent girls aged 15 -19 years across the state. However, in the 10 Aspirational Districts, the coverage is limited to girls aged 18 -19 years.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to assist poor patients from Scheduled Castes suffering from prolonged illness.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance to Old Age Pensioner Suffering From TB/ Cancer
sub_schemes.description: “Financial Assistance to Old Age Pensioner Suffering From TB/ Cancer” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Puducherry, was introduced to extend a helping hand by way of financial assistance to Old Age/Destitute Pensioners who are suffering from TB/Cancer to meet the medical expenses.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance for the treatment of ex-servicemen and their dependents (wife & children) who have a disability of 40% or more and are suffering from serious illnesses such as cancer, leprosy, tuberculosis, kidney and cardiac ailments, paralysis, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided to registered workers for indoor treatment of chronic diseases like Cancer, TB, AIDS, etc. as per government rules.

sub_schemes.title: Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started this scheme "Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" for labor workers.

sub_schemes.title: Dulari Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The DULARI Scheme was implemented by the Directorate of Health Services in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide incentives for newborn baby girls and to the girl children who pass Classes VIII, X, and XII.

sub_schemes.title: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme (Revised – 2009)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme” has been revised and implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana in 2009. Under this scheme, the state government provides medical treatment facilities to patients of the SC/ST communities.

sub_schemes.title: Doodh Sanjivani Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to enhance the nutritional health of children aged 6 months to 6 years and pregnant and lactating mothers by providing fortified flavored milk in Anganwadi centers across 20 districts in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to livestock owners for losses due to wild animal attacks.

sub_schemes.title: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to victims or families affected by wild animal attacks in both urban and rural areas through timely monetary compensation.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Death
sub_schemes.description: The component “Accidental Death” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of accidental death.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
sub_schemes.description: “Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” by the Labour Resources Dept., provides financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- to workers or craftsmen suffering from incurable diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries
sub_schemes.description: The component “Accidental Injuries” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance to the workers or craftsmen in case of accidental injuries.

sub_schemes.title: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
sub_schemes.description: “Permanent Partial Disability” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Dept, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹37,500/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of permanent partial disablement.

sub_schemes.title: Accident Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Accident Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that aims to provide compensation of a certain amount both from the employer and the Board.

sub_schemes.title: Aastha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with two or more specially-abled members. Under this scheme, eligible families receive free medical treatment, ration supplies, and other welfare benefits.

sub_schemes.title: Aama Kuni Pilaa
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to focus on early stimulation and responsive parenting in the best interest of each child from 0-3 years. The scheme envisages promoting parent-led, home-based, joyful child-friendly learning by creating an early stimulating environment at the household level.

sub_schemes.title: AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide accessible, affordable, and holistic healthcare services based on Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani and Homeopathy systems to people of all age groups.

sub_schemes.title: Employee Health Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Employee Health Scheme (EHS) is a government-run health scheme in Andhra Pradesh, providing cashless treatment at network hospitals for government employees, pensioners, and their families under the Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Healthcare Trust.

sub_schemes.title: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health
sub_schemes.description: The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH-based interventions to improve community health outcomes by supporting preventive, promotive, curative, and rehabilitative healthcare services.

sub_schemes.title: Awareness Programme on Child/Human Trafficking, Family Planning, Legal Awareness, Health etc.
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community regarding child/human trafficking, family planning, legal awareness, and health. It generates awareness benefits for the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community through Non-Governmental Organizations proposals.

sub_schemes.title: Ayurswasthya Yojana: Up-gradation of Facilities to Centre of Excellence (CoE)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme-component aims to support the establishment and up-gradation of reputed institutions to Centres of Excellence for strengthening AYUSH education, research, innovation, and advanced healthcare services.

sub_schemes.title: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine
sub_schemes.description: The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH interventions for the treatment and rehabilitation of sports injuries and to enhance health and fitness among sports persons.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Mission For Rejuvenation And Urban Transformation
sub_schemes.description: Providing basic services (e.g. water supply, sewerage, urban transport) to households and building amenities in cities which will improve the quality of life for all, especially the poor and the disadvantaged is a national priority.

sub_schemes.title: Atal Sneh Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Gujarat Chief Minister Shri Vijay Rupani here today announced the Atal ‘Screening of Newborn for Enhancement of Health’ (SNEH) Yojna to be started in the state from the former Prime Minister Atal Behari Vajpayee’s birthday on December 25, 2016.

sub_schemes.title: Aswasakiranam
sub_schemes.description: Aswasakiranam Scheme envisages assisting the caregivers of physically and mentally disabled bedridden patients, who are their family members or relatives. All those who have been providing caregiving service to patients since 02/08/10 will be paid monthly assistance with retrospective effect.

sub_schemes.title: Dikri Development Scheme-DNH&DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims at “Saving girls” as the primary objective and to improve the Sex Ratio at birth. Through this scheme, money is deposited in the name of the girl child under the LIC Single Premium Endowment Plan for the first two living girl children.

sub_schemes.title: AFFDF-Financial Assistance For Treatment Of Serious Diseases To Non Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)/Widows
sub_schemes.description: A scheme to provide financial assistance to a non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen of all ranks and widows to meet medical expenses related to treatment of approved serious diseases like cancer, renal failure, knee replacement and heart surgery.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide youth-friendly counseling services in Government Industrial Training Institutes, delivered by appointed Counselors, to assist trainees suffering from mental, physical, or psychological stress. The benefit is the provision of a safe, confidential space.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes (PIPDIC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to financially assist the entrepreneurs for setting up hospitals/nursing homes. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

sub_schemes.title: Sneha Sparsha
sub_schemes.description: "Sneha Sparsha" is a healthcare scheme by the Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Assam. In this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided for specialized treatment of children below 12 years of age affected with some serious ailments.

sub_schemes.title: Sishu Saathi
sub_schemes.description: “Sishu Saathi”, a scheme of the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal as part of the Rastriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) under National Health Mission is meant to treat Indian children of 0-18 years age group with zero out of pocket expenditure.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 16 January 2018.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of workers engaged in Akik occupation who died due to silicosis disease. It benefits the families of deceased workers with monetary compensation of ₹1,00,000/- as support for occupational disease-related deaths.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Silicosis Affected Workers Welfare Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to workers suffering from silicosis and their families.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers" is a Welfare Scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Dept. The scheme provides financial assistance to help mitigate the financial burden on the worker's family.

sub_schemes.title: Sanitary Napkin Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide sanitary napkins to adolescent girls and women at subsidized rates through Anganwadi centres across the state. Under this scheme, sanitary napkins are made available to adolescent girls and women at a cost of ₹6.00 through Anganwadi centres.

sub_schemes.title: Sanitary Napkin Distribution - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote menstrual hygiene and prevent reproductive tract infections among adolescent girls aged 10 to 19 years in Uttarakhand by providing sanitary napkins at a nominal cost of ₹6/-, available through all ASHA workers across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Sanitary Napkin Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide free sanitary napkins to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers, in order to promote health and hygiene.

sub_schemes.title: Safai Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012.

sub_schemes.title: Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 05 June 2018.

sub_schemes.title: Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

sub_schemes.title: Thalolam Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Kerala launched the “Thalolam Scheme” under Kerala Social Security Mission to provide free treatment to children affected with chronic diseases such as haemophilia, cerebral palsy, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE): Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide health Insurance coverage to all Transgender persons living in India to improve their health condition through proper treatment including sex re-assignment surgeries as well as medical support. The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus.

sub_schemes.title: Su-Swastha Yojana
sub_schemes.description: "Su-Swastha Yojna" provides comprehensive and affordable healthcare coverage to the employees of the Government of Sikkim and their families. Cashless hospitalization at top-tier hospitals across India is provided to eligible beneficiaries with the best-in-class healthcare.

sub_schemes.title: Rural Sports and Health Promotion Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme promotes fitness among rural youth by providing financial assistance to the mangal dals for setting up open gyms in each Gram Panchayat. Financial assistance of ₹17,960/- is allocated per gram panchayat for installing open gym/community fitness equipment to encourage fitness & well-being.

sub_schemes.title: Rules Related to Madhya Pradesh State Disease Assistance Fund
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹2,00,000 to Below Poverty Line (BPL) patients for major surgeries and treatments related to specified serious diseases.

sub_schemes.title: Reimbursement of Expenditure for Occupational Diseases (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Reimbursement of Expenditure for Occupational Diseases'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement of expenditure incurred by the beneficiaries and their dependents for the treatment of 16 dangerous ailments.

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation Allowance To Lepers
sub_schemes.description: The Himachal Pradesh Rehabilitation Allowance to Lepers is a social welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Himachal Pradesh in India to provide financial assistance to people affected by leprosy.

sub_schemes.title: Rehabilitation Treatment For The Disabled
sub_schemes.description: The government of Meghalaya provides rehabilitation treatment for persons with disabilities under the "Disability Rehabilitation Scheme".

sub_schemes.title: Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Minister’s Cancer Patient Fund
sub_schemes.description: The scheme-component aims to provide financial assistance to poor patients living below the poverty line and suffering from cancer, for their treatment at 27 Regional Cancer Centers (RCCs).

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2,000/- per month to Leprosy Patients who are residents of Tripura.

sub_schemes.title: Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹2,000/- to the person suffering from cancer.

sub_schemes.title: Payment of Death Benefit ( HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Payment of Death Benefit" under the Labour and Employment Department, Himachal Pradesh, provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered members. In case of accidental death, ₹4,00,000 is given, while ₹2,00,000 is payable in case of natural death.

sub_schemes.title: Pada Pushti Karyakram
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to ensure access to supplementary nutrition by all children, residing in hard-to-reach villages where there is no Anganwadi centers. This programme is functioning as an extension of respective Anganwadi Centers in the hard-to-reach villages.

sub_schemes.title: PURNA Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to reduce malnutrition, anemia, and early marriage among adolescent girls in Gujarat by educating them on health, nutrition, life skills, and legal rights, while promoting self-empowerment through various activities.

sub_schemes.title: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly.

sub_schemes.title: PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment
sub_schemes.description: PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to the children studying in Government and Government – aided schools. The Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education.

sub_schemes.title: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve the socio-economic status of PVTGs by saturating families and habitations with basic facilities and services. It provides 11 critical infrastructure and welfare interventions, including housing, water, electricity, and connectivity.

sub_schemes.title: Miscarriage Benefit
sub_schemes.description: The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial benefits for miscarriage up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

sub_schemes.title: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
sub_schemes.description: "Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept.,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides medical expenses for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from Cancer, Heart disease, Kidney disease, T.B. etc.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme For Adolescent Girls
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to address malnutrition among adolescent girls through nutritional and non-nutritional support. Through this scheme, nutritional support, health services, nutrition education and skilling support are provided to adolescent girls aged 14-18 years in identified areas.

sub_schemes.title: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
sub_schemes.description: The aim of this aid gratis is to provide financial assistance to non-pensioner ESM or their widow to meet routine medical expenses during the year.

sub_schemes.title: Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive health care and financial assistance for medical treatments. It offers hospital services, medical reimbursements, and subsistence allowances for beedi, cine, and non-coal mine workers and their dependants.

sub_schemes.title: “Home for the Aged" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
sub_schemes.description: Through the scheme “Home for the Aged", the senior citizens are provided with stay at subsidiary rates, food (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian), routine health check up by doctors thrice in a week, providing news papers and television for entertainment.

sub_schemes.title: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
sub_schemes.description: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.

sub_schemes.title: “Family Counseling" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: “Family Counseling" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the residents of Puducherry are provided with counselling, rehabilitative and referral services.

sub_schemes.title: Yoga Wellness Center
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to promote holistic health and wellness among people of all age groups through yoga, naturopathy, and personalized counseling.

sub_schemes.title: Workers In Case Of Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
sub_schemes.description: The "Workers In Case of Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to registered Building and Other Construction (BOC) workers in the case of permanent disablement.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Medical Benefit for Major Ailments
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance for the treatment of beneficiaries or their family members suffering from major ailments like cancer, TB, brain stroke, cardiac problems, and others.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Maternity Benefit
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to a beneficiary on successful delivery of a child or miscarriage by such beneficiary or his wife.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial relief to the beneficiaries in case of permanent disability due to accidents or their dependents/nominees in case of accidental or natural death.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Hospitalization
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to transport workers who are hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident.

sub_schemes.title: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries every 5 years to support the purchase of spectacles, ensuring better eye health and vision.

sub_schemes.title: Welfare Services for Disabled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide support, rehabilitation, and empowerment to persons with disabilities through financial assistance for healthcare, education, vocational training, and assistive devices.

sub_schemes.title: Weekly Iron Folic Acid Tablets Free Distribution - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: This aims to improve the health and nutritional status of school-going children by preventing and reducing iron deficiency anemia. Under this scheme, teachers distribute free iron and folic acid tablets every Monday to all students enrolled in government & government-aided schools across the state.

sub_schemes.title: Vandan Matru Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme is a Gujarat government initiative providing financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women from economically weaker sections to promote maternal and child health.

sub_schemes.title: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to road traffic accident victims. It offers comprehensive medical treatment packages for various injury types with cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.

sub_schemes.title: Urban Health Kiosk Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
sub_schemes.description: The "Urban Health Kiosk Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that aims to provide primary health facilities to the construction workers & their families in urban health kiosks run by Punjab Health Society in slum areas.

sub_schemes.title: Udita Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Udita Yojana" for women health promotions.

sub_schemes.title: Tripura Journalist Health Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A Health Insurance Scheme by the Directorate of Information & Culture Affairs, for Journalists who are permanent residents of the state of Tripura. The applicant must be an accredited journalist by the state government or PIB. The age must be in between 21-65 years.

sub_schemes.title: Total Health Check-up Scheme (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: This scheme facilitates a complete physical examination of the construction workers, which can diagnose potential illnesses and early treatment can prevent major illnesses. Hence, major illness can be avoided and the construction worker can lead a healthy life.

sub_schemes.title: Scheme for Acquisition of Electro-Medical and Other Equipment (PIPDIC)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to financially assist the registered Medical practitioners for acquisition and installation of Electro Medical and other related equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

sub_schemes.title: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana was initiated by the "Department of Women, Child Development, and Social Security, Government of Jharkhand."

sub_schemes.title: State Government Health Scheme (Golden Card)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide quality healthcare facilities to all government employees, pensioners, and their dependents in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, prescribed medical treatment is provided free of cost.

sub_schemes.title: Sruthitharangam ( Cochlear Implantation Scheme )
sub_schemes.description: The Govt. of Kerala launched the “Sruthitharangam (Cochlear Implantation Scheme)” under Kerala Social Security Mission by the Social Justice Department, Kerala. This scheme envisioned providing free cochlear implantation surgery for children in the age group of 0-5 years, who are hearing impaired.

sub_schemes.title: Specialized Treatment & Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides up upto ₹2,00,000/- for specialized medical treatment in Hospitals having tie-ups with Government General Hospitals. The amount for the medical treatment is credited through DBT into the bank account.

sub_schemes.title: Special Livestock Insurance Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Special Livestock Insurance Scheme" is a welfare initiative targeting SC families engaged in livestock rearing. The scheme provides free insurance for livestock, enhancing the economic security of resource-poor SC families. The scheme covers milch animals, sheep, goats, pigs, camels, etc;

sub_schemes.title: Sparsh Abhiyan: Surgery to Prevent Disability of Poor and Destitute Disabled People of Madhya Pradesh
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide surgical treatment to prevent disability among poor and destitute disabled persons. Benefits include financial assistance/reimbursement for various surgeries related to visual, hearing, bone impairment, and leprosy, available to eligible residents of Madhya Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Special Health Scheme for Primitive Tribes
sub_schemes.description: The "Special Health Scheme for Primitive Tribes" scheme by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to improve healthcare services for primitive tribal communities. Financial assistance of ₹38,41,632 is provided for targeted healthcare benefits.

sub_schemes.title: National Youth Award
sub_schemes.description: This award is to motivate young persons to achieve excellence in the field of national development or social service and to develop in them a sense of responsibility to the community and thus to improve their potential as good citizens.

sub_schemes.title: National Livestock Mission: Establishment of State Semen Bank
sub_schemes.description: "Establishment of State Semen Bank (Genetic Improvement of Sheep and Goat breeds)" aims at the genetic improvement of sheep/goat breeds through selective breeding by propagation of superior male germplasm through artificial insemination.

sub_schemes.title: National AIDS Control Programme - Uttarakhand
sub_schemes.description: The programme aims to prevent and control the spread of HIV/AIDS through awareness, testing, and treatment, while providing care and support to affected individuals.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana Jharkhand
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana" by the Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, & Backward Classes Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to provide medical financial aid to beneficiaries. It covers illnesses, surgeries, & nutritional support during & after treatment.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (3 years - 6 years)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomes, with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 3 years and 6 years.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Purna Aahaara for Children (6 months - 5 years)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide nutritional support to Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) children. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per month, along with 30 eggs per month, for a duration of 112 days.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (6 months - 3 years)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomes, with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 6 months and 3 years.

sub_schemes.title: Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to distribute 15 Kg of rice per month or equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the differently abled persons.

sub_schemes.title: Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide insurance benefits in cases of natural death, accidental death, and disability to BPL and Aastha Card holders.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Policy - Assistance on Death
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal heir or nominee in the event of death of the Pneumoconiosis victim.

sub_schemes.title: Silicosis Policy – Rehabilitation Assistance
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide rehabilitation assistance to persons suffering from Silicosis by offering financial support after certification.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Facility Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Hostel Facility Scheme, introduced by the HPBOCWWB , provides financial assistance ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 annually. This support covers accommodation, boarding, and food expenses for the children of registered worker while they reside in a hostel.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, hostel facilities for free accommodation and meals shall be provided to the children of migrant construction workers in primary school. The aim of the scheme is to provide primary, secondary, and higher education to the children of migrant construction workers.

sub_schemes.title: Homes For Intellectually Impaired Persons
sub_schemes.description: The "Homes for Intellectually Impaired Persons" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, Mentally Deficient Children who are in need of care and protection are admitted into shelter homes through the Child Welfare Committees.

sub_schemes.title: Home for Mentally Challenged Children
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Home for Mentally Challenged Children" by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, aims to provide care for children facing mental challenges, i.e. low Intelligence Quotient (IQ). The scheme offers free boarding and lodging, uniform sets, daily living needs, etc.

sub_schemes.title: Home Loan Interest Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
sub_schemes.description: Under the scheme, a 3% Interest Subsidy is provided to workers who are employed in the organized sector to buy their own house and get relief from interest deductions on loans taken from banks.

sub_schemes.title: Halpati Housing Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, ₹1,20,000 financial assistance is provided for self-constructed houses in rural south Gujarat to support housing needs of Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) caste members included in Scheduled Tribes.

sub_schemes.title: Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence
sub_schemes.description: “Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence" was launched by Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. NGOs are paid ₹ 500/- per month per inmates, in two equal installments, for 12 months.

sub_schemes.title: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided house construction subsidy.

sub_schemes.title: Grant for the Repair of House (BBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to registered workers who have been members of the Board for at least three years for repair of house. However, workers who have already received assistance for house construction, bicycles, or tools are not eligible for this benefit.

sub_schemes.title: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home
sub_schemes.description: The "Grant in Aid to Old Age Home" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, grants are provided to the NGOs for accommodating old men & women, destitute, disabled victims, into Old Age Homes, and providing them with food, & accommodation.

sub_schemes.title: Grant In Aid Hostels
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities to tribal students who wish to pursue primary, secondary and higher secondary education. Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to intended beneficiaries who are students studying in standards 5th to 12th.

sub_schemes.title: Government Working Women’s Hostel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Government Working Women’s Hostel" is an initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide safe accommodation facilities to working women who live far away from their families, belonging to lower and middle-income groups.

sub_schemes.title: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Government Service Home" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide institutional care to widows, destitute women, deserted women, adolescent girls and differently-abled women and their children.

sub_schemes.title: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, was introduced to facilitate the education and self-confidence development of visually impaired and hearing-impaired children.

sub_schemes.title: Gaushala Vikas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This initiative provides financial assistance to registered gaushalas for building permanent infrastructure. Under this scheme, up to ₹10,000,00/- can be provided, with 90% of the funding from the state government and 10% contributed by the gaushala.

sub_schemes.title: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
sub_schemes.description: The aims to provide shelter, protection, rehabilitation, livelihood opportunities, and social reintegration support to transgender persons. It also provides shelter facilities, food, medical care, counselling, legal assistance, skill development, and document support to transgender persons.

sub_schemes.title: Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- in three instalments to Gadiya Lohar families in Rajasthan for the construction of permanent houses and ensuring their settlement.

sub_schemes.title: Integrated Hostel Scheme
sub_schemes.description: "Integrated Hostel Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free residential facilities, meals, and basic amenities to SC/ST/OBC students studying in classes 1st to 12th and also to the students pursuing college education.

sub_schemes.title: Indian Community Welfare Fund
sub_schemes.description: A scheme by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for the welfare of Overseas Indians; assisting them in distress situations. ICWF has also been a critical support in emergency evacuation of Indian nationals from conflict zones, countries affected by natural disasters and other challenging situations.

sub_schemes.title: Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme" by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Kerala, aims to improve the basic facilities of houses belonging to widowed, divorced, or abandoned women from minority religious communities.

sub_schemes.title: Housing Subsidy Scheme (GBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board to build their own houses.

sub_schemes.title: House Subsidy Scheme
sub_schemes.description: A subsidy of Rs. 1,30,000/- is given to persons from Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minority Communities, Single Women, or handicapped for the construction of the house.

sub_schemes.title: Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides housing support to tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometown, where hostels are not available.

sub_schemes.title: House Building Loan Scheme for Employees of Government of Goa
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to assist government employees in achieving their dream of owning a house by providing financial support to erstwhile House Building Advance scheme beneficiaries whose loans were operative as on 15th May 2020. The scheme provides loan takeover facility through empanelled banks.

sub_schemes.title: Hostel Rent Assistance Scheme for Tribal Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides financial assistance towards hostel rent for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in government colleges, who are staying in rented accommodation for the purpose of regular studies.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Ministers House Rent
sub_schemes.description: The "Chief Minister's House Rent" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 per student per month in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yoiana 2017
sub_schemes.description: The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has decided to implement the Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yojana 2017 for creating model villages in the state.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme was revised in 2018, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme," to provide an additional ₹1,00,000 assistance to eligible construction workers in urban areas, along with grants from the Central and State Governments.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: Launched in 2013, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme" provides permanent houses to registered construction workers in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh.

sub_schemes.title: Chief Minister Housing Assistance Programme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Chief Minister’s Housing Assistance Programme" by the Housing Department, Government of Meghalaya, aims to provide durable housing to EWS and LIG families. Through this scheme, roofing materials and dwelling houses are provided to eligible families in the State.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the children of construction workers for hostel facilities while they pursue technical/professional courses in recognized institutes.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers
sub_schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for upto 2 children.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide 50% reimbursement of interest on home loans up to ₹1,00,000 for eligible war widows, war bereaved families, war disabled personnel, and attributable peacetime casualties.

sub_schemes.title: Financial Aid For Providing Hostel Facility To Transgender Students
sub_schemes.description: The scheme “Financial Aid for Providing Hostel Facility to Transgender Students” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana
sub_schemes.description: This scheme aims to provide safe housing for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Extremely Backward Classes whose existing group housing under previous schemes has become broken down.

sub_schemes.title: Map Simplification Process
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide an efficient online system for landowners in Haridwar district to get approval for their residential and commercial property maps quickly and easily, ensuring transparency and reducing delays.

sub_schemes.title: Map Approval through UDAY App
sub_schemes.description: It aims to simplify and expedite the process of residential property map creation and approval for all landowners in Haridwar district through mobile app.

sub_schemes.title: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste students in standards 9 to 12. Through this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.

sub_schemes.title: Maintenance of Govt Boys and Girls Hostels (SC)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, it provides free hostel, food, and academic facilities to scheduled caste students pursuing post-SSC education.

sub_schemes.title: Mahila Swayamsiddha Yojana Rajasthan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme objective is to provide free skill training and self-employment support to widowed, abandoned, and destitute women through voluntary organizations. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department with financial assistance provided to participating NGOs.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna (HPBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna, introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), provides financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- to registered worker.

sub_schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Aawasiye Bhu-Adhikaar Yojana
sub_schemes.description: Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh State started this scheme to provide residential plots.

sub_schemes.title: Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls’ Hostel
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to encourage girls’ participation in education at the upper primary and secondary levels and to provide quality education to girls from disadvantaged groups (SC, ST, OBC, Minority communities and BPL families) studying in Classes 6 to 12.

sub_schemes.title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to financially assist the Goan artists to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their houses damaged due to natural calamities. The maximum financial assistance provided under this component is ₹25,000/- or the valuation done by the Taluka Mamlatdar.

sub_schemes.title: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
sub_schemes.description: Under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme, beneficiaries of Middle-Income Group (MIG) can seek housing loans from Banks, Housing Finance Companies and other such institutions for acquisition/ construction of house (including re-purchase).

sub_schemes.title: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
sub_schemes.description: A relief and rehabilitation scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs provides central assistance to the displaced families from PoK And Chhamb and settled in the state of Jammu & Kashmir. The amount of Central Assistance of Rs. 5,49,692/- per family will be distributed through Direct Benefit Transfer.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Purchase of House (HBOCWWB)
sub_schemes.description: Under this scheme, interest free loan is provided to registered construction workers, who have minimum five year’s regular membership, for purchase or construction of their houses. This facility is available once in lifetime.

sub_schemes.title: Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals whose residential houses have been completely or partially damaged due to natural disasters in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, compensation is provided to disaster-affected families to support them in rebuilding or repairing their homes.

sub_schemes.title: Ashram Schools (Scheduled Tribes)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme "Ashram Schools" was launched on 1st January 1966 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides free accommodation, mess, and education facilities to Scheduled Tribe students.

sub_schemes.title: Boarding House Stipend Scheme (Tripura Govt.)
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide accommodation support and reduce dropouts for ST students from remote areas, by offering a stipend per day (including LPG and upkeep) for those in hostels.

sub_schemes.title: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The "Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance in three installments for housing construction to Scheduled Tribes, along with a ₹500 incentive for monitoring agencies for timely completion.

sub_schemes.title: 100% Penalty Mafi Yojana
sub_schemes.description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to beneficiaries of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell who have pending installment dues by offering a complete waiver of penalty amounts. It benefits tenants and property allottees by waiving 100% penalties on arrears if paid by 31st March.

sub_schemes.title: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyaan - DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: The scheme ensures holistic and sustainable development of tribal communities, building on PMJANMAN. It promotes inter-ministerial convergence across 17 ministries with 25 focused interventions. Gap analysis by departments guides need-based funding to bridge development gaps effectively.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
sub_schemes.description: A flagship mission implemented by MoHUA, addressing urban housing shortage. The beneficiaries include Economically Weaker Section (EWS) / Low Income Group (LIG) and Middle Income Group (MIG) categories, including slum dwellers, by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households by 2022.

sub_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
sub_schemes.description: Launch on 1st April 2016, Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G) is centre's flagship mission by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). PMAY-G addresses the rural housing shortage and bridges the housing deficit in rural areas

sub_schemes.title: Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
sub_schemes.description: The umbrella Central Sector Scheme of this Ministry called the "Scheme to Promote Voluntary Action for Persons with Disabilities" was revised w.e.f. 01.04.2003 and was renamed as the "Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)"

sub_schemes.title: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
sub_schemes.description: The Scheme aims at providing hostel facilities to students belonging to socially and educationally backward classes, especially from rural areas, to enable them to pursue secondary and higher education.

sub_schemes.title: Mission Shakti- DNH & DD
sub_schemes.description: Mission Shakti is a Government of India umbrella scheme (2021–26) for women’s safety, security, and empowerment. It follows a life-cycle approach via Sambal (safety) and Samarthya (empowerment), strengthening services like One Stop Centres, Women Helpline (181), and Shakti Sadans.

sub_schemes.title: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyaan
sub_schemes.description: The scheme ensures holistic and sustainable development of tribal communities, building on PMJANMAN. It promotes inter-ministerial convergence across 17 ministries with 25 focused interventions. Gap analysis by departments guides need-based funding to bridge development gaps effectively.

sub_schemes.title: Mission Vatsalya-DNH&DD
sub_schemes.description: Scheme Target for safety, happy childhood for every child by focusing on child protection, welfare, and development.
